And by the night and the things that gather in it.
اور چاند کی جب وہ پورا ہوجائے۔
And by the moon, when it becomes full.
کہ تمہیں زینہ بہ زینہ چڑھنا ہے۔
That you have to ascend step by step.
تو ان لوگوں کو کیا ہوا کہ ایمان نہیں لاتے۔
So what has happened to these people that they do not believe?
اور جب ان کے سامنے قرآن پڑھا جاتا ہے تو سجدہ نہیں کرتے۔
And when the Quran is recited before them, they do not prostrate themselves.
بلکہ کافر جھٹلاتے ہیں۔
Rather, the unbelievers belie.
اور اللہ اُن باتوں سے خوب واقف ہیں جو یہ اپنے دلوں میں چھپاتے ہیں۔
And Allah is well Aware of the matters that they conceal in their hearts.
پس ان کو دردناک عذاب کی خبر سُنادو۔
Thus announce to them the news of a painful torment.
ہاں جو لوگ ایمان لائے اور نیک عمل کرتے رہے ان کے لیے بے انتہا اجر ہے۔
Yes! There is limitless reward for the people who believed and kept performing righteous deeds.
آسمان کی قسم جس میں برج ہیں۔
By the sky wherein are towers.
اور اُس دن کی جس کا وعدہ ہے۔
And by the Day that has been promised.
اور حاضر ہونے والے(دن) کی اور اس (دن) کی جس کے پاس حاضر کیا جائے۔
And by the attending (Day), and by that (Day) which is attended.
کہ خندقوں والے ہلاک کردئیے گئے۔
That the people of the Trench have been destroyed.
آگ(کی خندقیں) جس میں ایندھن جھونک رکھا تھا۔
(Trenchesof) fire in which fuel had been cast.
جب کہ وہ ان(کناروں) پر بیٹھے ہوئے تھے۔
When they were sitting over (the edges).
اور وہ جو(سختیاں) اہلِ ایمان کے ساتھ کررہے تھے ان کو سامنے دیکھ رہے تھے۔
And were witnessing, before them what (hardships) they were inflicting on the believers.
اور ان کو ان(مومنوں) کی یہی بات بُری لگتی تھی کہ وہ اللہ پر ایمان لائے ہوئے تھے جو غالب، قابل ستائش ہے۔
And the only fact that they disliked about them (the believers) was that they had believed in Allah, the Dominant, the Praiseworthy.
وہی ہے جس کی آسمانوں اور زمین میں بادشاہت ہے۔ اور اللہ ہر چیز سے واقف ہے۔
It is He,to Whom belongs the Sovereignty in the heavens and earth. And Allah is Aware of everything.
یقیناً جن لوگوں نے مومن مردوں اور مومن عورتوں کو تکلیفیں دیں پھر توبہ نہ کی تو اُن کو دوزخ کا عذاب بھی ہوگا اور جلنے کا بھی۔
Assuredly, the people who inflicted hardship on the believing men and believing women, then did not repent,for them will be the torment of Hell and also that of the burning.
بے شک جو لوگ ایمان لائے اور نیک کام کرتے رہے ان کے لیے باغات ہیں جن کے تابع نہریں بہتی ہیں، یہی بڑی کامیابی ہے۔
Without doubt, the people who believed and kept performing righteous deeds, for them are gardens under whose direction streams flow; this is the great success.
بے شک تمہارے پروردگار کی گرفت بڑی سخت ہے۔
Without doubt, the Grasp of your Rabb is very severe.
بے شک وہی پہلی دفعہ پیدا کرتا ہے اور وہی دوبارہ(زندہ کرےگا)۔
Without doubt, it is He, Who originates creation, and it is He, Who will repeat (revive) it.
اور وہ بخشنے والا محبت کرنے والا ہے۔
And He is the Forgiving, the Loving.
عرش کا مالک، بڑی شان والا۔
Owner of the Throne, Majestic.
جو چاہتا ہے کردیتا ہے۔
He does whatever He wills.
بھلا تم کو لشکر کا حال معلوم ہے۔
Well then, do you know the account of the hosts?
(یعنی) فرعون اور شمود کے۔
(Meaning, that) of Fir‘aun and Samood.
لیکن کافر تکذیب میں گرفتار ہیں۔
But the unbelievers are caught up in denial.
اور اللہ نے ان کو ہر طرف سے گھیر رکھا ہے۔
And Allah has surrounded them from all sides.
بلکہ یہ قرآن عظیم الشان ہے۔
Rather this is a Majestic Quran.
لوحِ محفوظ میں (لکھا ہوا) ہے۔
(Inscribed) in the Lauh-e Mahfooz.
آسمان کی قسم اور رات کو آنے والے کی۔
By the sky and by the night-comer.
اور تم کو کیا خبر کہ رات کو آنے والا کیا ہے؟۔
And what do you know what the night-comeris.
وہ تارا ہے چمکنے والا۔
It is a star, brilliant
کہ ہر متنفس پر نگہبان مقرر ہے۔
That, on every soul is appointed a guardian.
تو انسان کو دیکھنا چاہیئے کہ وہ کس چیز سے پیدا کیا گیا ہے۔
So man should see from what he has been created.
وہ اُچھلتے ہوئے پانی سے پیدا کیا گیا ہے۔
He has been created from a spurting fluid.
جو پیٹھ اور سینے کے درمیان سے نکلتا ہے۔
Which issues forth from between the back and the chest.
بے شک وہ (اللہ) اُسے دوبارہ پیدا کرنے پر قادر ہے۔
Without doubt, He (Allah) has the Power to create him again.
جس دن پوشیدہ باتیں جانی جائیں گی۔
On the Day the secrets will become known.
تو اس کا کوئی بس نہ چل سکے گا اور نہ (اس کا) کوئی مددگار ہوگا۔
Then he will neither have any authority and nor will there be any helper (for him).
قسم ہے آسمان کی جو مینہ برساتا ہے۔
By the sky that pours rain.
اور زمین کی جو پھٹ جاتی ہے۔
And by the earth that splits.
یقیناً یہ بات (قرآن) فیصل ہے۔
Indeed this (the Quran) is a Decisive Word.
اور یہ فضول بات نہیں ہے۔
It is not a trivial statement.
بے شک یہ لوگ اپنی تدبیروں میں لگے ہوئے ہیں۔
Without doubt, these people are plotting their plots.
اور میں اپنی تدبیر کررہا ہوں۔
And I am making My Plan.
پس کافروں کو مہلت دو بس چند روز مہلت دو۔
Thus, give the unbelievers leave, only a few days’ leave.
اپنے پروردگار جلیل الشان کے نام کی تسبیح کرو۔
Celebrate the Name of your Rabb, the Exalted in Majesty.
جس نے پیدا کیا پھر سنوارا۔
Who created, then perfected.
اور جس نے (اس کا) اندازہ ٹھہرایا پھر (اس کو) راہ دکھائی۔
And Who determined (his) measure, then showed (him) the way.
اور جس نے چارا اگایا۔
And Who grew the fodder.
پھر اس کو سیاہ رنگ کا کوڑا کردیا۔
Then turned it into dark-coloured debris.
ہم آپ کو پڑھا دیں گے پھر آپ بھولیں گے نہیں۔
We shall teach you, then you will not forget.
سوائے اس کے جو اللہ چاہیں یقیناً وہ ظاہر بات کو بھی جانتے ہیں اور پوشیدہ کو بھی۔
Except that which Allah wills. Indeed He knows the revealed as well as the concealed matter.
اور ہم آپ کو آسان طریقے کی توفیق دیں گے۔
And We shall grant you the capacity towards the easy way.
سو جہاں تک نصیحت (کے) نافع (ہونے کی اُمید) ہو نصیحت کرتے رہئیے۔
So keep advising so long as advice is (expected to be) beneficial.
جو ڈرتا ہے نصیحت حاصل کرے گا۔
He who fears will adhere to the advice.
اور (بے خوف) بد بخت پہلو تہی کرے گا۔
And the (fearless) wretched will avoid it.
جو (قیامت کو) بڑی (تیز) آگ میں داخل ہوگا۔
Who will enter the great (blazing) Fire (on the Day of Qiyamah).
پھر وہاں نہ مرے گا اور نہ جی سکے گا۔
Then he will not die therein nor will he be able to live.
جو پاک ہوا یقیناً وہ مراد کو پہنچ گیا۔
He who purifies himself assuredly reached the goal.
اور اپنے پروردگار کے نام کا ذکر کرتا رہا پھر عبادت کرتا رہا۔
And he kept performing the Zikr of his Rabb’s Name, then kept worshipping.
مگر تم لوگ دنیا کی زندگی اختیار کرتے ہو۔
But you people prefer the worldly life.
حالانکہ آخرت بہت بہتر اور ہمیشہ رہنے والی ہے۔
Even though the Hereafter is much better and eternal.
بے شک یہی بات پہلے صحیفوں میں ہے۔
Without doubt, this statement is there in the earlier Scriptures.
ابراہیم (علیہ السلام) اور موسیٰ (علیہ السلام) کے صحیفوں میں۔
(In) the scriptures of Ibraheem (Alaihi as-Salam)and Musa (Alaihi as-Salam).
کیا تم کو ڈھانپ لینے والی کا حال معلوم ہوا؟
Have you come to know the account of the Covering One?
بہت سے چہرے اُس دن ذلیل ہوں گے۔
Many faces will be downcast that Day.
سخت محنت کرنے والے تھکے ماندے۔
Toiling hard, tired, weary.
دہکتی آگ میں داخل ہوں گے۔
Entering into the blazing Fire.
ان کو کھولتے ہوئے چشمے کا پانی پلایا جائے گا۔
They will be made to drink the water of a boiling spring.
اور خار دار جھاڑ کے سوا ان کے لئے کوئی کھانا نہ ہوگا۔
And for them will be no food except dry thorny plant.
نہ وہ فربہی لاتا ہے اور نہ بھوک میں کفایت کرتا ہے۔
That neither nourishes nor stills hunger.
کتنے چہرے اُس دن شادمان ہوں گے۔
How many faces will be cheerful that day.
اپنے اعمال (کی جزا) سے خوش۔
Happy with (the reward of) their deeds.
بہشت بریں ہیں۔
In lofty Paradise.
وہاں کوئی فضول بات نہیں سنیں گے۔
(They) will not hear any vain talk there.
اس میں چشمے جاری ہوں گے۔
Springs will be flowing therein.
وہاں اونچے بچھے ہوئے تخت ہوں گے۔
Elevated couches will be laid out there.
اور آب خورے رکھے ہوئے۔
And cups placed.
اور گاؤ تکیے قطاروں میں لگے ہوئے۔
And cushions set in rows.
اور نفیس مسندیں بچھی ہوئیں۔
And fine carpets laid out.
تو کیا یہ لوگ اونٹوں کی طرف نہیں دیکھتے کہ کیسے (عجیب) پیدا کیے گئے۔
So, do these people not look at the camels, how (strange) they have been created?
اور آسمان کی طرف کہ کیسا بلند کیا گیا ہے۔
And at the heaven how it has been raised high?
اور پہاڑوں کی طرف کہ کیسے نصب کیے گئے ہیں۔
And at the mountains how they have been fixed.
اور زمین کی طرف کہ کیسے بچھائی گئی ہے۔
And at the earth how it has been spread?
سو آپ نصیحت کرتے رہیئے کہ آپ نصیحت کرنے والے ہی ہیں۔
So, keep advising, as you are only an advisor.
(اور) آپ ان پر داروغہ نہیں ہیں۔
(And) you are not a warden over them.
ہاں جس نے منہ پھیرا اور نہیں مانا۔
Yes, whoever turned his face away and did not believe.
تو اللہ اس کو بڑا عذاب دیں گے۔
So Allah will give him severe torment.
بے شک ان کو ہمارے پاس لوٹ کر آنا ہے۔
Without doubt, they have to return to Us.
پھر یقیناً ہم کو ہی ان سے حساب لینا ہے۔
Then indeed it is for Us to call them to account.
فجر کی قسم۔
By the Dawn.
اور دس راتوں کی۔
And by the ten nights.
اور جفت اور طاق کی۔
And by the even and the odd.
اور رات کی جب جانے لگے۔
And by the night when it departs.
یقیناً یہ چیزیں عقلمندوں کے نزدیک قسم کھانے کے لائق ہیں۔
Indeed, with the intelligent, these things are worthy to swear by.
کیا تم نے نہیں دیکھا کہ تمہارے پروردگار نے عاد کے ساتھ کیا کیا۔
Did you not observe what your Rabb did to the ‘Aad?
جوارم (کہلاتے تھے اتنے) دراز قد تھے۔
Who were (called as) Irum, (so) tall in height.
کہ تمام ملک میں ان جیسے او رلوگ پیدا نہ کیے گئے۔
That other people like them were not created in the whole land.
اور ثمود کے ساتھ (کیا کیا) جو وادی (قریٰ) میں پتھر تراشتے (اور گھر بناتے) تھے۔
And (what Hedid to) the Samood, who used to carve rocks (and build homes) in the valley (of Qura)?
اور فرعون کے ساتھ جو میخوں والا تھا۔
And to Fir‘aun, who was the Owner of stakes?
یہ لوگ ملکوں میں سرکش ہو رہے تھے۔
These people were getting rebellious in the whole land.
پھر ان میں بہت خرابیاں کرتے تھے۔
And used to cause much disorder therein.
تو آپ کے ربّ نے ان پر عذاب کا کوڑا برسایا۔
So your Rabbunleashed on them the lash of torment.
بے شک آپ کا پروردگار تاک میں ہے۔
No doubt, your Rabb is on the watch.
مگر انسان (عجیب ہے) جب اس کا پروردگار اس کو آزماتا ہے پھر اسے عزت دیتا اور نعمت بخشتا ہے تو کہتا ہے (آہا) میرے پروردگار نے مجھے عزت بخشی۔
But man (is strange)- when his Rabb tries him,then grants him honour and bounty, he says, ‘(Aha!) my Rabb has granted me honour.’
اور جب (دوسری) طرح) آزماتا ہے تو اس پر اس کی روزی تنگ کردیتا ہے تو کہتا ہے (ہائے) میرے پروردگار نے مجھے ذلیل کیا۔
And when He tries him (differently), then restricts his livelihood, he says, ‘(Alas!) my Rabb has humiliated me.’
ہرگز نہیں! بلکہ تم لوگ یتیم کی خاطر نہیں کرتے۔
Never! Rather you people do not honour the orphan.
اور نہ مسکین کو کھانا کھلانے کی رغبت دلاتے ہو۔
And nor urge (each other) to feed the poor.
او رمیراث کو سمیٹ کر کھا جاتے ہو۔
And collect the inheritance and devour it.
اور مال کو بہت ہی عزیز رکھتے ہو۔
And love wealth with exceeding love.
تو پھر جب زمین توڑ دی جائے گی ریزہ ریزہ۔
So, when the earth will be broken into minute fragments.
اور تمہارا پروردگار جلوہ فرما ہوگا اور فرشتے قطار در قطار۔
And your Rabb will appear in Resplendent Majesty and the angels in rows upon rows.
اور اس دن دوزخ (سامنے) لائی جائے گی اس روز انسان متنبہ ہوگا مگر اب انتباہ سے اسے فائدہ کہاں۔
And that day, the Hell will be brought (in front); man will come to realise that Day, but how will the realisation benefit him then?
کہے گا اے کاش! میں نے اپنی (ہمیشہ کی) زندگی کے لیے کچھ آگے بھیجا ہوتا۔
He will say, ‘Alas! Would that I had sent ahead something for my (eternal) life!
پس اُس دن اُس (اللہ) کے عذاب کی طرح کا عذاب (کوئی کسی کو) نہ دے سکے گا۔
Thus on that Day, no one will be able to give torment (to anyone), like His (Allah’s) torment.
اور نہ کوئی اُس کی طرح قابو کرسکے گا۔
Nor will anyone be able to bind like He will bind.
اے اطمینان پانے والی روح!
O the satisfied Rooh!
اپنے پروردگار کی طرف لوٹ چل کہ تو اس سے راضی ہے (اور) وہ تجھ سے راضی۔
Return to your Rabb, as you are pleased with Him (and) He is pleased with you.
پھر تو میرے (ممتاز) بندوں میں شامل ہوجا۔
Then join My (distinguished) slaves.
اور میری بہشت میں داخل ہوجا۔
And enter My Paradise.
ہمیں اس شہر کی قسم۔
Iswear by this city.
اور آپ اس شہر میں رہتے ہیں۔
And you live in this city.
اور باپ (یعنی آدم علیہ السلام) اور اُن کی اولاد کی قسم۔
And by the father (Adam -Alaihi as-Salam) and his progeny.
کہ بلاشبہ ہم نے انسان کو تکلیف (کی حالت) میں (رہنے والا) بنایا ہے۔
That undoubtedly, We have created man (to remain) in (a state of) hardship.
کیا وہ سوچتا ہے کہ اس پر کوئی قابو نہ پاسکے گا۔
Does he think that no one will be able to overcome him?
کہتا ہے میں نے تو بہت سا مال خرچ کردیا۔
(He) says, ‘I have spent a lot of wealth.’
کیا اُسے یہ گمان ہے کہ اس کو کسی نے نہیں دیکھا۔
Does he assume that no one has seen him?
بھلا ہم نے اس کو دو آنکھیں نہیں دیں۔
Well then, have We not granted him two eyes?
اور زبان اور دو ہونٹ (نہیں دئیے)۔
And (have not granted) a tongue and two lips?
اور (خیر و شر کے) دونوں راستے بھی اس کو دکھادئیے۔
And showed him both ways (that of goodness and evil).
مگر وہ گھاٹی پر سے ہو کر نہ گزرا۔
But he did not pass over the steep course
اور تم کو کیا خبر کہ گھاٹی کیا ہے؟
And what do you know what steep course is?
کسی (کی) گردن کا چھڑانا۔
Getting (someone’s) neck freed.
یا بھوک کے دن کھانا کھلانا۔
Or feeding on a day of hunger.
یتیم رشتہ دار کو۔
The orphan relative.
یا فقیر خاکسار کو۔
Or the destitute beggar.
پھر ان لوگوں میں (داخل) ہوا جو ایمان لائے اور صبر کی نصیحت کی اور شفقت برتنے کی نصیحت کی۔
He then became of(entered) the people, who believed and advised patience and advised kindness.
یہی لوگ صاحبِ یمین ہیں۔
These people are the Sahib-e Yameen.
اور جنہوں نے ہماری آیات کو نہ مانا وہ بد بخت ہیں۔
And those who did not believe in Our Ayaat, they are the wretched.
یہ لوگ آگ میں بند کردئیے جائیں گے۔
These people will be enclosed in Fire.
سورج کی قسم اور اس کی روشنی کی۔
By the sun and by its light.
اور چاند کی جب اس کے بعد نکلے۔
And by the moon when it rises after it.
اور دن کی جب اُس کو روشن کردے۔
And by the day when it illuminates it.
اور رات کی جب اسے ڈھانپ لے۔
And by the night when it covers it.
اور آسمان کی اور اس ذات کی جس نے اُسے بنایا۔
And by the heaven and by the Being, Who created it.
اور زمین کی اور اس ذات کی جس نے اسے پھیلایا۔
And by the earth and by the Being, Who spread it.
اور انسان کی اور اس ذات کی جس نے اُسے سنوارا۔
And by the man and the Being, Who perfected him.
پھر اس کو بُرائی اور نیکی کا شعور دیا۔
And granted him the perception of evil and Allah-consciousness.
جس نے خود کو پاک رکھا یقیناً کامیاب ہوا۔
He, who kept himself pious, surely succeeded.
او رجس نے اپنا آپ خاک میں ملایا یقینا نقصان میں رہا۔
And he, who threw it in the dust, surely suffered loss.
ثمود نے اپنی سرکشی سے (پیغمبر کو) جھٹلایا۔
Samood denied (the Messenger) in their rebellion.
جب ان میں سے ایک بدبخت اُٹھا۔
When a wretched one of them rose.
تو اللہ کے رسول (صالح علیہ السلام) نے ان سے اللہ کی اونٹنی اور اس کے پانی پینے کی باری (کی حفاظت) کے بارے کہا۔
So, the Messenger of Allah (Salih - Alaihi as-Salam) spoke to them about the she-camel of Allah and (the protection of) its turn to drink water.
تو انہوں نے ان کو جھٹلایا پھر اس (اونٹنی) کی کونچیں کاٹ دیں تو ان کے پروردگار نے ان کے گناہ کے سبب ان پر عذاب نازل کیا پس سب کو (ہلاک کرکے) برابر کردیا۔
So they denied him and hamstrung her (the she-camel), so their Rabb sent down torment upon them for their sin, thus levelled them (destroying them) all.
اور (اللہ) کو اس کے انجام سے کوئی خوف نہ تھا۔
And (He, Allah) had no fear of its consequence.
رات کی قسم جب (دن کو) چھپالے۔
By the night when it hides (the day).
اور دن کی قسم جب چمک اٹھے۔
And by the day when it shines forth.
اور اُس ذات کی قسم جس نے نر اور مادہ پیدا کیے۔
And by the Being, Who created the male and the female.
کہ بے شک تم لوگوں کی کوشش مختلف ہے۔
That, without doubt, your endeavours are diverse.
تو جس نے (اللہ کی راہ میں) مال دیا اور پرہیز گاری کی۔
So, he who gives wealth (in Allah’s Way) and adopts Allah-consciousness.
اور نیک بات کو سچ مانا۔
And believes righteousness to be true.
تو اس کو ہم آسان طریقے کی توفیق دیں گے۔
So, We will grant him the capacity of (following) the easy way.
اور جس نے بخل او رلاپرواہی کی۔
And he, who practises miserliness and indifference.
اور نیک بات کو جھوٹ سمجھا۔
And considers righteousness to be false.
تو ہم اسے سختی میں پہنچائیں گے۔
So, We will lead him to hardship.
اور جب وہ (دوزخ میں) گرے گا تو اس کا مال اُس کے کچھ کام نہ آئے گا۔
And, when he falls (into Hell) his wealth will not avail him in the least.
یقیناً ہمارے ذمہ ہے راہ دکھانا۔
Indeed it is upon Us to show the way.
اور بے شک آخرت اور دنیا ہماری ہی چیزیں ہیں۔
And undoubtedly, to Us alone, belong the world and the Hereafter.
سو میں نے تم کو بھڑکتی آگ سے متنبہ کیا۔
So, I have warned you of the blazing Fire.
اس میں بڑا بد بخت ہی داخل ہوگا۔
Only the extremely wretched will enter it.
جس نے جھٹلایا اور منہ پھیرا۔
Who denied and turned his face.
اور جو بڑا پرہیز گار ہے وہ اس سے بچالیا جائے گا۔
And he, who is highly conscious of Allah, will be saved from it.
جو اپنا مال دیتا ہے کہ پاک ہو۔
Who gives his wealth to be purified.
اور اس لیئے نہیں (دیتا) کہ اس پر کسی کا احسان ہے جس کا بدلہ اتار رہا ہے۔
And (does) not (give) for the reason that on him is someone’s favour, which he is repaying.
بلکہ اپنے اعلیٰ و بلند پروردگار کی رضا مندی حاصل کرنے کے لیئے دیتا ہے۔
But gives to earn the Good Pleasure of his Rabb, the High, the Exalted.
اور وہ عنقریب خوش ہوگا۔
And he will soon become pleased.
آفتاب کی روشنی کی قسم۔
By the light of the sun.
اور رات (کی تاریکی) کی جب چھا جائے۔
And by the (darkness of the) night when it spreads.
(اے حبیبﷺ) آپ کے پروردگار نے نہ آپ کو چھوڑا اور نہ (آپ سے) ناراض ہوا۔
(O Beloved - Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) your Rabb has neither abandoned you and nor has got annoyed (with you).
اور آخرت آپ کے لیے پہلی (حالت یعنی دنیا) سے کہیں بہتر ہے۔
And the Hereafter is far better for you than the present (phase - meaning the world).
اور آپ کو آپ کا پروردگار عنقریب وہ کچھ عطا فرمائے گا کہ آپ خوش ہو جائیں گے۔
And your Rabb will soon grant you that with which you will become pleased.
بھلا اس نے آپ کو یتیم پاکر جگہ نہیں دی۔
Well then, did He not, finding you orphan, lodge you?
اور آپ کو جستجو میں پایا تو سیدھا راستہ دکھایا۔
And found you seeking, so showed you the straight path.
اور تنگدست پایا تو غنی کردیا۔
And found you in need, so made you self-sufficient.
سو آپ بھی یتیم پر سختی نہ کیجیئے۔
Therefore, you too, be not severe to the orphan.
اور مانگنے والے کو نہ جھڑکیں۔
And rebuke not the beggar.
اور اپنے پروردگار کی نعمتوں کا بیان کرتے رہیئے۔
And keep mentioning the bounties of your Rabb.
کیا ہم نے آپ کا سینہ کھول نہیں دیا۔
Have We not expanded your breast?
اور آپ پر سے آپ کا بوجھ بھی اتار دیا۔
And have also removed your burden from you.
جس نے آپ کی پیٹھ توڑ رکھی تھی۔
That had broken your back.
اور ہم نے آپ کا ذکر بلند کردیا۔
And We exalted your mention.
ہاں ہاں مشکل کے ساتھ آسانی بھی ہے۔
Yes, yes, there is also ease along with difficulty.
بے شک مشکل کے ساتھ آسانی بھی ہے۔
No doubt, there is also ease along with difficulty.
پس جب آپ فارغ ہوں تو محنت (عبادت) کیا کریں۔
Thus, make effort (worship) when you are free.
اور اپنے پروردگار کی طرف متوجہ ہوجایا کریں۔
And become attentive towards your Rabb.
قسم ہے انجیر کی اور زیتون کی۔
By the fig and by the olive.
اور طورِ سینین کی۔
And by the Toor Sineen.
اور اس امن والے شہر کی۔
And by this Secure City.
کہ یقیناً ہم نے انسان کو بہت اچھی صورت میں پیدا کیا۔
That, We have indeed created man in a very good form.
پھر (رفتہ رفتہ) اس (کی حالت) کو پست سے پست کردیا۔
Then (gradually) reduced him (his condition) from the low to the lowest.
سوائے ان لوگوں کے جو ایمان لائے او رنیک عمل کرتے رہے تو ان کے لیے بے انتہا اجر ہے۔
Except those people who believed and kept performing righteous deeds, for them is limitless reward.
تو پھر (اے انسان!) تُو جزا کے دن کو کیوں جھٹلاتا ہےْ
So, then (O man!) why do you deny the Day of Recompense?
کیا اللہ سب سے بڑے حاکم نہیں؟
Is Allah not the Greatest of all rulers?
(اے حبیبﷺ!) اپنے پروردگار کا نام لے کر پڑھیں جس نے (عالم کو) پیدا کیا۔
(O Beloved - Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam !) Read, with the Name of your Rabb, Who created (the universe).
انسان کو خون کی پھٹکی سے بنایا۔
Created man from a clot of blood.
پڑھیے اور آپ کا پروردگار بڑا کریم ہے۔
Read, and your Rabb is Extremely Bountiful.
جس نے قلم کے ذریعے علم سکھایا۔
Who taught knowledge by means of the pen.
انسان کو وہ باتیں سکھائیں جو وہ نہیں جانتا تھا۔
Taught man that which he did not know.
خبردار! یقیناً انسان سرکش ہو جاتا ہے۔
Beware! Indeed man becomes rebellious.
جب خود کو غنی دیکھتا ہے۔
When he sees himself self-sufficient.
یقیناً (اسے) آپ کے پرودگار کی طرف ہی لوٹ کر جانا ہے۔
Indeed (he) has to return to your Rabb only.
بھلا تم نے اس شخص کو دیکھا جو منع کرتا ہے۔
Well then, have you seen the person who forbids
ایک بندے کو جب وہ عبادت کرنے لگتا ہے۔
A slave, when he starts to worship?
بھلا دیکھو اگر یہ راہِ راست پر ہو۔
Well then, see, if he is on the right path.
یا پرہیز گاری کا حکم کرے۔
Or enjoins Allah-consciousness.
دیکھو تو اگر اس نے( دین حق کو) جھٹلایا اور(اس سے) منہ موڑا۔
Look then, if he denied (the True Deen) and turned his face (from it).
کیا اس کو معلوم نہیں کہ اللہ دیکھ رہے ہیں۔
Does he not know that Allah is watching?
دیکھو! اگر وہ باز نہ آٗئے گا تو ہم (اس کو) پیشانی) کے بالوں سے گھسیٹیں گے۔
Look! If he does not desist, We shall drag (him) by his forelock.
اس جھوٹے خطا کار کی پیشانی کے بال۔
The forelock of this lying sinner.
تو وہ اپنے ہم مجلسوں کو بُلالے۔
So, let him summon his companions.
ہم بھی (اپنے) مؤکلانِ دوزخ کو بُلائیں گے۔
We will also summon (Our) Wardens of Hell.
خبر دار! اس کا کہا نہ ماننا اور سجدہ کرنا اور (اللہ کا) قرب حاصل کرتے رہنا۔
Beware! Do not obey him; and prostrate yourself and keep acquiring the Nearness (of Allah).
بے شک ہم نے اس (قرآن) کو شبِ قدر میں نازل (کرنا شروع) کیا۔
Indeed We revealed (started revealing) it (the Quran) during the Night of Qadr.
اور تمہیں کیا معلوم کہ شبِ قدر کیا ہے؟
And what do you know, what is the Night of Qadr?
شبِ قدر ہزار مہینے سے بہتر ہے۔
The Night of Qadr is better than a thousand months.
اس میں فرشتے اور روح اپنے پروردگار کے حکم سے اترتے ہیں ہر کام(کے انتظام) کے لیئے۔
In it descend the angels and the Rooh by the Command of their Rabb, for (administering) every affair.
یہ(رات) طلوعِ صبح تک(امان اور) سلامتی ہے۔
This (Night) is (security and) peace till the break of dawn.
جو لوگ کافر ہیں(یعنی )اہل کتاب اور مشرک وہ (کفر سے) باز رہنے والے نہ تھے جب تک ان کے پاس کُھلی دلیل (نہ) آتی۔
The people who are unbelievers, (meaning) the People of the Book and the polytheist, were not going to desist (from unbelief), until a manifest sign had (not) come to them.
اللہ کے رسول جو پاک اوراق پڑھتے ہیں۔
The Messenger of Allah, who recites holy pages.
جن میں محکم آیات (لکھی ہوئی) ہیں ۔
In which are (written) categorical Ayaat.
اور اہل کتاب جو متفرق ہوئے ہیں تو اپنے پاس دلیل واضح آنے کے بعد (ہوئے ہیں)۔
And the People of the Book who have differed, (have done so) only after the coming of manifest proof to them.
اور ان کو حکم تو یہی ملا تھا کہ اخلاص کے ساتھ یکسو ہو کر اللہ کی عبادت کریں اور نماز پڑھیں اور زکوٰۃ دیں اور یہی سچا دین ہے۔
And they had been commanded only to worship Allah with sincerity and single-mindedness and to offer Salah and to pay Zakat, and only that is the True Deen.
بے شک جو لوگ کافر ہیں (یعنی) اہلِ کتاب او رمشرک، وہ دوزخ کی آگ میں پڑیں گے(اور) ہمیشہ اس میں رہیں گے۔ یہ لوگ ساری مخلوق سے بدتر ہیں۔

Without doubt, the people who are unbelievers, (meaning) the People of the Book and the polytheists, shall be in Hell-fire, (and) shall remain therein forever. These people are the worst of the entire creation.
بے شک جو لوگ ایمان لائے او رنیک عمل کرتے رہے وہ تمام مخلوق سے بہتر ہیں۔
Without doubt, the people who believed and kept performing righteous deeds, they are the best of the entire creation.
ان کا صلہ ان کے پروردگار کے ہاں ہمیشہ رہنے والے باغ ہیں جن کے تابع نہریں جاری ہیں، ہمیشہ ہمیشہ ان میں رہیں گے۔ اللہ اُن سے خوش اور وہ اس سے خوش۔ یہ (صلہ) ہے اُس کے لیے جو اپنے پروردگار سے ڈرتا رہے۔

Their reward with their Rabb are Gardens of Eternity, under whose direction streams are flowing; they will remain therein forever. Allah is well pleased with them and they are well pleased with Him. This (reward) is for him, who keeps fearing his Rabb.
جب زمین اپنے ہی بھونچال سے ہلادی جائے گی۔
When the earth will be shaken with an earthquake.
اور زمین اپنے (اندر کے) بوجھ نکال ڈالے گی۔
And the earth will cast out its (inner) burdens.
اور انسان کہے گا اس کو کیا ہوا ہے؟
And man will say, ‘What has happened to it?’
اُس روز وہ اپنے حالات بیان کردے گی۔
That Day, it will narrate its accounts.
کیونکہ تمہارے پروردگار نے اس کو حکم بھیجا(ہوگا)۔
Because your Rabb (would have) commanded her.
(تو) اُس دن لوگ گروہ گروہ ہو کر آئیں گے تاکہ اُن کو اُن کے اعمال دکھا دئیے جائیں۔
(So) people will come group by group that Day, so that they are shown their deeds.
تو جس نے ذرہ برابر نیکی کی ہوگی وہ اس کو دیکھ لے گا۔
So, whoever did good equal to an atom, will see it.
اور جس نے ذرہ برابر برائی کی ہوگی وہ اسے دیکھ لے گا۔
And whoever did evil equal to an atom, will see it.
اُن سرپٹ دوڑنے والے گھوڑوں کی قسم جو ہانپ اٹھتے ہیں۔
By the headlong charging steeds that start panting.
پھر(پتھروں پر) نعل مار کر آگ نکالنے والوں کی۔
Then by those that produce sparks by striking hoofs (on stones).
پھر صبح کے وقت چھاپہ مارنے والوں کی۔
Then by those that raid at dawn.
پھر اس میں گرد اٹھاتے ہیں۔
Then raise dust therein.
پھر اس وقت(دشمن کی) فوج میں جاگھستے ہیں۔
Then at the same time, penetrate into the (enemy’s) army.
بے شک انسان اپنے رب کا ناشکرا ہے۔
Without doubt, man is ungrateful to his Rabb.
اوریقیناً وہ اس بات پر گواہ بھی ہے۔
And indeed he is also a witness to this fact.
اور یقیناً وہ مال سے سخت محبت کرنے والا ہے۔
And indeed he is an intense lover of wealth.
کیا وہ نہیں جانتا جب قبروں سے(مرُدوں کو) اُٹھایا جائے گا؟
Does he not know when those in the graves (the dead) will be raised,
اور جو(بھید) دلوں میں ہیں وہ حاصل کرلئیے جائیں گے۔
And those (secrets) that are in the hearts will be obtained?
یقیناً ان کا پروردگار اُس روز ان سے خوب واقف ہوگا۔
Indeed, that Day, their Rabb will be well Aware of them.
کھڑکھڑانے والی۔
The Clatterer.
کھڑ کھڑانے والی کیا ہے؟
What is the Clatterer?
اور تم کو کیا خبر کھڑ کھڑانے والی کیا ہے؟
And what do you know what is the Clatterer?
جس دن لوگ ایسے ہوں گے جیسے بکھری ہوئی ٹڈیاں۔
The Day when people will be like scattered locust.
اور پہاڑ دھنکی ہوئی پشم کی طرح ہوجائیں گے۔
And the mountains will become like carded wool.
تو جس (کے اعمال) کا وزن بھاری ہوگا۔
So, he whose weight (of deeds) will be heavy.
تو وہ اپنی پسند کی عیش میں ہوگا۔
He will be in the bliss of his choice.
اور جس کے اعمال کا وزن کم نکلے گا۔
And he whose weight (of deeds) will prove to be light.
تو اس کی جگہ ہاویہ ہے۔
Then his abode is Hawiyah.
اور تمہیں کیا خبر کہ وہ (ہادیہ) کیا ہے؟
And what do you know what is that (Hawiyah)?
(وہ) دہکتی ہوئی آگ ہے۔
(That is) the blazing Fire.
(لوگو!) تم کو(مال کی) بہتات نے غافل کردیا۔
(O people) the abundance (of wealth) has made you heedless.
یہاں تک کہ تم نے قبریں جا دیکھیں۔
Until you reach the graves.
خبردار! تمہیں بہت جلد معلوم ہوجائے گا۔
Beware! You will come to know very soon.
پھر دیکھو! تمہیں عنقریب معلوم ہوجائے گا۔
Again, look! You will come to know soon.
دیکھو! اگر تم جانتے علم الیقین (رکھتے تو غفلت نہ کرتے)۔
Look! Had you (possessed) the sure knowledge (you would not have been heedless).
تم ضرور دوزخ کو دیکھو گے۔
You will assuredly see Hell.
پھر اُس کو (ایسا) دیکھو گے (کہ) عین الیقین سے۔
Then you will see it with sure vision.
پھر اُس روز تم سے(شکر) نعمت کے بارے پوچھا جائے گا۔
Then on that Day, you will be questioned about (gratitude for) the bounty.
زمانے کی قسم۔
By the time.
یقیناً انسان نقصان میں ہے۔
Indeed man is in loss.
سوائے ان لوگوں کے جو ایمان لائے اور نیک عمل کرتے رہے اور آپس میں حق (بات) کی تلقین کرتے رہے اور صبر کی تاکید کرتے رہے۔
Except for those people who believed and kept performing righteous deeds and kept preaching (the words of) Truth among themselves and kept enjoining patience.
ہر طعن کرنے والے چغل خور کی خرابی ہے۔
Woe to every slanderer, backbiter.
جو مال جمع کرتا ہے اور اسے گن گن کر رکھتا ہے۔
Who amasses wealth and stores it, counting (it) repeatedly.
خیال کرتا ہے کہ اس کا مال اس کو ہمیشہ رکھے گا۔
He assumes that his wealth will make him immortal.
ہرگز نہیں! وہ ضرور حطمہ میں ڈالا جائے گا۔
Never! He will assuredly be cast into Hutamah.
اور تم کیا سمجھے کہ حطمہ کیا ہے؟
And what did you understand what is Hutamah?
وہ اللہ کی بھڑکائی ہوئی آگ ہے۔
A fire kindled by Allah.
جو دلوں پر جالپٹے گی۔
That will leap and wrap the hearts.
وہ یقیناً اس میں بند کر دئیے جائیں گے۔
They will assuredly be enclosed in it.
(آگ کے) لمبے لمبے ستونوں میں۔
In outstretched columns (of fire).
کیا آپ نے نہیں دیکھا کہ آپ کے پروردگار نے ہاتھی والوں کے ساتھ کیا کیا؟
Did you not see what your Rabb did to the people of the Elephant?
کیا اُن کا داؤ غلط نہیں کیا؟
Did (He) not foil their plot?
اور ان پر جُھنڈ کے جُھنڈ اُڑتے جانور(پرند) بھیجے۔
And sent on them flocks upon flocks of flying creatures (birds).
جو اُن پر کنکر سے پتھر پھینکتے تھے۔
Which pelted them with stones of baked clay.
سو ان کو ایسا کر دیا جیسا کھایا ہوا بُھس۔
So (He) made them like eaten up chaff.
قریش کے مانوس کرنے کے سبب۔
For the purpose of familiarising the Quraish.
(یعنی) ان کو مانوس کرنے کے سبب جاڑے اور گرمی کے سفر سے۔
(Meaning) for the purpose of familiarising them with their winter and summer journeys.
تو لوگوں کو چاہیئےکہ اس گھر کے مالک کی عبادت کریں۔
So the people should worship the Owner of this House.
جس نے اُن کو بھوک میں کھانا کھلایا اور ان کو خوف سے امن بخشا۔
Who provided them with food during hunger and granted them safety from fear.
بھلا آپ نے اس شخص کو دیکھا جو جھٹلاتا ہے جزا(کے دن) کو؟
Well then, have you seen the person who denies the (Day of) Recompense?
تو یہ وہی ہے جو یتیم کو دھکے دیتا ہے۔
He is the same who repulses the orphan.
اور فقیر کو کھانا کھلانے کے لیے(لوگوں کو) ترغیب نہیں دیتا۔
And does not urge (people) to feed the needy.
پس ایسے نمازیوں کے لئیےخرابی ہے۔
Thus, woe to such performers of Salah.
جو اپنی نماز کی طرف سے غافل رہتے ہیں۔
Who remain neglectful of their Salah.
جو دکھاوا کرتے ہیں۔
Who show off.
اور برتنے کی چیزیں عاریتاً نہیں دیتے۔
And do not lend items of common use.
(اے حبیبﷺ!) بے شک ہم نے آپ کو کوثر عطا فرمائی۔
(O Beloved, Sall Allah-o Alaihi wa Sallam) Without doubt, We have granted you the Kausar.
تو آپ اپنے پروردگار کے لیے نماز پڑھا کریں اور قربانی دیا کریں۔
So offer Salah for your Rabb and offer sacrifice.
یقیناً آپ کا دشمن ہی بے اولاد رہے گا۔
Without doubt, it is your very enemy who will remain childless.
کہہ دیجئیے اے کافرو!
Say, ‘O unbelievers!
نہیں عبادت کرتا میں ان(بتوں) کی جن کی تم عبادت کرتے ہو۔
I do not worship those (idols) whom you worship.
اور جس کی میں عبادت کرتا ہوں تم اس کی عبادت نہیں کرتے۔
And, you do not worship Whom I worship.
اور جن کی تم عبادت کرتے ہو میں ان کی عبادت کرنے والا نہیں۔
And neither am I going to worship those whom you worship.
اور نہ تم اس کی عبادت کرنے والے(معلوم ہوتے) ہو جس کی میں عبادت کرتا ہوں۔
And nor you are going to (seem to) worship Whom I worship.
تمہارے لئے تمہارا دین او رمیرے لیے میرا دین۔
For you is your religion and for me is my Deen.
جب اللہ کی مدد آئی اور فتح(حاصل ہوگئی)۔
When Allah’s Help arrived and victory (was achieved).
اور آپ نے دیکھا کہ لوگ غول کے غول اللہ کے دین میں داخل ہورہے ہیں۔
And you saw that people are entering Allah’s Deen, in multitudes.
تو اپنے پروردگار کی تعریف کے ساتھ تسبیح کریں اور اُس سے مغفرت مانگیں بے شک وہ معاف کرنے والا ہے۔
So celebrate the Glory of your Rabb with Praise, and beseech forgiveness from Him; no doubt, He is the Relenting.
ابولہب کے ہاتھ ٹوٹیں اور وہ ہلاک ہو۔
May the hands of Abu Lahab break and (may) he perish!
نہ اس کا مال ہی اس کے کام آیا اور نہ وہ(کردار) جو اس نے کمایا۔
Neither did his wealth avail him and nor did that (reputation) which he earned.
وہ جلد بھڑکتی آگ میں داخل ہوگا۔
Soon he will enter the blazing Fire.
اور اُس کی بیوی بھی جو ایندھن اُٹھائے پھرتی ہے۔
And so will his wife, who carries firewood.
اس کے گلے میں پوست کھجور کی رسی ہوگی۔
In her neck will be a rope of the palm fibre.
کہہ دیجئیے وہ اللہ ایک ہے۔
Say, ‘He, Allah is One.
اللہ بے احتیاج ہے۔
Allah is Absolute.
نہ کسی کا باپ ہے اور نہ کسی کا بیٹا۔
Neither is He anyone’s father and nor anyone’s son.
اور کوئی اُس کی برابری کرنے والا نہیں۔
And there is none equal to Him.’
کہہ دیجئے کہ میں صبح کے پروردگار کی پناہ مانگتا ہوں۔
Say, ‘I seek refuge with the Rabb of the dawn.
ہر چیز کی برائی سے جو اُس نے پیدا کی۔
From the evil of everything that He created.
اور شبِ تاریک کی برائی سے جب اس کا اندھیر اچھا جائے۔
And from the evil of the dark night when its darkness spreads.
اور گرہوں پر(پڑھ کر) پھونکنے والیوں کی برائی سے۔
And from the evil of the women (reciting and) blowing on knots.
اور حسد کرنے والے کی برائی سے جب حسد کرنے لگے۔
And the evil of the jealous when he starts to feel jealous.’
کہہ دیجئیے کہ میں لوگوں کے پروردگار کی پناہ مانگتا ہوں ۔
Say,‘I seek refuge with the Rabb of mankind.
لوگوں کے حقیقی بادشاہ کی۔
The True Sovereign of mankind.
لوگوں کے معبودِ برحق کی۔
The True Ilaha of mankind.
وسوسہ ڈالنے والے کی برائی سے جو (اللہ کا نام سن کر) پیچھے ہٹ جاتا ہے۔
From the evil of the whisperer who withdraws (on hearing Allah’s Name).
جو لوگوں کے دلوں میں وسوسے ڈالتا ہے۔
Who whispers into the hearts of people.
جنات میں سے اور انسانوں میں سے۔
From among the Jinn and the humans.’
In the Name of Allah The Most Gracious, The Most Merciful.
All Praise is for Allah Alone, Rabb of the entire Universe.
The Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
Master of the Day of Judgement.
You Alone do we worship and from You Alone we seek help.
Guide us onto the straight Path.
The Path of those whom You rewarded. Not of those condemned by You nor of those who went astray.
ALIF, LĀM, MĪM.
This is the Book, in which there is not the slightest doubt. Guidance for the Muttaqīn.
Those who believe in the unseen and establish Salat and spend out of what We have given them.
And those who believe in what has been sent to you and that sent before you and are sure of the Ākhirah.
It is they who are truly guided by their Rabb and it is they who are successful.
As for those who disbelieve, it makes no difference to them whether you warn them or not, they will not believe.
Allah has set a seal on their hearts and their hearing, and on their eyes is a veil. And for them is a great punishment.
And of people there are some who say, "We believe in Allah and in the Ākhirah". But they do not really believe.
They deceive Allah and those who believe. But they deceive none except themselves, and they perceive it not.
In their hearts is a disease and Allah has increased their disease. And grievous is their punishment because of their persistent lying.
And when they are told: "Do not make mischief on the earth". They answer: "We are only improving things".
They are, without doubt, mischief mongers. But they realise not.
And when they are told: "Believe the way others believe", they cynically reply: "Should we be- lieve as the fools believe?" Indeed it is they who are the fools, but they know not.
And when they meet those who believe, they assert: "We believe". But when alone with their devils, they say: "We are actually making fun"
Allah (in return) mocks them and allows them to wander blindly in their transgression.
It is they who have traded guidance for error, but neither their trade has brought them gain, nor have they found guidance.
They are like the one who kindled a fire and as soon as it lit up his surroundings, Allah took away their light and left them in utter darkness, wherein they cannot see.
Deaf, dumb and blind, they will not turn back.

Or it is like a rain laden cloud from the sky, in it is darkness, thunder and lightning. They press their fingers into their ears to block out the thunderclap, in terror of death. And Allah surrounds the non-believers.

The lightning almost takes away their sight. Whenever it gives them light, they walk therein, but when darkness grows on them they stand still. And if Allah so willed, He could take away their faculty of hearing and seeing. Indeed Allah has power over everything.
O mankind! Worship your Rabb, Who created you and those before you, so that you may remain conscious of Him.
Who has made the earth your carpet and the sky a canopy and has sent down rain from the sky and with it, has brought forth fruits for your sustenance. So do not, knowingly, set up rivals with Allah.
And if you doubt what We have revealed to Our servant, then produce a Sūrah of this merit and call your helpers beside Allah, if you are truthful.
But if you cannot and most certainly you cannot, then beware of the Fire, whose fuel is men and stones, prepared for those who do not believe.

And give good news to those who embrace faith and act righteously, that, for them are Paradise, be- neath which streams flow. Every time they are given its fruit to eat, they exclaim, "We have received this before!" For, they will be given things resembling. For them will be spouses pure. And therein they will live forever.

Allah does not mind to quote the example of even a gnat or any- thing lesser. Believers know that it is the truth from their Rabb. But those who do not believe say, "What does Allah mean by such an example?" By this He causes many to go astray and guides many. Yet He causes none to stray except the evildoers.
Those who break their solemn promise with Allah after its con- firmation. And break what Allah has ordered to be joined and make mischief on earth. It is they who are the losers.

How can you refuse to acknowledge Allah, seeing that He gave you life, when you were lifeless. Then He will cause you to die and will give you life again. And to Him you shall ultimately be brought back.
It is He Who has created for you all that is in the earth, then He ap- plied His design to the heavens and balanced them into seven heavens. And He has the perfect knowledge of all things.

And when your Rabb addressed the angels, "Indeed I am placing a Deputy on earth". They said, "Would You place one who will spread corruption therein and shed blood? While we glorify You with Your praise and proclaim Your Holiness". He replied, "I know that which you do not know".
And He imparted to Adam the names of all things. Then He placed them before the angels and said, "Tell Me their names if you are right".
They said, "Glory be to You! We have no knowledge, except that which You have given us. Indeed You are All-Knowing, Most Wise".
He said, "O Adam! Tell them their names". As soon as he had
And when We commanded the angels, "Do Sajdah before Adam", they all fell in Sajdah except Satan. He refused and was arrogant and was of those who deny the truth.
We said, "O Adam! Dwell you and your wife in Paradise and eat freely whatever you wish, but do not approach this tree, lest you become wrong-doers".
Then Satan caused them to stumble therein and brought them out of their abode. And We said, "Get down, some of you as enemies of others. On earth is your stay and livelihood for a while".
Then Adam learnt some words from his Rabb and He accepted his repentance. No doubt He is Ever-Relenting, Most Merciful.
We said, "Get down all of you from here. There shall, nonetheless, come to you guidance from Me, and whosoever follows My guidance shall neither fear nor grieve.
But those who disbelieve and belie our Signs, they are the dwell-
O Children of Isrāīl! Remember My favour bestowed upon you and fulfil your promise with Me, whereupon I shall fulfil My promise with you. And of Me stand in awe.
And believe in what I reveal, confirming what you already have, and do not be the first to deny it. Nor sell My Ayāt for a trifling gain and of Me remain conscious.
And do not cover Truth with falsehood, nor knowingly conceal the Truth.
And establish Şalāt, and pay Zakāt and bow down with those who bow down (in worship).
Do you enjoin people to be good and forget your own selves, yet you read the Book? Will you not understand?
And seek Allah's help through patience and Şalāt. It is indeed difficult save for the humble.
Those who are convinced that they shall meet their Rabb, and unto Him they shall return.
O Children of Isrāil! Remember My favour bestowed upon you, how I exalted you above others.
And be mindful of the Day, when no soul shall, in any way, avail another, neither shall any intercession be accepted, nor shall any compensation be taken from anyone, nor shall they be helped.
And when We delivered you from Pharaoh's folk, who tormented you dreadfully, slaying your sons and sparing your women. And therein was a tremendous trial from your Rabb.
And We parted for you the sea, rescued you and drowned the folk of Pharaoh and you witnessed it.
And We appointed forty nights for Musa. And in his absence you took the calf (for worship). And you were the transgressors.
Even after that We pardoned you to give you a chance of being grateful.
And when We gave Musa the Book and the Criterion, so that you are led aright.

And when Musa said to his people, "O my people! You have indeed wronged yourselves by worshipping the calf, so be penitent before your Rabb and kill yourselves, this is better for you in the sight of your Rabb ". Then He forgave you, for He is Ever Forgiving, Most Merciful.
And when you said, "O Musa! We shall not believe you, unless we see Allah openly". So the thunderbolt seized you and you were witnessing.
Then We gave you life after your death, in order that you might become grateful.
And We caused the cloud to provide you shade and sent down Manna and the Quails for you. "Eat of the pure things that We have provided you". They did no harm to Us, but harmed only themselves.
And when We said "Enter this town and eat at pleasure, and enter the gate prostrating and say 'Hittatun', We shall overlook your faults and further reward those who do good".
But the transgressors changed the word taught to them with another, so We brought down on them a calamity from the Heaven, for their (repeated) evil acts.

And when Mūsa asked for water for his people. We said, "Strike the rock with your staff". There gushed forth twelve springs from it. Each group knew its drinking point. Eat and drink from the provisions of Allah and do not make mischief on the earth.

And when you said, "O Musa! We cannot (always) endure one type of food, so ask your Rabb, to bring forth for us what the earth grows, its vegetables, its cucumbers, its garlic, its lentils and its onions". He said, "Would you exchange the better for the worse? Go down to any town and there you shall find what you ask for”. Humiliation and misery befell them and they were surrounded by the wrath of Allah. That was because they (repeatedly) denied His Signs and wrongfully slew the Prophets. That was for their defiance and (continued) transgression.

Those who believe (in the Quran) and those who are Jews and the Christians and the Sabā'īn; those who believe in Allah and the Last Day and do good works, their reward is with their Rabb. On them shall be no fear nor shall they grieve. The quran says that the prophet of Jesus and the Christians and the Sabā'īn are Jews and the Christians and the Sabā'īn; those who believe in Allah and the Last Day and do good works, their reward is with their Rabb. On them shall be no fear nor shall they grieve.

And when We took a pledge from you and raised Tūr over you, (saying) "Hold fast that which We have given you and remember what is therein so that you may observe Taqwa" And when We took a pledge from you and raised Tūr over you, (saying) "Hold fast that which We have given you and remember what is therein so that you may observe Taqwa"

And even after that you turned away. Had it not been for the Grace and Mercy of Allah, you would have been amongst the losers for sure. And even after that you turned away. Had it not been for the Grace and Mercy of Allah, you would have been amongst the losers for sure.
And you very well knew those of you, who transgressed in respect of Sabbath. So We said to them, "Be you apes, despised and rejected".
And We made this an example for their time and their posterity and a lesson for the Muttaqin.
And when Musa said to his people, " Allah commands you to slaughter a cow". They said, "Are you making fun of us?" He said, " Allah save me from being an ignorant".
They said, "Pray to your Rabb, on our behalf to make clear to us what it is?" He said, "He says: the cow should neither be old nor too young, but of middle age. Now do what you are commanded".
They said, "Pray to your Rabb on our behalf, to make clear to us, of what colour should it be?" He said, "He says: it is a yellow cow, bright in colour, pleasing the on-lookers".
They said, "Pray to your Rabb on our behalf, to tell us more about it, because all cows appear alike to us. Allah willing, we shall then be rightly guided".

He said, "He says: a cow un-yoked, neither tills the soil nor waters the fields, perfect, without any flaw". They said, "Now you have told us exactly". Then they sacrificed her, although they had no intention to do so.
And when you killed a man and disputed about it. But Allah was to bring forth what you were concealing.
So We said, "Strike him with a piece (of the cow)". Thus Allah brings the dead to life and shows you His signs, so that you may understand.

Thereafter, your hearts hardened like a rock or even harder. For among rocks there are some, from which streams gush forth. Others split apart and water flows out of them, yet others, which fall down for fear of Allah. And Allah is not unaware of what you do.
Do you (O believers) hope that, they will believe in you, when a group of them used to hear the Word of Allah and having understood it, used to change it intentionally?

And when they meet the believers, they say, "We believe", but when they meet each other in private, they say, "would you tell them what Allah has disclosed to you, so that they could use it to argue with you before your Rabb? Have you no sense?
Don't they know that Allah knows what they conceal and what they reveal?
And among them are the illiterates, who have no knowledge of the Book but their own fantasies, and they only guess.

So woe to those who write the Book with their own hands and then say, "This is from Allah ", in order that they could trade it for a petty price. So woe to them for what their hands write and woe to them for what they earn with it.
And they say, "the Fire will not touch us but for a few numbered days". Say, "Have you taken a promise from Allah? For Allah never breaks His promise. Or do you say about Allah what you know not?
But whosoever does evil and his sins surround him, they are the dwellers of the Fire. They will abide therein for ever.
And those who believe and do righteous acts, they are the dwellers of the Paradise. Therein will they abide forever.

And when We took the Covenant from the Children of Isrāīl: worship none but Allah, be good to parents, the kindred, the orphans and the needy, and speak kindly to people and establish Şalāt and give Zakāt. Then you turned back, except a few among you and you were averse.
And when We took your Covenant: Do not shed each other's blood, nor drive your own people out of your habitations. Then you ratified and (to this) you were witness.

Yet you are the ones who kill each other and drive some of your own people out of their home, you help (the enemy) with sin and transgression against your own people; and if they come to you as cap- tives you ransom them, whereas their expulsion, in itself, was unlawful for you. Is it that you believe some part of the Book and disbelieve the other? And what should be the reward of those of you who do so, except disgrace in this life? And on the Day of Qiyamah they will be consigned to the severest punishment. And Al-lah is not unmindful of what you do.
They are the people who have traded the life of this world at the price of Ākhirah. Neither their punishment would be lightened nor will they be helped.

We gave Mūsā the Book and sent a chain of Messengers after him. And we gave ‘Īsā, son of Maryam manifest signs and strengthened him with the Holy Spirit. Is it that whenever a Messenger comes to you with something that you do not desire, you become arrogant? Some of them you refute, while others you kill.
And they say, "Our hearts are wrapped". Infact Allah has cursed them for their disbelief. So, it is very little that they believe.

And when a Book from Allah comes to them, confirming that which is with them, although, before this, they used to pray for victory over the non-believers. But when there comes to them, that which they recognize (to be true), they refuse to believe it. So the curse of Allah is on the non-believers.

Miserable is the price for which they have sold their souls that they disbelieve what Allah has revealed, grudging that Allah, in His Grace, has revealed to any of His servants He liked. They have drawn wrath upon wrath. And for the non-believers is a humiliating punishment.
And when it is said to them, "Believe in what Allah has revealed"
And Musa came to you with clear signs, yet you worshipped the calf in his absence and you were the wrongdoers.

And when We made a pact with you and raised the Tūr over you, (Saying): "Hold fast that which We have given you and listen". They said, "We listen and we disobey". (The love of) the calf permeated their hearts because of their disbelief. Say, "Evil indeed are the dictates of your faith, if you have any".
Say, "If the home in Ākhirah with Allah is exclusively for you and no one else, then ask for death in case you are truthful".
But they will never ask for it, because of what their hands have sent before them. And Allah is well aware of the wrongdoers.

You shall indeed find them, out of all people, most greedy for life, even greedier than the polytheist. Each one of them longs to live for a thousand years. Even such a long life will not save him from the punishment. For Allah sees all that they do.
Say, "Who is an enemy to Jibrīl! For he brings down (revelation) to your Qalb by Allah's leave, a confirmation of what was (revealed) before, a guidance and good news for the believers".
Who is an enemy of Allah and His Angels and His Messengers and Jibrīl and Mikāīl, so Allah is an enemy of the non-believers.
We have sent to you clear Āyāt and none but the Fāsiqīn reject them.
Is it not that every time they make a promise, a party of them set it aside? In fact, most of them do not believe.
And whenever came to them a Messenger from Allah, confirming what they already had, a party of People of the Book flung the Book of Allah behind their backs, as if they did not know.

And they followed what the devils recited in Sulaimān's kingdom. It is not that Sulaimān did disbelief but the devils indulged in disbelief teaching people magic and that, which was revealed to the two Angels Hārūt and Mārūt at Babul. But the two (angels) did not teach anyone without warning, "We are only a test, so do not indulge in disbelief." And from them, people learnt that which caused separation between husband and wife. But they could thus harm none except by Allah's leave. And they learnt that which harmed them and not what benefited them. And they knew for sure that such traders shall have no share in the Ākhirah. And evil was the price for which they sold their souls, if they only knew!
And if they had believed and guarded themselves from evil, they would have got a far better reward from Allah, if they only knew!
O you who believe! Do not say, (to the Prophet) Rā'ina (Listen to us) but say, Unzuma (Look upon us), and listen carefully; and for the non-believers is a painful punishment.

Neither the non-believers among the People of the Book, nor the polytheists want that anything good may come to you from your Rabb. But Allah favours with His Mercy whom He pleases and Al-lah's Grace is Infinite.
Such of Our Revelations that We abrogate or cause to be forgotten, We substitute with better or similar ones. Do you not know that Allah has power over everything?
Do you not know that, to Allah belongs the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth? And for you there is no friend or helper besides Allah.
Do you want to question your Messenger, as Mūsa was questioned aforetime? And whosoever trades disbelief for faith, has indeed strayed from the right path.

Many of the People of the Book wish, that they turn you back to disbelief after your faith, even after the truth has become manifest to them. So forgive and overlook, till Allah brings about His Command. Indeed Allah has power over all things.
And establish Şalāt and give Zakāt. And whatever good you send forth for your souls, you will find it with Allah. For Allah observes all that you do.
And they say, "None except the Jews and the Christians shall enter Paradise", this is their thinking, Say, "Produce your proof if you are truthful".
Yes, any one who surrenders his will and purpose to Allah and does good, his reward is with his Rabb. Such shall neither fear, nor grieve.

The Jews assert, "The Christians have no valid grounds for their beliefs," and the Christians say, "The Jews have no valid grounds for their beliefs," and both quote the Book. Even those devoid of knowledge speak like this. But Allah will judge between them, in their differences, on the Day of Judgement.

And who is more wicked than the one, who forbids celebration of Allah's Name, in the places of His worship and strives for their ru-ination? Although such have no right to enter there except in fear. For them is disgrace in this world and a grave punishment in the Hereafter.
To Allah belong the East and the West. Wherever you turn, there is Allah's Countenance, for Allah is Infinite, All-Knowing.
And they say, " Allah has begotten a son." Be He glorified! No, but all that is in the heavens and the earth is His. Everything is subservient to Him.
The Originator of the heavens and the earth! When He decrees a thing, He says, "Be." And it is.

And those who are without knowledge say, "Why does Allah not speak to us or why does a sign not come to us?" People aforetime also spoke like this. Their hearts are all alike. We have indeed made Our revelations clear, for those who (firmly) believe.
Indeed We have sent you with the Truth, a bearer of good news and a warner. And you will not be asked about the dwellers of the Fire.

The Jews and the Christians will never be pleased with you, until you follow their creed. Say, " Allah's guidance is the only true guidance". And if you follow their desires after the knowledge has come to you, you will have none to protect you from Allah or help you.
Those to whom We have given the Book, read it in earnest. They are the ones who believe in it, and those who reject it, they are the losers.
O Children of Isrāīl! Remember My favour I bestowed upon you and how I exalted you above all.
And be mindful of the Day, when no soul shall, in any way, avail another, neither shall any compensation be accepted from it, nor shall any intercession benefit it. And they shall not be helped.

And when Ibrāhīm was put to test by his Rabb with certain commands, he fulfilled them. He said, "I shall appoint you the leader of mankind." He inquired, "And also from my offspring?" He answered, "My promise does not extend to the evil-doers."

And We made the House a place of assembly for people and a place of peace. Take the station of Ibrāhīm as a place of worship. And We commanded Ibrāhīm and Ismā'īl, to purify Our House for those who go around it and those who meditate and those who bow and do Sajdah.

And when Ibrāhīm said, "O my Rabb! Make it a City of Peace and provide its dwellers who believe in Allah and the Ākhirah with fruits." He answered, " I shall let those who indulge in disbelief, enjoy for a while. But in the end shall drive them to the torment of Fire. And an awful destination!"
And when Ibrāhīm was raising the foundations of the House, with Ismā'īl they prayed, "O our Rabb! Accept (this service) from us. You Alone are All-Hearing, All-Knowing."
"O Rabb! Make us Muslims, and make a community out of our offspring who are Muslims. And show us our ways of worship and accept our repentance. Indeed You are the Ever-Forgiving, the Most Merciful."
"O our Rabb! Raise among them a Messenger of their own, who shall convey to them Your Messages, and teach them the Book and wisdom and purify them. Indeed You Alone are the Mighty, the Wise."
And who turns away from the religion of Ibrāhīm, save the one who befools himself? Certainly We chose him in this world, and he will be among the righteous in the Ākhirah.
When his Rabb said to him "Surrender," he said, "I surrender myself to the Rabb of the Universe."
And Ibrāhīm enjoined this upon his sons and so did Y'aqūb: "O my sons! Allah has chosen the Dīn for you, so do not die except as Muslims."

Did you witness Y’aqūb’s hour of death? When he said to his sons, "Whom will you worship after I am gone?" They answered, "We shall worship your Ilāha, the Ilāha of your fathers Ibrāhīm and Ismā’īl and Ishaq, the Only Ilāha! And to Him do we surrender."
These are the people who have gone by. For them is what they earned and for you is what you have earned. And you will not be asked about what they used to do.
And they say, "Become Jews or Christians, you will be guided". Say, "No! (We follow) the religion of Ibrāhīm the upright. And he was not among the polytheists."

Say, "We believe in Allah and the revelation given to us and to Ibrāhīm, Ismā'īl, Ishāq, Y'aqūb and their tribes and that given to Mūsā and 'Isa, and given to the other Prophets from their Rabb. We make no distinction between any of them. And to Him do we surrender."

So if they believe, as you have believed, then they are rightly guided. But if they turn away, then it is they who are in the wrong, Allah will suffice you against them and He Alone is the All-Hearing and the All-Knowing.
(Say) The colour of Allah, and whose colour is better than Allah's? And Him Alone do, we worship.
“Do you dispute with us about Allah, when He is our Rabb and your Rabb? For us are our works and for you are yours. And to Him alone do we devote ourselves."

Do you say that Ibrahim, Isma’il, Ishaq, Y’aqub and their descendants were Jews or Christians? Say, “Do you know more than Allah?” And who is more unjust than the one who conceals the evidence given to him by Allah? And Allah is not unaware of what you do.
These are the people who have gone by. For them is what they earned and for you is what you have earned. And you will not be asked about what they used to do.
Presently the foolish among the people will say, "What has turned them from their previous Qiblah?" Say, "To Allah belong the East and the West. He guides whom He will to the straight path."

Thus We have made you a balanced Ummah, so that you be witnesses over mankind, and the Messenger be a witness over you. And We did not appoint the Qiblah, which you had, but only to differentiate the one who follows the Messenger, from the one who turns back on his heels. Indeed it was hard except for those whom Allah guided. And Allah would never lay waste your faith. For Al-lah is Kind, Most Merciful to mankind.

We see the turning of your face towards the Heaven (for guidance). Now We shall turn you towards the Qiblah that you desire. Then turn your face in the direction of the Sacred Mosque. And wherever you be, turn your faces in its direction. Those who have been given the Book, surely know this to be the truth from their Rabb. And Allah is not unaware of what they do.

Even if you place all evidence before the People of the Book, they will not follow your Qiblah, nor can you follow their Qiblah. Nor indeed will they follow each other's Qiblah. And if you follow their vain desires, after the knowledge has come to you, then you shall surely be among the unjust.
Those, to whom We have given the Book, recognise this as they recognise their own sons. But some of them knowingly conceal the Truth.
The Truth is from your Rabb! So do not be among the doubters.
Every community faces a direction of its own. So compete with each other in virtue. Wherever you may be, Allah will bring you all together, for Allah has power over all things.
And from wherever you come forth, turn your face towards the Sacred Mosque. No doubt it is the truth from your Rabb, and Allah is not unaware of what you do.

And from wherever you come forth, turn your face towards the Sacred Mosque; and wherever you may be turn your face towards it, lest there should be with people an argument against you except those of them who transgress; so do not fear them, but fear Me, so that I may perfect My favour upon you and that you may remain rightly guided.
Even as We have sent unto you a Messenger, who recites Our Āyāt to you, purifies you, and teaches you the Book and wisdom, and teaches you that which you did not know.
So remember Me, I shall remember you. Give thanks to Me and do not be ungrateful to Me.
O you who believe! Seek help through patience and Şalāt. Indeed Allah is with the steadfast.
And do not speak of those killed in the way of Allah as dead. No, they are alive but you do not perceive.
And We shall surely test you with something of fear and hunger, and loss of goods, lives and fruits, and give glad tidings to those who bear with patience.
Who say, when a calamity befalls them, "Surely we are Allah's and surely to Him shall we return".
They are those on whom are the blessings of their Rabb and His Mercy, and they are the ones rightly guided.

Indeed Şafa and Marwa are among the symbols of Allah. So there is no sin on the one who performs Hajj or 'Umrah to go inbetween them. If any one does good of his own accord, then surely ' Allah is Appreciative, Knowing.
Surely those who conceal the evidence and the guidance that We have revealed, after We have made it clear to mankind in the Book, they are cursed by Allah and the ones cursed by the cursors.
Except those who repent and make amends and make known (the Truth). To them I relent, for I am Merciful.
Those who disbelieve and die as non-believers, on them is the curse of Allah, and of the angels and of all mankind.
They shall remain in it forever. Neither shall their punishment be lightened, nor would they be granted any respite.
Your Ilāha is the only Ilāha. There is no Ilāha but He, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

Indeed in the creation of the heavens and the earth, and in the alternation of night and day, and in the ships sailing upon the ocean laden with what profits mankind, and in the water which Allah sends down from the heavens, thereby reviving the earth after its death, and in all species of beasts that He scatters through it, and in the change of the winds, and in the clouds harnessed between the heavens and the earth; (those) are signs for people who are wise.

And some people take for worship others besides Allah, loving them as they should love Allah. And those who believe love Allah passionately. If only the unjust saw now what they shall see when they see the punishment; that surely all power belongs to Allah. And Allah is severe in requital.
When those who were followed will disown those who followed them and they would witness the punishment and all their relations would be cut off.

And the followers would say, "If we could possibly return, we would disown them as they have disowned us." Thus will Allah show them their deeds as bitter regrets. And they shall never get out of the Fire.
O Mankind! Eat of that which is permissible and pure on the earth, and do not follow the footsteps of the Satan. Indeed he is your enemy.
He only commands you to do what is evil and obscene and to say about Allah what you do not know.
And when they are told, "Follow that which Allah has revealed," they say, "Nay, we shall follow that on which we found our fathers", even though their fathers were void of wisdom and guidance?
The example of the non-believers is like the one who calls out to something which hears nothing except a shout and a cry. Deaf, dumb and blind, so they have no sense.
You who believe! Eat of the pure things that We have provided you. And be grateful to Allah, if it is Him indeed that you worship.

He has only declared prohibited on you dead animals and blood and pork, and that on which any other name besides Allah's is invoked. However, there is no sin upon the one driven by necessity, neither being deliberately disobedient nor transgressing. Surely, Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

As for those who conceal what Allah has revealed in the Book, and purchase a petty gain, they fill their bellies with nothing but fire. Allah shall neither speak to them on Yaum-al-Qiyamah, nor purify them, and for them shall be a painful punishment.
They are the ones who trade error for guidance, and torment for forgiveness. What boldness in facing the Fire!
That shall be because Allah has surely revealed the Book with truth, and those who dispute the Book are in wide schism.

Virtue is not in turning your faces towards East or West, but truly virtuous is the one who believes in Allah and the Last Day and the Angels and the Book and the Prophets, and gives his wealth for His love to relatives and orphans and the needy and the wayfarers and beggars and for the liberation of the slaves, and establishes Şalāt and gives Zakāt; and (those who) fulfil their promises after making them, and remain firm during hardships and adversity and at the time of crisis. Such are the people of truth and such are the God-fearing.

O you who believe! Qişāş is prescribed for you in cases of murder. Free for the free, slave for the slave and female for the female. And if any remission is made by his brother (the other party), it should be adhered to with fairness and payment be made with gratitude. This is a concession and a Mercy from your Rabb. And whoso exceeds the limits after this, shall have a painful punishment.
And in the Qiṣāṣ, there is life for you, O men of understanding, so that you may adopt Taqwa.
It is prescribed for you that when death approaches any of you, and he is leaving behind much wealth, he should bequeath it to his parents and kindred equitably, a duty on the righteous.
Then whosoever changes it after hearing it, then its sin shall be on those who alter it. Indeed Allah hears and knows everything.
But if anyone fears a mistake or a sin from the testator, and brings about a settlement between them (parties), on him there is no sin. For Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
O you who believe! Fasting is ordained for you, as it was ordained for those before you, so that you may acquire self-restraint.

A fixed number of days! But if any of you is sick or on a journey, for him is the like number from other days. And for those who face hardships is redemption: the feeding of a poor man. But whoever does good of his own accord, it is better for him. And it

Ramadhān is the month in which the Qurān was revealed: guidance for mankind, an open proof of guidance and a Criterion. So whoever is present in that month shall fast. But whosever is sick or on a journey, (is to fast for) the like number from other days. Allah desires ease and does not desire hardship for you, so you shall complete the number and shall extol Allah for having guided you, and that you may be thankful.
And when My servants ask you about Me, I am indeed close. I respond to the call of every suppliant when he calls Me, so let them hear Me and believe in Me, so that they are led aright.

Love making with your women on the night of the fast, is allowed to you. They are your garments and you are a garment for them. Allah knows that you were deceiving yourselves. So He relented to you and forgave you. So new (you may) associate with nem and seek what Allah has ordained for you. And eat and drink until the white streak of dawn becomes distinct to you from the darkness of night. Then complete the fast till nightfall. And do not approach them while you are retreating in the mosques. These are the limits set by Allah, so do not approach them. Thus Allah explains His revelations to mankind so that they may acquire Taqwa.
And do not unjustly eat up one another's property, nor use it as bait for the judges, to devour a part of other people's riches.

They ask you about new moons. Say, "They are time-marks for mankind and for Hajj." And it is no virtue that you enter your houses from the rear. But truly virtuous is the one who exercises Taqwa. So enter the houses by their doors. And fear Allah, so that you may succeed.
Fight in the cause of Allah, against those who fight you. But do not step beyond the limits of law, for Allah does not love the transgressors.

And kill them wherever you find them and expel them from wherefrom they expelled you, for militancy is worse than killing. But do not fight them near the Sacred Mosque, unless they fight you therein. But if they fight you, then kill them. Such is the reward of the non-believers.
But if they desist, then surely Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
And fight them until there is no more militancy and the Din is of Allah. But if they desist, let there be no hostility except against the wrongdoers.

The sacred month is for the sacred month, and all sacredness is reciprocal. But if any one is violent against you, you offer violence likewise against him. And fear Allah and know that Allah is with those who observe Taqwa.
And spend in the way of Allah, and do not ruin yourself with your own hands. And do good, surely Allah loves those who do good.

Perform Hajj and 'Umrah for Allah. And if you are prevented, then send a sacrificial animal you can easily afford. And do not shave your heads till the offering has reached the destination. But if any of you is sick or has an ailment in his head, the ransom is by fasting or alms or sacrifice. If any one wants to combine 'Umrah with Hajj in peaceful conditions, he should sacrifice an animal that he can afford. And if he cannot afford, then he should fast three days during the Hajj and seven days on return. That is ten in all. This is for him whose family does not dwell near the Sacred Mosque. And fear Allah and know that, Allah is stern in punishment.

The months of Hajj are well known. So whoever undertakes this duty should refrain from lewdness, wickedness and quarrel during Hajj. And whatever good you do, Allah knows it. And take provisions for the journey. Surely, the best of provision is Taqwa. So fear Me, O people of understanding!
It is no sin for you to seek the Grace of your Rabb by trading (during Hajj). So when you return from 'Arafat, perform Allah's Zikr near the Sacred Monument. And remember Him as He has
Then return from the place whence the other people return. And ask Allah's Forgiveness. Indeed Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

And when you have completed your rites, do Zikr of Allah as you used to do Zikr of your fathers, rather this Zikr should be much more intense. And so there are people who say, "O our Rabb! Give us in this world", and they have no share in the Akhirah.
And there are some who pray, "O our Rabb! Give us the good in this world and the good in the Akhirah and save us from the torment of the Fire."
For such is the share of what they have earned, and Allah is swift at reckoning.

And remember Allah during the appointed days. Then whoever hastens away in two days, on him is no sin. And whoever stays on, there is no sin on him either, provided Taqwa is observed. Fear Allah and know that you shall surely be gathered unto Him.
And among people there is one whose discourse about the life of this world may impress you, and he cites Allah as Witness to what
And when he turns away, he speeds through the land to make mischief therein and to destroy the human civilization. And Allah does not approve mischief.
And when he is told, "Fear Allah ", his false pride drives him to crime. Hell is enough for him and an ill resort indeed!
And there is a type of person who would sell himself to earn the Pleasure of Allah. And Allah is Most Kind to His servants.
O you who believe! Enter Islam completely, and do not follow the footsteps of the Satan, for he is your enemy.
And if you waver after the clear proofs have reached you, then know that Allah is indeed Mighty, Wise.
Are they only waiting that Allah should come to them in the shadows of the clouds, and also the angels, and the matter is decided? And to Allah are all matters brought back.
Ask the Children of Isrāīl, how many clear signs We gave them. And if any one changes the favour of Allah, after it has come to him, then Allah indeed is severe in punishment.

The life of this world is made alluring for the non-believers. And they scoff at those who believe. But the Muttaqīn will be above them on Yaum-al-Qiyamah. And Allah provides subsistence, without measure, to whom He wills.

Mankind was one community. So Allah raised Prophets as bearers of glad tidings and as warners, and sent with them the Book with truth, to decide between people respecting what they differed in. And none other than those to whom it had been given disputed it due to mutual spite, even after the clear proofs had come to them. So Allah, by His Grace guided the believers to the truth of the matter in which they differed. Allah guides whom He will to the straight path.

Do you think that you shall enter Paradise, while that which came to those before you has not yet come to you? They encountered adversity and distress, and were so shaken that the Prophet and the believers with him exclaimed, "Where is Allah's Help?" Surely Allah's Help is near.

They ask you, how will they spend? Say, "Whatever you spend of wealth, let it be for parents and kindred, and the orphans and the needy and the wayfarer. Fighting has been ordained for you, though you dislike it. And it is possible that you dislike a thing and that is good for you and you like a thing and that is bad for you. Allah knows and you do not know.

They ask you about fighting in the prohibited month. Say, "Fighting in it is heinous. But hindering people from the way of Allah, and disbelieving Him, and in the sanctity of the Sacred Mosque, and expelling its dwellers therefrom, are grave (offences) with Allah. And militancy is worse than bloodshed." They will not stop fighting you till they turn you back from your religion, if they could. And anyone who renounces his religion and dies a
Of course those who believed and those who emigrated and did Jihād in the way of Allah, they hope for the Mercy of Allah. And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

They ask you about intoxicants and gambling. Say, "There is great sin in both, and some benefit for people. But the sin is greater than their benefit." And they ask you, as to what shall they spend? Say, "Whatever you can spare." Thus Allah explains His Āyāt to you, so that you may reflect

On this world and the Ākhirah. And they ask you of orphans. Say, "Their betterment is good, and if you mix them with you, they are your brothers. Allah knows the miscreant from the reformer. Had Allah desired, He could have put you in difficulty. Indeed Allah is Most Powerful, Wise."

Do not marry polytheist women until they believe. A believing slave woman is better than a polytheist, even though she attracts you. And do not marry (your women to) polytheist men until they accept faith. A believer slave is better than a polytheist, even though he pleases you. They call you to the Fire, while Allah calls you towards the Paradise and towards forgiveness, by His Grace. And Allah explains His Āyat to the people so that they may pay heed.

And they ask you about menstruation. Say, "It is a pollution, so keep away from women during menstruation. And do not draw near them until they are clean. But when they have cleansed themselves, go in unto them as enjoined by Allah." Indeed Allah loves those who turn to Him in repentance and those who remain clean.

Your women are tillage for you, so go to your tillage, as you like. And give good news (good deeds) before you for your souls. And remain conscious of Allah and know that you are to meet Him. And give good news to the believers.
And make not your oaths in the name of Allah impediments to virtue, righteousness and promotion of peace among people. And Allah hears and knows everything.
Allah will not take you to task for your thoughtless oaths. But He will call you to account for the intentions in your hearts. And Allah is oft Forgiving, Most Forbearing.
Those who swear to abstain from their wives, have four months of grace. If they return, then Allah is Forgiving, Most Merciful.
And if they resolve a divorce, then Allah is Hearer and Knower.

The divorced women shall withhold themselves for three monthly courses. And it is not legitimate for them to conceal what Allah may have created in their wombs, if they believe in Allah and the Last Day. And their husbands have 'a greater right to take them back in that period, if they desire reconciliation. And they have similar rights (over men) as they have over them according to rules. And men are a degree above them.

Divorce is twice. Thereafter, she is either retained honourably or released kindly. And it is not legitimate for you to take away whatever you have given them, except when both fear that they may not be able to observe the limits set by Allah. And if you fear that both may not be able to observe the limits set by Allah, then there is no blame on any of them for that with which she redeems herself. These are the bounds defined by Allah, so do not trespass them. And whosever crosses the limits set by Allah, then it is they who are wrongdoers.

If he divorces her finally, she is not lawful for him, until she marries another man and he also divorces her. Then there is no blame on them if they reunite, provided they feel that they shall be able to keep the limits ordained by Allah. And these are the limits of Allah, which He explains for people who know.

And when you have divorced your women and they have spent their waiting-term, then either retain them honourably (before expiry), or release them kindly. And do not retain them to their hurt so that you may take undue advantage. Whoever does this surely wrongs his soul. Do not hold Allah's Commands in mockery, and remember Allah's Favours on you, and that He has sent down upon you the Book and wisdom, by which He admonishes you. And remain conscious of Allah and know that surely Allah has full knowledge of everything.

And when you have divorced your women and they have completed their waiting term, do not prevent them from marrying their husbands, if they mutually agreed in a fair manner. This is an admonition for every one of you who believes in Allah and the Last Day. This is the most virtuous and the cleanest (course) for you. And Allah knows and you do not know.

And the mothers shall suckle their children for two whole years, this is for him who intends to complete the period of suckling. And on him (the father) is the mother's provision and clothing in a fair manner. No soul shall be burdened beyond its capacity. Neither shall a mother be made to suffer because of her child, nor a father on account of his child. And the same duty shall devolve on the heirs (of the father). So if both desire weaning by consent and mutual counsel, there is no blame on them. And if you decide on a foster-mother there is no blame on you, provided you pay her the agreed (wages) honourably. And remain conscious of Allah and know that He sees all that you do.

And as for those who die and leave behind widows, they shall keep themselves in waiting for four months and ten days. Thereafter, there is no blame on you for what they do with themselves honourably. And Allah is aware of whatever you do.

And there is no blame on you if you propose indirectly to those women, or conceal it in your souls. Allah knows that you will soon make a mention to them. But make no promise in secret with them, except that you mention in an honourable manner. And do not resolve on wedding before the prescribed waiting-term is completed. And know that Allah knows what is in your souls, so be mindful of Him. And know that Allah is Ever-Forgiving, Most Forbearing.
