And let them not turn you aside from the Signs of Allah after they have been sent down unto you. And call you mankind to your Rabb, and do not be you of the associators.
And do not invoke you any other god along with Allah. There is no god but He. Perishable is everything save His Countenance. His is the judgement, and to Him you all shall be returned.
Alif Lām Mīm.
Do people think that they shall be left alone because they say: We believe; and that they shall not be tested?
And assuredly We have tested those who were before them. So Allah will surely know those who are true and will surely know the liars.
Or those who work ill-deeds think that they will outstrip Us? Evil do they judge!
Whoever hopes for the meeting with Allah, then Allah's term is surely coming, and He is the Hearer, the Knower.
And whoever strives, strives only for himself, verily Allah is independent of the worlds.
And whoever believes and works righteous deeds, We shall purge away the evil deeds from them. And shall recompense them the best of what they have been working.

And We have enjoined on man kindness to parents, but if they strive to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them; To Me is your return, and I shall declare to you what you have been doing.
And those who believe and work righteous deeds - We shall surely make them enter among the righteous.

Of mankind are some who say: We believe in Allah, then if they are afflicted in the way of Allah, they take the persecution of men as the torment of Allah, and then, if succour comes from your Rabb they say: Verily we have been with you. Is not Allah the Best Knower of what is in the breasts of the creatures?
And surely Allah will come to know those who believe, and surely He will come to know the hypocrites.
And those who disbelieve say to those who believe: "Follow our way, and we shall surely bear your sins; whereas they shall not bear anything of their sins; verily they are liars."
And assuredly they shall be questioned on the Day of Resurrection concerning what they used to fabricate.
And assuredly We sent Nūḥ to his people. Then he stayed among them for a thousand years save fifty years; and then the Deluge overtook them, while they were wrongdoers.
Then We delivered him and those with him in the Ark, and made it a Sign to the worlds.
And We sent Ibrāhīm. Recall when he said to his people: Worship Allah and fear Him, that is best for you if you but know.

You worship only images instead of Allah, and it is a fiction you have created. Verily those whom you worship instead of Allah own no provision for you. So seek provision with Allah and worship Him, and to Him give thanks; to Him you shall be returned.
And if you believe me, then communities before you have belied; and nothing is upon the Messenger but a manifest preaching.
Do they not see how Allah originates creation? And then He shall restore it; surely that is easy for Allah.
Say you: Go about in the land, and see how He originated creation, and then Allah will bring another production; verily Allah is Potent over everything.
He shall chastise whom He will, and shall show Mercy to whom He will; and to Him you shall be returned.
And you cannot escape in the earth or in the heaven, and for you there is no friend and helper besides Allah.
Those who disbelieve in the Signs of Allah and in their meeting with Him, they shall despair of My Mercy, and they! Theirs shall be an afflictive torment.
Then the answer of his people was nothing but that they said: Slay him, or burn him. Then Allah rescued him from the fire: herein are Signs for a people who believe.
And he said: You have taken images instead of Allah out of affection between you in the life of this world; but on the Day of
And Lūṭ believed in him. And he said: Verily I will flee to my Rabb; verily He is the Mighty, the Wise.

And We bestowed on him Ishāq and Ya'qūb, and We assigned prophecy and the Book to be among his posterity, and We vouchsafed to him his reward in this world, and in the Hereafter he shall be of the righteous.
And Lūṭ! Recall when he said to his people: you commit an indecency in which none has preceded you in the worlds.

You go in indeed to males, and you rob on the highway, and you commit what is disreputable in your assembly. The answer of his people was none but that they said: Bring you Allah's chastisement on us, if you are of the truthful.
He said: Rabb! Give me victory over the corrupt people.
And when Our envoys came to Ibrāhīm with the glad tidings, they said: We are about to destroy the inhabitants of that city, verily its inhabitants have become wrongdoers.
He said: But there is Lūṭ. They said: We know very well who is therein; we are to deliver him and his household, save his wife; she is to be of the lingerers.

And when Our envoys came to Lūṭ, he was distressed and felt straitened on their account. They said: Have no fear and do not grieve; verily we are to deliver you and your household, save your wife; she is to be of the lingerers.
Verily we are about to bring down upon the inhabitants of this city a scourge from the heaven, for they have been transgressing.
And assuredly We have left of that a manifest Sign for a people who reflect.
And to Madyan We sent their brother Shu’aib. He said: My people! Worship Allah and fear the Last Day, and do not commit evil on the land as corrupters.
Then they belied him, so an earthquake seized them and they lay in their dwellings, crouching.

And 'Ād and Thamūd! Of a surety their destruction is apparent to you from their dwellings. Satan made their works fair-seeming to them, and so kept them off from the path, while they were endued with sight.
And Qārūn and the Pharaoh and Hāmān! And assuredly there came to them Mūsa with evidences, yet they were stiff-necked in the land, and they could not outstrip Us.

Each of them We laid hold of for his sin, of them were some on whom We sent a violent wind; and of them were some who were overtaken by a shout; and of them were some with whom We sank the earth; and of them were some whom We drowned. Allah was not such as to wrong them, but themselves they were used to wrong.
The likeness of those who take other patrons than Allah is as the likeness of the spider, which takes to herself a house. And the frailest of all houses is the spider's house, if they but knew.
Verily Allah knows whatever they invoke beside Him. And He is the Mighty, the Wise.
And these similitudes! We propound them for mankind and none understands them save men of learning.
Allah has created the heavens and the earth with a purpose; verily in them is a Sign for the believers.

Recite what has been revealed to you of the Book and establish what you Şalāt; verily Şalāt forbids indecency and dishonour. And the remembrance of Allah is the highest. And Allah Knows what you perform.

Do not dispute with the People of the Book unless in the best manner, save with those of them who do wrong; and say: We believe in what has been sent down to us and in what has been sent down to you, our God and your God is One, and to Him we surrender.
Likewise We have sent down the Book to you, so those to whom We vouchsafed the Book believe in it, and some of these also believe in it. And none deny Our Signs except the infidels.
And before it you have not been reading any book nor have you been inscribing it with your right hand. For then followers of falsehood might have doubted.
Aye! It is manifest Signs in the breasts of those who have been vouchsafed knowledge; and none deny Our Signs except the wrong-doers.
And they say: Why are not Signs sent down unto him from his Rabb? Say you: Signs are with Allah only, and I am but a manifest warner.
Does it not suffice with them that We have sent down to you the Book to be recited to them? Verily herein is a mercy and an admonition to a people who believe.
Say you: Allah suffices as a witness between you and me. He knows whatever is in the heavens and the earth, and those who believe in falsehood and disbelieve in Allah, these! They shall be the losers
And they ask you to hasten on the torment. And had there not been a term appointed, the torment would surely have come to them. And surely it shall come upon them while they perceive not.
They ask you to hasten on the torment, and verily the Hell is about to encompass the infidels.
On the Day whereon the torment shall cover them from above them and from underneath their feet, and He shall say: Taste what you have been working!
O My bondmen who believe! Verily My earth is wide, so worship Me Alone.
Every soul shall taste of death; then unto Us you shall be returned.

And those who believe and work righteous deeds, them We will surely settle in lofty dwellings of the Garden whereunder rivers flow; they shall be abiders therein. Excellent is the reward of the workers.
Who persevere and trust in their Rabb.
And how many a moving creature there is that bears not its provision. Allah provides for it
And were you to ask them: Who has created the heavens and the earth and has subjected the sun and the moon? They would surely say: Allah. How then are they deviating?
Allah expands provision for whom He will of His bondmen and stints it for him. Verily Allah is the Knower of everything.

And were you to ask them: Who sends down water from the sky, and therewith revives the earth after its death? They would surely say: Allah. Say you: All praise to Allah! aye! Most of them reflect not.
And this life of the world is but sport and play. Verily the home of the Hereafter - that is life indeed, if they but know!
So when they mount upon the ship they call on Allah making faith pure for him; then when He delivers them safely on the land, lo! They associate.
So that they become ingrate for what We have vouchsafed to them, and that they enjoy themselves; but presently they shall know.

Do they not see that We have appointed an inviolable sanctuary, while men are being snatched away round about them? In falsehood would then they believe, and unto favours of Allah would they be ingrate?
And who is greater wrong-doer than he who forges a lie against Allah or belies the truth when it comes to him? Will there not be in the Hell an abiding-place of the infidels?
And those who strive hard in Us, We shall surely guide them in Our Paths; verily Allah is with the well-doers.
Alif. Lām. Mīm.
The Byzantians have been defeated.
In a nearer land, and they, after being defeated, shall soon overcome.
In a few years. Allah’s is the Command, before and after, and on that day the believers shall rejoice.
In Allah’s succour, He succours whom He will. And He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
This is Allah’s Promise and Allah does not fail His Promise. Yet most men know not.
They only know the outside appearance of the life of the world, and they! Of the Hereafter they are neglectful.

Do they not ponder in their minds? Allah has not created the heavens and the earth and what is in-between except with a purpose and for an appointed term? And verily many men are disbelievers in the meeting of their Rabb.

Have they not journeyed in the land and observed how has been the end of those before them? Those were stronger than these in power and they broke up the earth and they inhabited it with greater affluence than these have inhabited it, and their Messengers came to them with evidences. And Allah was not one to wrong them, but they were used to wrong themselves.
Then the end of those who committed evil was evil, for they belied the Signs of Allah, and they were used to mock at them.
Allah originates the creation, then He shall restore it, then to Him you shall be returned.
And on the Day whereon the Hour arrives the culprits will be dumb-struck.
And not from their associate-gods there will be intercessors
On the Day whereon the Hour arrives, that Day they will be separated.
Then as for those who believed and worked righteous deeds, they shall be in a meadow made happy.
And as for those who disbelieved and belied Our Signs and the meeting of the Hereafter – these shall be brought to the torment.
So hallow Allah when you enter the night and when you enter the morning.
And His is all Praise in the heavens and the earth, and at sun's setting and decline and when you enter the noon.
He brings forth the living from the lifeless, and He brings forth the lifeless from the living, and He revives the earth after its death, and thus you too will be brought forth.
And of His Signs is that He created you of dust, and then lo! You are human beings spreading yourselves.
And of His Signs is, that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find repose in them, and He set between you affection and mercy, verily in this are Signs for a people who ponder.
And of His Signs are the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the variation of your languages and complexions? Verily in this are Signs for men of knowledge.
And of His Signs are your sleeping by night and day, and your seeking of His Grace.

And of His Signs is that He shows you lightning for a fear and for a hope, and sends down from the sky water. And therewith revives the earth after its death; verily in this arc Signs for a people who reflect.
And of His Signs is that the heavens and the earth stand fast by His Command, and thereafter when He calls you, a call from the earth, lo! You shall come forth.
His is whosever is in the heavens and the earth; all are obedient to Him.
And He is Who originates the creation, then shall restore it, and this is for Him very easy. His is the Most Exalted similitude in the heavens and the earth, and He is the Mighty.

He propounds to you a similitude taken from yourselves. Have you, from among those whom your right hand possess, partners in that which We have provided, so that you are equal in respect thereof and you fear them as you fear each other? Thus do We detail the Signs for a people who reflect.
Aye! Those who do wrong follow their own lusts without knowledge. Who, then, will guide them whom Allah has sent astray? And for them there will be no helpers.

So set you your face towards the true faith uprightly. And follow you the constitution of Allah according to which He has constituted mankind and let there be no alteration in Allah's creation. That is the right religion, but most men know not.
And remain turning penitently to Him, and fear Him, and establish Şalāt, and be not of the associaters.
Of those who split their religion and become sects, each band is exulting what is with it.
And when any hurt visits mankind, they cry to their Rabb turning penitently to Him; then when He causes them to taste of His Mercy, lo! A part of them joins others with their Rabb.
So that they may be ungrateful for that which We have vouchsafed to them. So enjoy awhile; presently you shall come to know.
Or, have We sent to them any authority, so that it speaks of what they have been associating with Him?
And when We cause mankind to taste of Mercy, they exult at it, then if an evil befalls them because of what their hands have sent forth; lo! They despair.
Do they not see that Allah expands the provision for whomever He will, and stints? Verily in that is a Sign for a people who believe.
So give you to the kinsman his due and to the needy and to the wayfarer. That is the best for those who seek Allah's Pleasure, and those are the blissful ones.

And whatever you give in gift in order that it may increase among the substance of men does not increase with Allah, and what you pay in poor-rate seeking the favour of Allah, then these! They shall have manifold increase.

Allah is He Who created you and provided food for you, then He causes you to die, and then He shall quicken you. Is there any of your associate-gods that does anything of that? Hallowed and exalted be He above what they associate!
Corruption has prevailed on land and sea because of what men's hands have earned, so that He may make them taste a part of what they have worked, in order that perhaps they may turn.
Say you: Go forth in the land and see what has been the end of those who were before you. And most of them were associators.
So set your face towards the right religion before the Day arrives from which there is no averting from Allah. On that Day they shall be sundered.
Whoever disbelieves, on him is his infidelity, and those who work righteously are preparing themselves.
So that He shall recompense out of His Grace those who believe and work righteous deeds; verily He does not approve the infidels.

And of His Signs is that He sends winds heralding rain and that He may make you taste of His Mercy, and that the ships may sail at His Command, and that you seek His Grace, and that perhaps you may return thanks.
And assuredly We sent Messengers before you to their people. They brought them manifest Signs. Then We requited them who transgressed. And incumbent upon Us was to avenge the believers.

Allah is He Who sends the winds so that they raise a cloud and then spreads it along the sky as He will, and then breaks it into fragments, and you see the rain come forth from its midst. Then when He makes it fall upon such of His bondmen as He will. Lo! They rejoice.
Even though before it was sent down upon them, they were surely despairing before that.
Look then at the effects of Allah's Mercy: how He revives the earth after its death, verily He is the Quickener of the dead, He is Potent over everything.
And if We send a wind and they should see their tilth yellow, then they would thereafter remain disbelieving.
Surely you cannot make the dead hear, nor can you make the deaf hear the call when they turn away in flight.
Nor can you be a guide to the blind out of their error, you can make none to hear save those who believe in Our Signs, and who have surrendered.
Allah is He Who created you in weakness, then He assigned strength after weakness, then after strength weakness and grey hair. He creates what He will, and He is the Knower, the Potent.
And on the Day when the Hour arrives the culprits will swear that they stayed not but an hour, thus were they ever deluded.

And those who have been vouchsafed knowledge and faith will say: Assuredly you have stayed according to the decree of Allah until the Day of Upraising; so this is the Day of Upraising, but you were not used to know.
On that Day the excusing of themselves will not profit them who did wrong, nor shall they be allowed to please Allah.
And assuredly We have in this Qurān propounded all means of similitude for mankind, and if you bring them a Sign. who disbelieve are sure to say: You are but deluded.
Thus does Allah seal the hearts of those who do not believe.
Have you patience; verily Allah's Promise is true. And let not those who have no conviction make you unsteady.
Alif. Lām. Mīm.
These are verses of the Wise Book.
A guidance and a mercy for the well-doers.
Those who establish Ṣalāt and pay Zakāt and are convinced of the Hereafter.
These are on guidance from their Rabb, and these! They are the blissful.
And of man is he who purchases an idle discourse that he may mislead from Allah's Way without knowledge, and takes it by way of mockery. These! For them shall be an ignominious chastisement.
And when Our Revelations are recited to him, he turns away in pride as though he did not hear that at all; as though there was a heaviness in his ears. Announce you to him an afflictive torment.
Verily those who believe and work righteous deeds. Theirs shall be Gardens of Delight.
Abiders they will be therein; a true promise of Allah. And He is the Mighty, the Wise.

He has created the heavens that you see without pillars and has cast firm mountains in the earth lest it move away with you, and He has scattered thereon every kind of animals. And We send down water from the sky and We make all manner of goodly growth therein.
This is the creation of Allah. Show me what those beside Allah have created. Aye! The ungodly are in manifest error.

And assuredly We vouchsafed wisdom to Luqmān saying: Give thanks to Allah, and whoever gives thanks, gives thanks for his soul; and whoever is unthankful – then verily Allah is Self-Sufficient, Praise-worthy.
And recall when Luqmān said to his son, while he was exhorting him: O my son! Associate not anything with Allah; verily this associating is a tremendous wrong.
And We have enjoined upon man concerning his parents – his mother bears him, in hardship upon hardship, and his weaning is in two years, give thanks to Me and to your parents: unto Me is the goal.

And if the twain strive to make you associate with Me that whereof you have no knowledge, then obey them not. And keep them honourable company in this world reputably and follow you the path of him who turns to Me penitently. Then to Me is your return, and I shall declare to you what you have been working.
Son! Though it be but of the weight of a grain of mustard-seed and though it be in a rock, or in the heavens, or in the earth, Allah shall bring it forth; verily Allah is Subtle, Aware.
Son! Establish the Salaat and so what is reputable and forbid iniquity, and bear patiently whatever may befall you; verily that is of the firmness of affairs.
And turn not your cheek from men, nor walk on the earth stiflingly; verily Allah does not approve any vainglorious boaster.
And be you modest in your gait and lower your voice; verily the most abominable of voices is the voice of the ass.

Do you not see that Allah has subjected for you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and has completed His favours on you outwardly and inwardly. And yet of mankind is one who disputes concerning Allah without knowledge and with neither guidance nor a luminous Book.

And when it is said to them: Follow what Allah has sent down, they say: Nay! We shall follow what we found our fathers upon. What! Even though Satan had been calling on them to the torment of the Blaze.
And whoever submits his face to Allah and he is a well-doer, he has of a surety lain hold of a firm cord. Unto Allah is the end of all affairs.
And whoever disbelieves, let not his infidelity grieve you. To Us is their return, and We shall declare to them what they have worked. Verily Allah is the Knower of what is in their breasts.
We let them enjoy for a while, and then We shall drive them to a rough torment.
And were you to ask them: Who has created the heavens and the earth, they will surely say: Allah. Say you: All Praise to Allah! But most of them know not.
Allah's is whatever is in the heavens and the earth. Verily Allah! He is the Self-sufficient, the Laudable.
And if whatever trees are on the earth were pens, and seas were ink, with seven more seas to help, the words of Allah could not be exhausted; verily Allah is Mighty, Wise.
And the creation of you all and the upraising of you all are as though of one soul, verily Allah is Hearing, Beholding.
Do you not see that Allah plunges the day into the night and the night into the day and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running to an appointed term, and that Allah is Aware of what you do?
That is because Allah! He is the Truth, because whatever they call upon beside Allah is falsehood, and because He is the Exalted, the Great.
Do you not see that the ship sails into the sea by the favour of Allah, that He might show you of His Signs? Verily therein are Signs for every persevering, grateful heart.

And when a wave covers them like awnings, they call upon Allah making their faith pure for Him. Then when He delivers them on the land, only some of them keep to the middle course. And none denies Our Signs save each perfidious, ingrate one.

O mankind! Fear your Rabb and dread the Day whereon no father will atone for his son and no son will atone for his father at all. Verily the Promise of Allah is true. Let not the life of this world beguile you, and let not the great beguiler beguile you in regard to Allah.

Verily Allah! With Him Alone is the knowledge of the Hour, and He is Who sends down the rain, and knows what is in the wombs. And no person knows what he will earn to morrow, and no person knows in what land he will die. Verily Allah is Knowing, Aware.
Alif. Lām. Mīm.
Revelation of this Book of which there is no doubt, is from the Rabb of the worlds.
Will they say: He has fabricated it? Aye! It is the truth from your Rabb that you may warn therewith a people to whom no warner came before you, that perhaps they may be guided.

Allah it is Who has created the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is in-between in six days, and then He established Himself on the Throne. No patron have you nor an intercessor, beside Him. Will you not then be admonished?
He disposes every affair from the heaven to the earth. Thereafter it shall ascend unto Him in a Day whereof the measure is one thousand years of what you compute.
Such is the Knower of the unseen and the seen, the Mighty, the Merciful.
Who has made everything good which He has created. And He originated the creation of man from clay.
Then He made his progeny from an extract of mean water.
Then He fashioned him and breathed into him something of a spirit from Him; and He ordained for you hearing and sight and hearts. Little is the thanks you return.
And they say: When we are vanished in the earth, shall we be raised in a new creation? Aye! They are disbelieving in the meeting with their Rabb.
Say you: The angel of death who is set over you shall cause you to die, thereafter you shall be returned to your Rabb.
Could you but see when the culprits shall hang their heads before their Rabb saying: Rabb! We have now seen and heard; so
And had We willed, surely We would have given every soul its guidance, but true must be the word from Me; I shall surely fill Hell with the Jinn and mankind together.
So taste you the sequel for as much as you forget the meeting of this Day, verily We have forgotten you. Taste the abiding torment for what you have been working.
They alone believe Our Revelations who, when they are reminded thereof, fall down prostrate and hallow the Praise of their Rabb, and they are not proud.
Their sides leave off the couches calling upon their Rabb in fear and in desire, and they expend of that with which We have provided them.
No soul knows what is kept hidden from them of perfect comfort as a recompense for what they have been working.
Shall he, thereof, who is a believer, be like him who is a transgressor? Equal they are not.
As for those who believe and work righteous deeds for them are Gardens of Abode: An entertainment of what they had been working.

And as for those who transgress their abode is the Fire. Whenever they will desire to get thereout, they shall be drawn back thereto, and it will be said to them: Taste the torment of the Fire which you used to belie.
And surely We shall make them taste of the smaller torment before the greater that perhaps they may yet return.
And who is a greater wrong-doer than he who is reminded of His Sign, and he turns aside therefrom? Verily We are going to be Avenger unto the culprits.
Assuredly We vouchsafed the Book to Musa; So be you not in doubt in receiving it. And We assigned it to be a guidance to the Children of Israil.
And we appointed from amongst them leaders, guiding others by Our Command, when they had persevered, and of Our Signs they were convinced.
Verily your Rabb: He shall decide between them on the Day of Judgment concerning that wherein they have been differing.
Has this not guided them: How many a generation We have destroyed before them amidst whose dwellings they walk? Surely therein are signs; will they not listen?
Do they not see that We drive water to a bare land, and bring forth therewith crops of which their cattle and they themselves eat? Will they not therefore be enlightened?
And they say: When will this Decision arrive, if you say the truth?
Say you: On the Day of the Decision their belief will not profit those who have disbelieved; nor will they be respited.
So turn aside you from them, and await, verily they are awaiting.
O Prophet! Fear Allah, and do not yield to the infidels and the hypocrites; verily Allah is ever Knowing, Wise.
And follow that which is revealed to you from your Rabb, verily Allah is Aware of what you do.
And put your trust in Allah, and Allah suffices as a Trustee.

Allah has not placed two hearts in any man, in his inside. Neither had He made your wives whom you pronounce to be as your mother's back, your real mothers, nor has He made your adopted sons your own sons. This is only your saying by your mouths, whereas Allah says the truth and He guides the way.
Call them after their fathers; that will be more equitable in the sight of Allah. And if you do not know their fathers then they are your brethren in faith and your friends and there is no fault

The Prophet is nearer to believers than themselves, and his wives are their mothers. And kinsmen are nearer one to another than other believers and the emigrants in the ordinance of Allah, except that you may act humbly to your friends. This has been inscribed in the Book.
And recall when We took a bond from the Prophets and from you, and from Nūḥ and Ibrāhīm and Mūsa and 'Isā son of Maryam. And We took from them a solemn bond.
That He may question the truthful of their truth. And for the infidels He has prepared an afflictive torment.
O you who believe! Remember Allah's favour to you when there came unto you hosts, and We sent against them a wind and hosts which you did not see, and Allah was a Beholder of what you were working.
When they came upon you from above you and from below you, and when eyes turned aside and hearts reached to the gullets in terror, and of Allah you were imagining various things.
Then were the faithful turned and shaken with a mighty shaking.
And when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is disease were saying: Allah and his Messengers have promised us nothing but delusion.
And when a party of them said: O people of Yarthrib! There is no place for you, so retire. And a party of them asked leave of the Messenger saying: Verily our houses stand exposed.
And if they were to be entered upon from the sides thereof and they were asked to sedition, they would surely have committed it, and they would have stayed therein but slightly.
And assuredly they had already covenanted with Allah that they would not turn their backs; verily the covenant with Allah must be questioned about.
Say you: Flight will not avail you if you flee from death or slaughter, and lo! You will not enjoy life except for a little.
Say you: Who is there that will protect you from Allah, if He intends to bring evil on you or intends mercy for you? And they shall not find, besides Allah, for themselves a patron or helper.
Surely Allah knows those amongst you who hinder others and those who say to their brethren: Come hither to us, while they themselves come not to the battle save a little.

Being niggardly towards you, when fighting comes you behold them to look to you, their eyes rolling like the eyes of him who faints unto death. Then when the fighting is over, they inveigh against you with sharp tongues, being deprived of good things. These have not believed, so Allah has made their works of none effect; and that is with Allah ever easy.

They imagine that the confederates have not yet departed; and if the confederates should come, they would rather be in the desert with the wandering Arabs asking for news of you. And if they happen to be among you, they would fight but little.
Assuredly there has been an excellent pattern, for you in the Messenger of Allah, for him who hopes in Allah and the Last Day and remembers Allah much.

And when the faithful saw the confederates, they said: This is what Allah and His Messenger had promised us, and Allah and His Messenger had spoken the truth. It only increased their belief and self-surrender.
Of the faithful are men who have fulfilled their covenant with Allah. Some of them have performed their vow, and some of them are waiting, and they have not changed in the least.
All this happened in order that Allah may recompense the truthful for their truth, and may punish the hypocrites if He would or may relent toward them. Verily Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
Allah drove back those who disbelieved in their rage, they obtained no advantage; and Allah sufficed for the faithful in the fighting. Allah is ever Strong, Mighty.
He brought those of the people of the Book who backed them down from their fortresses and cast terror in their hearts, a part of them you slew, and a part you made captives.
And He caused you to inherit their land and their houses and their riches, and the land which you have not trodden, and Allah is Potent over everything.
O Prophet! Say to your wives: If it be that you seek the life of the world and its adornment, then come, I shall make a provision for you, and shall release you with a handsome release.
And if you seek Allah and His Messenger and the abode of the Hereafter then verily Allah has prepared of the well-doers among you a mighty reward.
O wives of the Prophet! Whosoever of you commits a flagrant indecency, doubled for her would be the punishment and with Allah that is easy.
Whosoever of you is obedient to Allah and His Messenger and works righteously, her wage We shall give her twice over and We have prepared for her a generous provision.
O you Wives of Prophet! You are not like other woman if you are God-fearing. So do not be soft in speech, lest in whose heart is disease, should be moved with desire, but make an honourable speech.

And stay in your houses. And do not display yourselves as did the pagans of old. And establish Şalāt and pay Zakāt and obey Allah and His Messenger. Allah only desires to remove uncleanliness from you, and to purify you with a thorough purification. O people of the household of the Prophet!
And bear in mind what is rehearsed in your homes of the revelations of Allah and the wisdom. Verily Allah is ever Subtile, Aware.

Surely the Muslim men and women, and the believing men and women, and the devout men and women, and the men and women of veracity, and the persevering men and women, and the men and women of humility, and the almsgiving men and women, and the fasting men and women, and the men and women who guard their private parts and the men and women remembering Allah much - for them Allah has got ready forgiveness and a mighty reward.

And it is not for believing man or woman, when Allah and His Messenger have decreed an affair, that they should have any choice in their affair. And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger has strayed manifestly.

And recall when you were saying to him on whom Allah had conferred a favour and you had conferred a favour: Keep your wife to yourself and fear Allah, and you were concealing within you what Allah was going to disclose, and you were fearing mankind, while Allah had a greater right that Him you should fear. Then when Zaid had accomplished his purpose regarding her, We wedded her to you so that there should be no blame on the believers in respect of wives of their adopted sons, when they have accomplished their purpose with regard to them. And the ordinance of Allah was to be fulfilled.

No blame there is on the Prophet in what Allah has decreed for him. That has been Allah's dispensation with those who have passed away before – and the ordinance of Allah has been a destiny determined.
Those who preached the Message of Allah, and feared Him, and none save Allah. And Allah suffices as a Reckoner.
Muhammad is not the father of any of your males, but a Messenger of Allah and the seal of the Prophets, and Allah is the Knower of everything.
O you who believe! Remember Allah oft.
And hallow Him morning and evening.
He it is Who sends His benedictions to you, and His angels also, that He may bring you forth from darkness into light, and to the faithful He is ever Merciful.
Their greeting on the Day when they meet Him will be: peace! And He has got ready for them a generous wage.
O Prophet! We have verily sent you as a witness and a bearer of glad tidings and a warner.
And a summoner unto Allah by His Command, and a luminous lamp.
And bear you to the faithful the glad tidings that there is for them a great grace from Allah.
Do not yield to the infidels and the hypocrites and disregard their insolence, and trust in Allah, and Allah suffices as a Trustee.

O you who believe! When you marry believing women and divorce them before you have touched them, then there is no waiting-period incumbent upon them from you, that you should count. So make a provision for them and release them with a scemily release.

O Prophet! He has allowed you your wives to whom you have paid their wages, also those whom your right hand owns of those whom Allah has given you as spoils of war and the daughters of your paternal uncle and the daughters of your paternal aunts and the daughters of your maternal uncle and the daughters of your maternal aunts, who migrated with you, and the believing woman, when she offers herself to the Prophet, if the Prophet desire to wed her – this provision is exclusively for you, above the rest of the believers, surely We know what We have ordained to them concerning their wives and those whom their right hands possess, in order that there may be no blame upon you. And Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.

You may put off such of them as you will, and you may take unto you such of them as you will; and when you desire such as you have set aside there is no blame upon you. This is likelier to cool their eyes and let them not grieve and to keep them pleased with what you shall give everyone of them. Allah knows what is in your hearts, and Allah is ever Knowing. Forbearing.

Henceforth women are not allowed to you, nor may you change them for other wives, although their beauty please you, save those whom your right hand shall own, and Allah is ever Watcher over everything.

O you who believe! Enter not the houses of the Prophet, except when leave is given to you, for a meal and at a time that you will have to wait for its preparation. But when you are invited, then enter, and when you have had the meal, then disperse, without lingering to enter into familiar discourse. Verily this is heavy on the Prophet, and he is shy of asking you to depart, but Allah is not shy of the truth. And when you ask of them anything, ask it from behind a curtain. That shall be purer for your hearts and for their hearts. And it is not lawful for you that you should cause annoyance to the Messenger of Allah, nor that you should ever marry his wives after him; verily that shall be an enormity in the Sight of Allah.
Whether you disclose a thing or conceal it, verily Allah is ever Knower of everything.

It is no sin for them in respect of their fathers or brothers, or their brother’s sons or their sister’s sons or their own women, or those whom their right hands own; and fear Allah, verily Allah is ever a Witness of everything.
Verily Allah and His angels send their benedictions upon the Prophet. O you who believe! Send you benedictions also upon him and salute him with a goodly salutation.
Surely those who annoy Allah and His Messenger – Allah has cursed them in this world and the Hereafter, and has prepared for them an ignominious torment.
And those who annoy the believing men and women without their deserving it shall surely bear the guilt of calumny and evident sin.

O Prophet! Say to your wives and your daughters and women of the believers that they should let down upon them their wrapping-garments. That would be more likely to distinguish them, so that they will not be affronted. And Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.

If the hypocrites and those in whose heart is a disease and the raisers of commotion in Madinah do not desist, We shall certainly set you up against them. Thenceforth they shall not be allowed to neighbour you therein, except for a little while.
Accursed, wherever found, they shall be seized and slain with a relentless slaughter.
That has been the dispensation of Allah with those who have passed away before, and you shall not find any change in the dispensation of Allah.
People question you concerning the Hour. Say you: Its knowledge is with Allah only. And what do you know? perhaps the Hour may be near.
Verily Allah has cursed the infidels, and has prepared for them a Blaze.
Abiders therein they shall be for ever, and they will find neither a protecting friend nor a helper.
On the Day when their faces shall be rolled in Fire, they will say: Ah! That we had obeyed Allah and had obeyed the Messenger!
And they will say: Our Rabb! We obeyed our chiefs and our elders and they led us astray from the way.
Our Rabb! Give them punishment twofold, and curse them with a great curse.
O you who believe! Do not be like those who annoyed Mūsa, but Allah cleared him of what they said; and he was illustrious with Allah.
O you who believe! Fear Allah, and speak a straight speech.
He will amend your works for you and forgive you your sins. And whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger, he has indeed achieved a great achievement.
Verily We! We offered the trust to the heavens and the earth and the mountains, but they declined to bear it and shrank from it. But man undertook it, truly he was very sinful, very foolish.

So that Allah will chastise the hypocritical men and women and the associators and the associatoresses. And Allah will relent toward the believing men and women, and Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.
All praise to Allah Whose is what is in the heavens and what is in the earth; and His is the Praise in the Hereafter. And He is the Wise, the Aware.
He knows what penetrates into the earth and what comes forth from it, and what descends from the heaven and what ascends to it. And He is the Merciful, the Forgiving.

Those who disbelieve say: The Hour will not come unto us. Say you: Yea! By my Rabb, the Knower of the Unseen, it will surely come unto you. Not an atom’s weight escapes Him in the heavens or in the earth, nor is there anything smaller than it or greater but it is inscribed in a luminous Book.
That He may recompense those who believed and worked righteous deeds. Those! Theirs shall be forgiveness and a generous provision.
And those who attempted to frustrate Our Signs - those!
And those who have been vouchsafed knowledge behold the Book revealed to you from your Rabb, - it is the truth and it guides to the path of the Mighty, the Laudable.
And those who disbelieve say: Shall we direct you to a man declaring to you that when you have dispersed with full dispersion, then you will be raised unto a new creation.
Has he fabricated a lie against Allah, or is there a madness in him? Nay, but those who disbelieve in the Hereafter are themselves in a torment and error far-reaching.

Do they not see what is before them and what is behind them of the heaven and the earth? If We will, We shall sink the earth with them, or cause a fragment of the sky to fall on them. Verily there is a Sign therein unto every penitent bondman.
And assuredly We vouchsafed to Daūd Grace from Us and said: O Mountains! Repeat Our Praises with him, and birds you also! And We softened for him the iron.
Saying: Make you complete coats of mail and rightly dispose the links, and work you righteously. Verily I am of that which you work a Beholder.

And to Sulaiman We subjected the wind, of which the morning journeying was a month and the evening journeying a month. And We made the fount of brass flow for him. And of the Jinn were who worked before him by the will of his Rabb. And whosoever of them swerved from Our Command, him We shall cause to taste the torment of the Blaze.
They fashioned for him whatsoever he wished, of lofty halls and statues and basins like cisterns and cauldrons standing firm. O House of Daūd! Work with gratitude; few of My bondmen are grateful.

Then when We decreed death for him, none discovered his death to them, save a moving creature of the earth, which gnawed away his staff. Then when he fell the Jinn clearly perceived that, if they had known the Unseen they would not have tarried in the ignominious torment.
Assuredly for Saba, a Sign in their own dwelling place; two gardens on the right hand and on the left. Eat you of the provision of your Rabb, and give thanks to Him: A fair land and a Forgiving Rabb!
But they turned away. So we sent upon them the inundation of the dam and We exchanged their two gardens for two gardens bearing bitter fruit, and tamarisk and some few lote-trees.
In this way We requited them, as they were ungrateful. And We do not requite thus any save the ingrates.
And We had placed between them and the cities which We had blessed, cities easy to be seen, and We had made the stages of journey between them easy: Travel in them nights and days secure.

And they said: Our Rabb! Make the distance between our journeys longer, and they wronged themselves. So we made them by-words and dispersed them totally. Surely herein are Signs for every persevering, grateful person.
And assuredly Iblis found his conjecture regarding them true; and they followed him, all save a party of the believers.
And he has no authority over them, except that We would know him who believes in the Hereafter from him, who is in doubt thereof. And your Rabb is a Warden over everything.

Say you: Call upon those whom you assert besides Allah. They do not own an atom's weight either in the heavens or in the earth, nor have they any partnership in either, nor is there for Him any supporter from among them.

Intercession with Him profits not save the intercession of him whom He gives leave. They hold their peace until when fright is taken off from their hearts, they say: What is it that your Rabb has said? They (angels) say: The very Truth. And He is the Exalted, the Great.
Say you: Who does provide food for you from the heavens and the earth? Say you: Allah; verily either we or you are on the guidance, or in clear error.
Say you: You will not be questioned about what we have committed, nor will we be questioned about what you work.
Say you: Our Rabb shall assemble us together, then He shall judge between us with truth; and He is the All-Knowing.
Say you: Show me those whom you have joined with Him as associates. By no means! Aye! He is Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.
And We have not sent you save as a bearer of glad tidings and a warner to all mankind; yet most mankind do not know.
And they say: When is the promise to come, if you are truthful.
Say you: The assignment to you is for a Day which you cannot put back for an hour nor can you anticipate.

And those who disbelieve say: We shall by no means believe in the Qurān nor in what has been before it. Would that you could see when the ungodly shall be made to stand before their Rabb. They shall cast back the word one to another. Those who were deemed weak will say to those who were proud: Had it not been for you, we should surely have been believers.
Those who were proud will say to those who were deemed weak: Were it we who prevented you from the guidance after it had come to you? Aye! You have been guilty yourselves.

And those who were deemed weak will say to those who were proud: Aye! It was your plotting night and day, when you were commanding us that we should disbelieve in Allah and set up peers unto Him. And they will keep secret their shame when they behold the torment. And We shall place shackles on the necks of those who disbelieved. They shall be requited not according to what they had been working.
And We sent not a warner to a town but the affluent thereof said: We are disbelievers in that with which you have been sent.
And they said: We are greater in riches and children, and we are not going to be chastised.
Say you: Verily my Rabb expands the provision for whom He will and stints it likewise, but most of mankind know not.

It is not your riches nor your children that will draw you closer to Us with a near approach, but whoever believes and works righteously – then theirs! Theirs will be a twofold reward for what they will have worked, and they will be in upper apartments secure.
And those who endeavour to frustrate our signs, torment will be brought to them.
Say you: My Rabb expands the provision for whom He will of His bondmen and also stints it for him. And what you expend of anything, He will replace it. And He is the Best of Providers.
And on the Day when He gathers them together, He will say to the angels: Were it you that these polytheists used to worship.
They will say: Hallowed be You! You are our protecting friend, not they. Aye! They have been worshipping the Jinn; in them most of them were believers.
Today you cannot benefit or hurt one another. And We shall say to those who did wrong: Taste the torment of the Fire which you used to belie.

And when there are rehearsed to them Our plain Revelations they say: This Messenger is nothing but a man, who seeks to prevent you from what your fathers have been worshipping. And they say: This Message is nothing but a fraud fabricated. And those who disbelieve say of the truth, when it comes unto them. This is nothing but manifest magic.
And We had not vouchsafed to them books they should have been studying, nor had We sent to them any warmer before you.
And those before them belied, and these have not arrived to a tithe of which We had vouchsafed them. But they belied My Messengers. So how intense was My disapproval!

Say you: I but exhort you to one thing; that you stand, for Allah's sake, by twos and singly, and then ponder, in your companion there is no madness, he is naught but a warner to you of a severe torment.
Say you: Whatever wage I might have asked of you is yours; my wage is with Allah; and He is a Witness of everything.
Say you: My Rabb hurls the truth; the Knower of things hidden.
Say you: The truth has come, and falsehood shall neither originate nor be restored.
Say you: If ever I go astray, I shall stray only against myself, and if I remain guided it is because of what my Rabb has revealed to me. Verily He is Hearing, Near.
Could you see the time when they shall be terrified. Then there shall be no escaping, and they shall be seized from a place quite near.
And then they will say: We believe in it. But whence can there be the attainment of faith from a place so afar.
Whereas they disbelieved in it before, and conjectured about the Unseen from a place so afar.
And they will be shut off from what they shall ardently desire, as shall be done with the likes of them of before. Verily they have been in doubt perplexing.

All praise to Allah, the Creator of the heavens and the earth, the appointer of the angels as His Messengers with wings of twos and threes and fours. He adds in creation what He will. Verily Allah is Potent over everything.
Whatsoever of Mercy Allah may grant to mankind, none there is to withhold it, and whatsoever He may withhold, none there is to release it thereafter. And he is the Mighty, the Wise.
O mankind! Remember the favour of Allah towards you. Is there any Creator other than Allah who provides for you from the heaven and the earth? There is no God but He. Whither then are you deviating?
And if they belie you, then Messengers have been belied before you. And to Allah shall be brought back all affairs.
O mankind! Verily the promise of Allah is true. So let not the life of this world beguile you,
Verily Satan is an enemy to you; so take him for an enemy, he only tempts his confederates that they become the inmates of the Blaze.
Those who disbelieve theirs shall be a severe torment. And those who believe and do good deeds, theirs shall be forgiveness and a great wage.

Can he whose evil work has been made fair-seeming to him, so that he considers it good, be as he who rightly perceives the truth? Verily Allah sends astray whom He will and guides whom He will, so let not your soul expire after them in sighings. Verily Allah is the Knower of what they perform.
And it is Allah Who sends the winds, and they raise a cloud, and then We drive it into a dead land and We raise thereby the earth after its death. Even so shall be the Resurrection.

Whosoever desires glory, then all glory is Allah's; to Him mount up goodly words, and the righteous work exalt them. And those who plot evils, theirs shall be a severe torment, and the plotting of those! It shall perish.

And Allah created you of dust, then of seed; then He made you pairs. No female bears or brings forth but with His Knowledge. And no aged man grows old, nor is anything diminished of his life, but it is in a Book. Verily for Allah that is easy.

And the two seas are not alike: This, sweet, thirst-quenching and pleasant to drink, and that, saltish and bitter. And yet from each you eat fresh flesh and bring forth the ornaments that you wear. And you see therein the ships cleaving water, that you may seek of His Grace, and that perhaps you may give thanks.

He plunges the night into the day and plunges the day into the night; and He has subjected the sun and the moon, each running till an appointed term. Such is Allah, your Rabb; His is the dominion: And those whom you call upon beside Him do not own even the husk of a date- stone.

If you call unto them, they hear not your calling, and even if they heard they could not answer you. On the Day of Judgment they will deny your associating. And none can declare to you the truth like Him Who is Aware.
O mankind! You are the ones that stand in need of Allah, and Allah! He is the Self-sufficient, the Praiseworthy.
If He will, He can take you away, and bring about a new creation.
And with Allah that shall not be hard.

And no bearer of a burden shall bear another's burden, and if one heavy-laden calls for his load none of it shall be borne, although he be of kin. You can warn only those who fear their Rabb, unseen, and establish Salāt. And whosoever becomes clean, becomes clean only for himself, and to Allah is the return.
Not alike are the blind and the seeing.
Neither darkness and light.
Nor the shade and the sun's heat.
Nor alike are the living and the dead. Verily Allah makes whosoever He will to hear, and you cannot make them hear who are in the graves.
You are but a warner.
Verily We! We have sent you with the truth, as a bearer of glad tidings and as a warner, and there is not a community but there has passed away among them of a warner.
And if they belie you, then surely those before them have also belied. Their Messengers came to them with evidences and Scriptures and a luminous Book.
Then I took hold of those who disbelieved. So how terrible was My disapproval!
Do you not see that Allah sends down water from the sky, and then We thereby bring fruit of diverse hues? And in the mountains are streaks white and red, of diverse hues, and also intensely black.
And of men and beasts and cattle, likewise of diverse
Verily those who read the Book of Allah and establish Şalāt and expend of that with which We have provided them, secretly and in open, look for a commerce that will not perish.
That He may pay them their wages in full and increase to them of His Grace, surely He is Forgiving, Appreciative.
And what We have revealed to you of the Book - it is the very truth confirming what has been before it. Verily Allah is unto His bondmen Aware, Beholder.

Afterwards We made those We chose of Our bondmen the inheritors of the Book. Then of them are some who wrong themselves, and of them are some who keep the middle way, and of them are some who go ahead, by Allah's leave, in virtues. That! That is indeed a great grace.
Gardens Everlasting! These they shall enter wearing therein bracelets of gold and pearls, and their apparel therein shall be of silk.
And they will say: All praise to Allah Who has taken away grief from us, verily our Rabb is Forgiving, Appreciative.
Who has through His Grace, lodged us in the everlasting abode, wherein there will not touch us toil and wherein there will not touch us weariness.
And those who disbelieve, for them shall be Hell Fire. It shall not be decreed to them that they should die, nor shall its torment be lightened for them. Thus do We requite every ingrate.

And they shall be shouting therein: Our Rabb! Take us out; we will work righteously, not what we have been working. Did We not give you lives long enough so that whosoever would receive admonition could receive it therein? And there came to you a warner; taste, therefore. And for the ungodly there will be no helper.
Verily Allah is the Knower of the unseen of the heavens and the earth. Verily He is the Knower of what is in the breasts.

He it is Who has made you successors in the earth. So whosoever disbelieves, on him will befall his infidelity. And for the infidels their infidelity increases nothing with their Rabb save abhorrence. And for the infidels their infidelity increases naught save loss.

Say you: What do you consider of your associate gods u on which you call besides Allah? Show me whatsoever they have created of the earth. Or, have they any partnership in the heavens? Or, have We vouchsafed to them a Book so that they stand upon an evidence from it? Nay! The ungodly promise to each other only delusions.
Verily Allah withholds the heavens and the earth lest they cease; and should they cease, not any one could withhold them after Him. Verily He is ever Forbearing, Forgiving.

And they swore by Allah with a most solemn oath, that if there came a warner unto them, they would surely be better guided than any of the other communities. Then when there did come to them a warner, it increased in them nothing save aversion.

Through their stiff neckedness in the land and their plotting of evil. And the plotting of evil only enfolds its author. Do they then wait only the dispensation of the ancients? And you will not find in the dispensation of Allah a change, nor will you find in the dispensation of Allah a turning off.

Have they not journeyed on the earth, so that they might see how has been the end of those before them, although they were stronger in power than these? Allah is not such that anything in the heavens and the earth can frustrate Him. Verily, He is ever Knowing, Potent.

Were Allah to take mankind to task for what they earn. He would not leave a moving creature on its back; but He puts them off till a term assigned, then when that term arrives – then, verily, Allah is ever a Beholder of His bondmen.
Yāsīn.
By the Qurān full of wisdom.
Verily you are of the sent ones.
Upon the straight path.
This is a revelation of the Mighty, the Merciful.
That you may warn a people whose fathers were not warned, so they are neglectful.
Assuredly the word has been justified against most of them, so they shall not believe.
Surely We have placed on their necks shackles which are up to the chins; so that their heads are forced up.
And We have placed before them a barrier and behind them a barrier, so We have covered them; so that they do not see.
It is alike to them, whether you warn them or warn them not; they will never have faith.
You can warn him only who follows the admonition and fears the Compassionate, Unseen. Bear you to him the glad tidings of forgiveness and a generous wage.
Verily We! We shall rise the dead; and We write down what they have forwarded and what they have left behind. And everything We have counted up in a luminous Record.
And recount you to them the similitude of the residents of a town, when there came thereto the sent ones.
When We sent to them two. Then they belied the twain; so We strengthened them with a third, and they said: We are envoys unto you.
They said: You are but human beings like ourselves, the Compassionate has not sent down anything. You are only lying.
The envoys said: Our Rabb knows that surly we are envoys to you.
And on us is nothing but manifest preaching.
They said: Surely we augur ill of you; and if you do not desist, we shall certainly stone you, and there will befall you from us an affective chastisement.
The envoys said: Your evil augury be with you. What I do you call it ill luck because you are admonished? Aye! You are a people extravagant.
And there came a man running from the end of the town. He said; my people, follow the
Follow those who do not ask any wage of you, and who are rightly guided.
And why should I not worship Him alone Who has originated me, and to Whom you shall be returned.
Shall I take, besides Him gods; when the Compassionate intends me any harm, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor would they save me?
Verily then I should be in clear error.
Verily now I believe in your Rabb, so listen to me.
It was said: Enter you the Garden. He said: Would that my people knew.
That my Rabb has forgiven me, and has made me of the honoured ones.
And We sent not against his people after him a host from heaven, and We have not been sending down any such.
It was but one shout, and lo! They were extinct.
Ah the misery of Our bondsmen! There comes not to them any Messenger of Ours but him they have been mocking.
Do they not see how many of the generations before them We have destroyed? Surely to them they shall not return.
And surely all, every one of them, shall be brought to Us.
And a Sign unto them is dead land. We revive it and therefrom We bring forth grain, so that they eat of it.
And We place therein the gardens of date-palms and vines, and therein We cause springs to gush forth.
That they may eat the fruit thereof. And their hands worked it not. Will they not, therefore, give thanks?
Hallowed be He, Who has created all the pairs of what the earth grows and of themselves, and of what they know not.
And a Sign with them is night. We draw off the day therefrom, and lo! They are darkened.
And the sun runs to its assigned term; that is the disposition of the Mighty, the Knowing.
And the moon! For it We have decreed mansions till it reverts like the old branch of a palm-tree.
It is not permitted to sun to overtake the moon, nor can the night outstrip the day; each in an orbit, they float.
And a Sign unto them is that We bear their offspring in a laden ship.
And We have created for them of the like thereunto so on them they ride.
And if We will, We shall drown them, and there will be no shout for them, nor will they be saved.
Unless it be a Mercy from Us, and as an enjoyment for a season.
And when it is said to them: fear what is before you and what is behind you, that perchance you may find Mercy, they withdraw.
And not a Sign of the Signs of their Rabb comes to them, but they are ever backsliders therefrom.

And when it is said to them: Expend of that with which Allah has provided you, those who disbelieve say to the faithful: Shall we feed those whom Allah Himself would have fed, had He willed? You are but in error manifest.
And they say: When will the Promise be fulfilled, if you are truthful.
They await not but a single shout which shall seize them while they are yet wrangling?
And they will not be able to make a disposition, nor to their family they will return.
And the Trumpet will be blown, and lo! From their tombs they shall be hastening to their Rabb.
They will say: Ah woe to us! Who has roused us from our sleeping-place? This is what the Compassionate had promised, and truly spoke the sent ones.
It shall be but one Shout, and lo! They shall all be brought together before Us.
Today no soul shall be wronged at all; nor shall you be requited but for what you have been doing.
Verily the dwellers of the Garden, today shall be happily employed.
They and their mates shall be reclining on couches in shade.
Theirs shall be fruit therein, and theirs shall be whatsoever they ask for.
Peace shall be the word from the Rabb Merciful.
And separate yourselves, this Day, O you culprits!
Children of Adam! Did I not enjoin you that you shall not serve Satan, verily he is your manifest foe?
And that, you shall worship Me! This is the straight path.
And yet he has assuredly led astray a great multitude of you. Why do you not reflect?
Over there is Hell, which you were promised.
Roast therein Today for that you have been disbelieving.
Today We will seal up their mouths, and their hands shall speak to Us and their feet shall bear witness to what they have been earning.
And if We willed, We would surely wipe out their eyes so that they would struggle for the way; how then would they see?
And if we willed, We would surely transform them in their places, so that they would be able neither to go forward nor to return.
And whom We grant long life We reverse him in creation; why then they do not reflect?
And We have not taught him poetry, nor does it become him. This is but an Admonition and a luminous Recital.
In order that it may warn him who is alive, and that the sentence may be justified on the infidels.
Do they not see that We have created for them, of what Our hands have created, cattle, so that they are their owners.
And to them We have subdued so that some of them they have for riding. And on some they feed?
And they have therefrom other benefits and drinks. Will they not then give thanks?
And they have taken besides Allah gods, hoping that they may perchance be succoured.
They are not able to give them succour, whereas they shall be against them.
So let not their speech grieve you. Verily We! We know what they conceal and what they disclose.
Does not man see that We have created him of sperm? Yet lo! He is a manifest opponent.
And he recounts for Us a similitude and forgets his creation. He says: Who shall quicken the bones after they are decayed?
Say you: He shall quicken them Who brought them forth for the first time. And He is the Knower of every manner of a creation.
Who gives you fire out of the green tree, and lo! You kindle therewith.
Is not He Who created the heavens and earth for the first time able to create the like of them? Yea! He is the Supreme Creator, the Knower.
His affair, when He intends a thing, is only that He says to it: Be, and it is.
Wherefore hallowed be He, in Whose Hand is the governance of everything, and to Whom you shall be returned.
By the angels ranged in ranks.
By the angels driving away.
By the angels reciting the praise.
Verily your God is One.
Rabb of the heavens and the earth, and what is in-between, and Rabb of the East.
Verily We! We have adorned the nether heaven with adornment - the stars.
And have placed therein a guard against any devil froward.
They cannot listen to the exalted assembly, and they are darted at from every side.
With a driving fusillade, and theirs shall be a perpetual torment!
Except him who snatches away a word by stealth and then pursues him a glowing flame.
Ask them you: Are they stronger in structure or those others whom We have created? Verily We! We have created them of a sticky clay.
Verily you marvel, and they scoff.
And when they are admonished, they receive no admonition.
And when they see a Sign, they turn to scoffing.
And they say: This Qurān is nothing but a manifest magic.
When we have become dead and become dust and bones, shall we then verily be raised?
And also our forefathers?
Say you: Yea! And verily then you shall be despicable.
It shall be a single shout, and lo! They shall be staring.
And they will say: Woe unto us this is the Day of Requital.
This is the Day of Judgment, which you used to belie.
Assemble together those who did wrong and their companions, and what they used to worship.
Beside Allah, and lead them on to the path of Flaming Fire.
And stop them; verily they are to be questioned.
What is the matter with you that you do not succour one another?
Nay! On that Day they will be entirely submissive.
And they will advance towards each other mutually questioning.
They will say: Verily you! You used to come to us imposing.
They will say: Nay! You yourselves were unbelievers.
And we had over you no authority, but you were a people exorbitant.
So on us h been justified the sentence of our Rabb: surely we are to t-ASte.
We seduced you astray; verily we were ourselves the seduced ones.
So on the Day they all will be sharers in the torment.
Verily We, We in this way deal with the culprits.
Of a surety, when it was said to them: There is none worthy of worship but Allah, they grew stiff-necked.
And said: Are we going to abandon our gods on account of a poet distracted?
Aye! He has come with the truth and he confirms the sent ones.
Verily you are going to taste a torment afflictive.
And you shall be requited not except for what you have been working.
But the bondmen of Allah, the sincere ones.
Those! Theirs shall be a provision known.
Fruits; and they shall be honoured.
In Gardens of delight.
On couches, facing one another.
Round shall be passed a cup unto them, filled with limpid drink.
White; delicious to the drinkers.
No headiness there shall be in it, nor shall they be inebriated with it.
And with them shall be damsels of refraining looks large-eyed.
As though they were eggs. preserved.
Then they will advance towards one another, mutually questioning.
And a speaker from among them will say: Verily there was a mate of mine.
Who said: Are you of them who confess to the doctrine of Resurrection.
Are we, when we are dead and have become dust and bones, going to be requited?
Allah will say: Will you look down?
Then he will look down and see him in the midst of the Flaming Fire.
And he will say: By Allah, you have what caused me to perish.
And but for the favour of my Rabb, I would have been of those brought forward.
Are we then not to die any more?
Save our first death, and are we not to be chastised?
Verily this! That is the supreme achievement.
For the like of it let the workers work.
Is this better as an entertainment or the tree of Zaqūm?
Verily We! We have made it a temptation for the ungodly.
Verily it is a tree that springs forth in the bottom of Flaming Fire.
The fruit of it is as though it were the hoods of the serpents.
And verily they must eat of it and must fill their bellies from it.
And on the top of it thereafter they shall have a drink of boiling water.
And thereafter their return is verily to the Flaming Fire.
Verily they found their fathers gone astray.
So they are rushing in their footsteps.
And assuredly many of the ancients went astray before them.
And assuredly We sent warners among them.
So behold what has been the end of those who had been warned.
Save the sincere bondmen of Allah.
And assuredly Nuh cried unto Us and We are the Best of the answerers.
And We rescued him and his people from the great affliction.
And his offspring! Them We made the survivors.
And for him We left among the posterity.
Peace be on Nuh among the worlds.
Verily We! We thus recompense the well-doers.
Verily he was of Our believing bondmen.
Then We drowned the others.
And of his sect was Ibrahim.
Recall when he came to his Rabb with a whole heart.
Recall when he said to his father and his people: What is it that you worship?
Is it a falsehood-gods besides Allah that you seek?
What then, is your opinion of the Rabb of the worlds?
Then he cast a glance on the stars.
And he said: I am about to be sick.
Then they departed from him turning their backs.
Then he slipped to their gods and said: Do you not eat?
What is the matter that you do not speak?
Then he slipped to them striking them with his right hand.
Then they advanced toward him, hastening.
He said: Do you worship what you carve.
Whereas Allah has created you and what you make.
They said: Build for him a building and cast him into the flaming fire.
And they devised a plot for him, but We made them the humble.
And he said: Verily I am going to my Rabb Who will guide me.
Rabb! Bestow on me a son who will be of the righteous.
Wherefore We gave him the glad tidings of a gentle boy.

And when the boy attained the age of running with him, he said: Son! I have seen in a dream that I am slaughtering you; so look, what consider you? He said: Father! Do what you are commanded: You will find me, Allah willing, of the patient.
Then when the twain submitted themselves, and he had flung him down on his face.
We cried to him: Ibrāhīm!
Of a surety you have fulfilled the vision. Verily We! Thus do We recompense the well-doers.
Verily that! That was a manifest trial.
And We ransomed him with a mighty victim.
And for him We left among the posterity:
Peace be upon Ibrāhīm.
Verily We! Thus do We recompense the well-doers.
Verily he was of Our believing bondmen.
And We gave him the glad tidings of Ishāq, a Prophet, and of the righteous.
And We blessed him and Ishāq, and of their offspring some are well-doers, and some who wrong themselves manifestly.
And delivered them and their people from the great affliction
And We succoured them, so they became the victors.
And We vouchsafed to the twain a Book luminous.
And We led the twain on to the straight path.
And We left for the twain among the posterity.
Peace be unto Musa and Harun.
Verily We! Thus do We recompense the pious.
Verily the twain were of Our believing bondmen.
And verily, Ilyas was of the sent ones.
Recall when he said to his people: Do you not fear?
Do you call upon B’al, and forsake the Best of creators?
Allah, your Rabb, and the Rabb of your forefathers?
Except the sincere bondmen of Allah.
And We left for him among the posterity.
Peace be on Ilyāsīn.
Verily We! Thus do We recompense the well-doers.
Verily he was of Our believing bondmen.
And verily Lūṭ was among the sent ones.
Recall when We delivered him and his household, all.
Save an old woman among the lingerers.
Then We annihilated the others.
And surely you pass by them in the morning.
And at night, will you not then reflect?
And verily Yunus was of the sent ones.
Recall when he ran away to a laden ship.
Then he joined the lots and was of the condemned.
And fish swallowed him, while he was reproaching himself.
And had he not been of them who hallow Him.
He would have tarried in its belly till the Day when they are raised.
Then We cast him on a bare desert whilst he was sick.
And We caused to grow over him a tree, a gourd.
And We had sent him to a hundred thousand. Rather they exceeded.
And they believed; so We let them enjoy life for a season.
Now you ask them: Are there daughters for your Rabb and sons for them?
Or did We create angels female while they were witnesses?
Lo! Verily it is of their falsehood that they say:
Allah has begotten. Verily they are the liars.
Has He chosen daughters above sons?
What ails you? How do you judge?
Will you not then be admonished?
Or, is there for you a clear authority?
Then bring your Book, if you are truthful.
And they have made a kinship between Him and the Jinn, whereas the Jinn assuredly know that they are to be brought up.
Hallowed be Allah from what they associate to Him
Except the sincere bondmen of Allah.
So neither you nor what you worship.
Can tempt anyone to rebel against Him.
Save him who is to roast in the Flaming Fire.
None of us there is but has a station assigned.
And verily we! We are ranged in ranks.
And verily we! We hallow.
And they surely used to say:
Had we an admonition as had the ancients.
Surely we would have been the sincere bondmen of Allah.
Yet they disbelieve therein: Presently they shall come to know.
And assuredly Our Word has gone forth for Our bondmen, the sent ones.
That verily they shall be made triumphant.
And verily Our host! They are to overcome.
So turn you aside from them for a season.
And you see them, they themselves shall presently see.
Do they seek Our torment to hasten on?
Then when it descends to them, face to face, a hapless morn that shall be for those who had been warned.
And turn you aside from them for a season.
And see you They themselves shall presently see.
Hallowed be your Rabb, the Rabb of Majesty, from what they associate to Him!
And peace be unto the sent ones.
And all praise to Allah, the Rabb of the worlds!
Şād. By the Qurān full of admonition.
Verily those who disbelieve are in vainglory and schism.
How many a generation We have destroyed before them and they cried, but the time to flee was past.
And they marvel that there should come to them a warmer from amongst them. And the infidels say: This is magic and a lie.
Does he make the gods, One God? Surely that is a thing extraordinary.
The chiefs among them departed saying: Go and persevere in your gods; surely this is a thing designed.
We have not heard of it in the later faith; this is nothing but an invention.
What has, out of us, been sent down upon him the admonition? Yea! They are in doubt concerning My admonition. Yea! They have not yet tasted My chastisement.
Or is it that with them there are treasures of the Mercy of your Rabb, the Bestower?
Or is it that theirs is the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is in between? If so, let them ascend by steps.
Here there is a host of the confederates only to be defeated.
Before them there have belied the people of Nūḥ and the 'Ād and the Pharaoh, the owner of the stakes.
And the Thamūd, and the people of Lūṭ, and the dwellers of the wood, these were the confederates.
There was not one but did not believe the Messengers; so My wrath was just.
And these wait but for one cry which will not be deferred.
And they say: Our Rabb! Hasten our portion to us before the Day of Reckoning.
Bear you with what they say, and remember Our bondman Daūd, endued with strength; verily he was off-returning to Us.
Verily We so subjected the mountains that they hallowed Us with him at nightfall and sunrise.
And so did the birds also, gathering, all oft returning to Him on his account.
And We strengthened his dominion and vouchsafed to him wisdom and decisive speech.
And has the news of the contending parties reached you, when they walled his apartment?

When they went in to Daūd, he was frightened at them. They said: Have no fear, we are two contending parties. One of us has oppressed the other, so judge between us with truth, and be not iniquitous, and guide us to the even path.
Verily this my brother has ninety-nine ewes while I have a solitary ewe, and he says: Entrust it to me, and he has overcome me in argument.

Daūd said: Assuredly he has wronged you in demanding your ewe in addition to his ewes and surely many of the partners oppress each other save such as believe and work righteous deeds, and few are they. And Daūd imagined that We had tried him. So he asked forgiveness of his Rabb, and he fell down bowing and turned in penitence.
So We forgave him that, and verily for him is an access to Us and a happy retreat.

O Daūd! We have appointed you a vicegerent in the earth, so judge between mankind with truth, and do not follow your desire, lest it cause you to err from the Path of Allah. Verily those who err from the Path of Allah, to them shall be a severe torment for they ignored the Day of Resurrection.
And We have not created the heavens and the earth and what is in between in vain. That is the conjecture of those who disbelieve. And woe unto those who disbelieve the Fire!
Shall We make those who believe and work righteous deeds like the corrupters in the earth? Or shall We make the pious like the ungodly?
This is a Book blessed, We have sent down unto you that they may ponder the revelations thereof, and that there may be admonished men of understanding.
And We vouchsafed to Daūd Sulaiman. An excellent bondman! He was oft-returning.
Recall when there were presented to him at eventide coursers swift-footed.
He said Verily I have loved earthly good above the remembrance of my Rabb until the sun has disappeared behind the veil.
Bring them back to me, and he set about slashing their legs and necks.
And assuredly We tried Sulaiman, and set upon his throne a mere body. And then he was penitent.
He said, Rabb! Forgive me, and bestow on me a dominion, which no one may obtain besides me. Verily You! You are the Bestower.
