Then We subjected to him the wind; it ran gently by his command witherward he directed.
And We subjected to him the evil ones: Every builder and diver.
And others abound in fetters.
This is Our gift, so spend you or withhold, without rendering an account.
And verily for him is an approach to Us, and a happy end.
And remember you Our bondman Ayyub when he cried to his Rabb: Verily Satan has touched me with affliction and suffering.
Stamp the ground with your foot; here is water, to wash in, cool, and to drink.
And We bestowed on him his household and along with them the like thereof, out of Mercy from Us, and a remembrance to men of understanding.
And take in your hand a handful of twigs, and strike with it and break not your oath. Verily We! We found him patient. An excellent bondman! Verily he was oft returning.
And remember you Our bondmen, Ibrāhīm and Ishāq and Ya'qūb all owners of might and vision.
Verily We! We distinguished them with a distinct quality. The remembrance of the Abode.
And verily they are of the elect of the excellent ones with Us.
And remember Ismā'il and Al-Yas'a and Zulkifl; all of the excellent ones.
This is an admonition. And verily for the pious is a happy retreat.
Gardens Everlasting, the portals of which remain opened for them.
Therein they will recline; therein they will call for plenteous fruit and drink.
And with them will be virgins of refraining looks and of equal age.
This it is which you are promised for the Day of Resurrection.
Verily this is of Our provision; there will be no ceasing of it.
This for the righteous. And verily for the exorbitant there shall be an evil retreat.
Hell, wherein they roast, a wretched couch.
This – let them taste it, scalding water and corruption.
And other torments, like them conjoined.
This is a crowd, rushing in along with you; no welcome for them; they are to roast in the Fire.
They will say: Nay! It is you for whom there is no welcome; it is you who have brought it upon us. Ill shall be their resting-place.
They will say: Our Rabb! Whosoever has brought this upon us, to him increase doubly the torment of the Fire.
And they will say: What is the matter that we do not see the men whom we counted among the evil ones.
Did we take them for a butt of mockery, so unjustly, or are they deluding our eyes?
Verily this is very truth: This wrangling of the inmates of the Fire.
Say you: I am but a warner, and there is no god but Allah, the One, the Subduer.
Rabb of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is in-between them, the Mighty, the Forgiver.
Say you: It is a great news.
You are averting there from.
I had no knowledge of the chiefs on high when they were disputing.
Nothing is revealed to me except that I am a manifest warner.
Recall when your Rabb said to the angels: I am about to create a human being from clay.
Then when I have created him and breathed into him of My Spirit, fall down before him prostrate.
The angels fell prostrate, all of them.
Not so Iblis. He grew stiff-necked, and became of the infidels.
Allah said: Iblis! What does prevent you from prostrating yourself before what I have created with my both hands? Have you been stiff-necked, or are you of the exalted ones.
Iblis said: I am better than he, me You have created of fire, and him You have created of clay.
Allah said: Get you forth herefrom, verily you are driven away.
And verily My curse shall be on you till the Day of Requital.
Iblis said: Rabb! Respite me till the Day whereon they are raised up.
Allah said: Verily you are of those respited.
Till the Day of the time appointed.
Iblis said: By Your Majesty, then I shall surely seduce them all.
Save Your sincere bondmen among them.
Allah said: The truth is, and it is the truth I always say,
That I shall fill Hell with you and such of them as shall follow you, all together.
Say you: I ask of you no wage for it nor am I of the affecters.
It is nothing but an admonition to the worlds.
And you shall surely come to know of its truth after a time.
The revelation of this Book is from Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.
Verily We! We have sent down the Book to you with truth: So worship you Allah, making religion pure for Him.

Lo! For Allah is the pure religion only, and those who take patrons besides Him, saying We do not worship them save in order that they may bring us closer to Allah — verily Allah will judge between them concerning that wherein they differ. Verily Allah does not guide him who is a liar and ingrate.
Had Allah willed to take a son, He would have chosen whomsoever He pleased out of what He has created. Hallowed be He! He is Allah, the One, the Subduer.
He has created the heavens and the earth with a purpose. He rolls the night around the day, and He rolls the day around the night and He has subjected the sun and the

He created you of a single soul and made his spouse therefrom; and of the cattle He sent down to you eight kinds. He creates you in the bellies of your mothers, one creation after creation, in threefold darkness. Such is Allah, your Rabb. His is the dominion, there is no god but He. Whither then turn you away?

If you disbelieve, then verily Allah is Independent of you. And he does not approve of infidelity in His bondmen. And if you return thanks, He approves of that in you. No burdened soul shall have another's burden. Your return is thereafter to your Rabb, and He shall declare to you what you have been doing, verily He is Knower of innumerate secrets.

And when some hurt touches man, he calls upon his Rabb, turning to Him in penitence. Then, when He bestows upon him a favour from Himself, he forgets that for which he had called on Him before, and sets up peers to Allah that he may lead astray others from His Path. Say you: Enjoy you life in your infidelity for a while, verily you are of the inmates of the Fire.

Is he who is devout in the watches of the night prostrating himself and standing, bewaring of the Hereafter and hoping for the Mercy of his Rabb to be dealt with like a wicked infidel? Say you: Shall they who know and those who know not be held equal? It is only men of understanding who receive admonition.

Say you: My faithful bondmen! Fear your Rabb. For those who do good in this world there is good; and Allah's earth is spacious. Surely the steadfast will be paid their wages in full without reckoning.
Say you: Verily I am bidden to worship Allah, making religion exclusive for Him.
And I am bidden this, in order that I may be the first of those who submit.
Say you: I fear, if I disobeyed my Rabb, chastisement of an awful Day.
Say you: It is Allah I worship, making faith for Him exclusive.
So worship whatever you will besides Him O pagans! Say you: The real losers are those who shall have lost themselves and their households on the Day of Judgment. Lo! That will be a manifest loss.
For them! Coverings of Fire will be above them and beneath them. With this Allah frightens His bondmen. My bondmen, therefore, fear Me.
And those who shun the devils lest they should worship them and turn to Allah in penitence, for them are glad tidings. So give you glad tidings to My bondmen.
Who listen to the Word and follow the best thereof. Those are they whom Allah has guided, and those are men of understanding.
Is he then on whom is justified the decree of torment - will you rescue him who is in the Fire?
But those who fear their Rabb, for them are lofty chambers with lofty chambers above them, built, where under rivers flow. The Promise of Allah, and Allah fails not his appointment.

Do you not see that Allah sends down water from the sky, and causes it to enter springs in the earth, and thereby produces corn various-coloured. Thereafter it withers and you see it turn yellow. Then He makes it chaff. Verily herein is admonition for men of understanding.

Shall he then whose breast Allah has expanded for Islam, so that he follows a light from his Rabb be as he whose heart is hardened? Then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against Allah's Ẓikr. They are in error manifest.

Allah has revealed the most excellent discourse, a Book consimilar, off-repeated, at which trembles the skins of those who fear their Rabb; then their skins and hearts soften to Allah's Ẓikr. This is Allah's guidance to which He guides whom He will; and whom Allah sends astray, for him there is no guide.

Is he, then who will shield himself with his face from the evils of torment on the Day of Resurrection be as he who is secure therefrom? And it will be said to the ungodly: taste what you have been earning.
Those who belied before them, on them came the torment from whence they knew not.
Allah made them taste humiliation in this world; and surely the torment of the Hereafter is greater - if they but know.
And assuredly We have propounded in this Qurān every manner of similitudes for mankind that perhaps they may reflect.
An Arabic Qurān, without any crookedness, that perhaps they may fear.
Allah propounds a similitude. A man has several partners quarrelling, and a man belonging to one man. Are the two equal in likeness? But most of them know not.
Verily you are mortal and they are mortals.
Then on the Day of Resurrection you shall be contending before your Rabb.
And who is a greater wrongdoer than he who fabricates a lie against Allah, and belies the truth when it comes to him? Will not the abode of the infidels be in Hell?
And whoever brings the truth and whoever gives credence to it – these! They are the pious.
Theirs shall be whatever they will desire with their Rabb, that is the wage of the well doers.
This will be in order that Allah may expiate from them the evil of what they may have worked, and may recompense them their wage for the best of what they have been working.
Is Allah not sufficient for His bondmen? Yet they would frighten you with those besides Him. And whom Allah sends astray, for him there will be no guide.
And whom Allah guides, for him there will be no misleaders. Is not Allah Mighty and Rabb of Retribution?

Were you to ask them: Who has created the heavens and the earth? They will surely say: Allah. Say you: Consider you then that those whom you call upon besides Allah, could they, if Allah intended some hurt for me, remove His hurt? Or if He intended some Mercy for me, could they withhold His Mercy? Say you: Enough for me is Allah; in Him the trusting put their trust.
Say you: O my people! Act according to your station; I am going to act in my way, presently you shall come to know.
On whom comes a humiliating torment and on whom alights a lasting torment.

Verily We! We have sent down to you the Book for mankind with truth. Then whoever receives guidance it is for his own soul, and whoever strays, strays only to its hurt; and you are not a guardian over them.

Allah it is Who takes away the souls at the time of their death and those who do not die in their sleep; then He withholds those on whom He has decreed death, and sends back the rest for an appointed term. Verily herein are Signs for those who ponder.
Have they taken others for intercessors besides Allah? Say: What! Even though they own not anything and understand not?
Say you: Allah's is intercession altogether. His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth; then to Him you shall be returned.
When mention is made of Allah alone, the hearts of those who believe not in the Hereafter shrink with aversion; and when mention is made of those besides Him, lo! They rejoice.
Say: Allah! Creator of the heavens and the earth! Knower of the hidden and the open! You shall judge between them concerning what they have been differing in.

And were the ungodly to own all that is on the earth, and with it as much again, they will seek surely to ransom therewith from the torment of the Day of Judgment, and there will become apparent to them from Allah what they had not been reckoning.
And there will become apparent to them the evils they earned, and
When hurt touches a man he calls on Us, then when We have changed it into a favour from Us, he says: I have obtained it by force of my knowledge. Aye! It is a trial, but most of them know not.
Surely said it those before them, yet there did not avail them what they have been earning.
And there befell them the evils of what they had earned. And of them they who go wrong – presently will befall them the evil of what they earn; nor can they frustrate.
Do they not know that Allah expands provision for whom He will, and stints it for whom He will? Verily herein are Signs for them who believe.
Say you: O My bondmen who have committed extravagance
Turn penitently to your Rabb, and submit to Him, before there comes to you the torment, and then you shall not be succoured.
And follow the best of what has been sent down to you from your Rabb before there comes to you the torment of a sudden, while you perceive not.
Lest a soul should say: Alas! For that I have been remiss in respect of Allah, and I was but of the scoffers!
Or, lest it should say: Had Allah but guided me, I would surely have been of the pious!
Or, lest it should say when it beholds the torment: Were there for me a return I would be of the well doers.
Yea! Surely there came to you My revelations, but you belied them and were stiff-necked and were of the infidels.
And on the Day of Judgment you shall see those who lied against Allah – their faces blackened. Is not the abode of the stiff-necked in Hell?
And Allah will deliver them who feared Him to their place of safety. Evil will not touch them, nor will they grieve.
Allah is the Creator of everything, and He is a Trustee over everything.
His are the keys of the heavens and the earth; and those who disbelieve in the revelations of Allah – those! They are the losers.
Say you: Is it other than Allah that you call me to worship, O you pagans!
And assuredly it has been revealed to you and to those before you: If you join partners to Allah surely of no effect shall be made your work, and you shall surely be of the losers.
Aye! Allah must you worship, and be among the thankful.

And they do not estimate Allah with an estimation due to Him, whereas the whole earth shall be His handful on the Day of Judgment, and the heavens shall be rolled in His right hand. Hallowed be He and Exalted above what they associate.

And the trumpet shall be blown, when all who are in the heavens and all who are on the earth shall swoon away, save whom Allah wills. Then it shall be blown again, and lo! They shall be standing, looking on.

And the earth will gleam with the light of the Rabb and the Record will be set up, and the Prophets and the witnesses will be brought, and the judgement between them will be given with truth, and they will not be wronged.
Every soul will be paid in full what it has worked; and He is the Best Knower of what they do.

And those who disbelieve will be driven to Hell in troops till when they arrive thereto, its portals will be opened, and its keepers will say to them: Did not there come to you Messengers from amongst you, rehearsing to you the revelations of your Rabb and warning you of the meeting of this your Day? They will say: Yea! But the word of chastisement has been justified on the infidels.
It will be said: Enter the portals of Hell to be abiders therein. How ill, then is the abode of the stiff-necked!

And those who feared their Rabb will be driven to the Garden in troops till when they arrive thereto, and its portals will be opened, and its keepers will say to them: Peace be to you! Excellent are you, enter it as abiders.

And they will say: All praise to Allah, Who has made good His Promise to us, and made us inherit this land, so that we may dwell in the Garden wherever we will! Excellent, then, is the wage of the workers!

And you will see the angels thronging round the Throne, hallowing the Praise of their Rabb. And Judgment will be given between them with truth; and it will be said: All Praise to Allah, the Rabb of the worlds.
Hā Mim
The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Mighty, the Knower.
The Forgiver of sin, Accepter of repentance, Severe in chastisement, Rabb of Power. No god is there but He, to Him is the journeying.
None dispute concerning the revelations of Allah save those who disbelieve, so let not their going about in the cities beguile you.

The people of Nūh and the confederates after them, belied their Messengers before these, and every disbelieving community advanced towards their Messenger that they may seize him, and disputed with vain talk, that they may confute the truth thereby. So I seized them, and how terrible was My chastisement!
And thus has the Word of your Rabb been justified on them who disbelieve, that they shall be the inmates of the Fire.

Those who bear the Throne, and those who are round about it, hallow the Praise of their Rabb and believe in Him and ask forgiveness for the faithful, saying: Our Rabb! You comprehend everything in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who repent and follow Your Path, and protect them from the torment of the Flaming Fire.

Our Rabb! Make them enter the Everlasting Gardens, which You have promised them, and also such of their fathers and their wives and their offspring as are fit. Verily You! You are the Mighty, the Wise.
And guard them against evils. And whom You shall protect from evils and the Day, him You have certainly taken into Mercy. And that, it is a mighty achievement.
Verily those who disbelieve – they will be cried unto: Surely Allah's abhorrence was greater than is your abhorrence toward yourselves, when you were called to belief, and you rejected.
They will say: Our Rabb! You have made us die twice, and You have made us live twice, now we confess our sins, is there no getting out any way?
That is because when Allah Alone was called upon you denied: And when some one was associated with Him you believed. So the judgement is of Allah, the Exalted, the Great.
He it is Who shows you His Signs and sends down provision for you from the heaven, and none receives admonition save him who turns in penitence.
Therefore call to Allah, making faith pure for Him, averse as the infidels may be.
He is lofty in degrees, Rabb of the Throne. He casts the Spirit of His Command upon whomsoever He wills of His bondmen, that he may warn the people of the Day of Meeting.
The Day whereon they will appear, nothing of them will be concealed from Allah. Whose is the dominion today? It is of Allah, the One, the Subduer.
Today every soul will be recompensed for what it has earned, no wrong doing today, verily Allah is Swift at Reckoning.
Warn them you of the Day of Portending whereon the hearts will be in the throats, choking, then for the ungodly there will be no ardent friend nor an intercessor to be given heed to.
He knows the fraud of the eyes, and what the breasts conceal.
Allah decrees with truth, while those whom they call upon beside Allah cannot decree anything. Verily Allah: He is the Hearer, the Beholder!

Have they not travelled about in the land so that they may see how has been the end of those who were before them? They were mightier than these in strength and in the traces in the land. Yet Allah seized them for their sins, and from Allah they had none as protector.
This, because their Messengers used to bring them evidences, but they disbelieved: So Allah seized them. Verily He is Strong, Severe in chastisement.
This assuredly We sent Mūsa with Our Signs; and a clear authority.
To the Pharaoh, Hāmān and Qārūn; but they said: A magician, a liar.
And when he came to them with truth from before Us they said: Slay the sons of those who have believed with him and let their women live. And the plot of the infidels was nothing but vain.
And said the Pharaoh: Leave me alone, that I may slay Mūsa and let him call upon his Rabb. I fear that he may change your religion or that he may cause disruption in the land.
And said Mūsa: Verily I seek refuge in my Rabb and your Rabb from every stiff-necked person who does not believe in the Day of Reckoning.

And a believing man of the Pharaoh's household, hiding his faith, said: Would you slay a man because he says, my Rabb is Allah, and has come to you with evidences from your Rabb? If he is an impostor, upon him will be his imposture, but if he is truthful, then shall befall you some of what he threatens you with. Verily Allah does not guide any one extravagant or a liar.

My people! Yours is the kingdom today, you are being triumphant in the land; but who will succour us against the scourge of Allah if it comes to us? The Pharaoh said: I show you only what I see; and I guide you to the path of rectitude.
And he who believed said: My people! I fear for you a fate like that of the factions of the old.
Like the fate of the people of Nūḥ and 'Ād and Thamūd and those after them; and Allah does not intend any wrong to His bondmen.
And, my people! I fear for you a day of Mutual Calling.
A Day whereon you shall turn away retreating; for you there will be no protector from Allah and he whom Allah sends astray, for him there is no guide.

And assuredly earlier there came to you Yūsuf with evidences, yet you ceased not to be in doubt concerning what be brought to you, until he died, and you said: Allah will by no means raise a Messenger after him. Thus does Allah keeps astray one who is extravagant and a doubter.

Those who wrangle concerning the Signs of Allah without any authority that has come to them. It is greatly abhorrent to Allah and to those who believe. Thus Allah seals up the heart of every stiff-necked highhanded person.
And the Pharaoh said: Hāmān! Build for me a tower that I may reach the roads.

The roads of the heavens so that I may mount up to the God of Mūsa, and surely I believe him to be a liar. And thus fair seeming to the Pharaoh was made the evil of his work, and he was hindered from the Path. And the plot of the Pharaoh ended only in perdition.
And he who had believed said: My people! Follow me, and I shall guide you to the path of rectitude.
My people! The life of this world is only a passing enjoyment, and verily the Hereafter! That is the Abode of rest.

Whoever works an evil, he shall not be requited except the like thereof, and whoever, male or female, works righteously, and is a believer - they will enter a Garden wherein they shall be provided for without measure.
And, my people! How is it that I call you unto salvation, while you call me to the Fire?
You call me for this, that I should blaspheme against Allah, and associate with Him that of which I have no knowledge, while I call you to the Mighty, the Forgiver.
Undoubtedly you only call me to what is not to be invoked in this world nor in the Hereafter, and verily our return shall be to Allah; and the extravagant! They shall be the inmates of the Fire.
And soon you shall remember what I am telling you. I confide my affair to Allah; verily Allah is the Beholder of His bondmen.
So Allah protected him from the ills, which they plotted, and the evil of the torment surrounded the household of the Pharaoh.
The Fire! They are exposed thereto morning and evening. And on the Day whereon the Hour will rise, it will be said: Cause the household of the Pharaoh to enter the most grievous torment.

And consider what time they will wrangle in the Fire together, and the oppressed will say to the stiff-necked: Verily we have been unto you a following; are you going to avail us against a portion of the Fire?
Those who were stiff-necked will say: Verily we are all in it; Verily Allah has judged between His bondmen.
And those in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell: Pray to your Rabb that He may lighten for us a day of torment.
They will say: Did not there come to you your Messengers with evidences? They will say: Yea! They will say: Pray then yourselves. And the praying of the infidels is but in wandering.
Verily! We shall surely succour Our Messengers and those who believe, both in the life of this world and on a Day whereon the witnesses will stand forth.
A Day whereon their excuse will not profit the ungodly. Theirs will be curse and theirs will be the evil Abode.
And assuredly We vouchsafed to Mūsa the guidance and We caused the Children of Isrāil to inherit the Book.
A guidance and an admonition to men of understanding.
So be steadfast. The Promise of Allah is true; and ask forgiveness for your fault; and hallow the praise of your Rabb at evening and dawn.

Verily those who wrangle concerning the revelations of Allah without an authority having come to them - nothing is there in their breasts save ambitions, which they shall not achieve. Seek refuge you then in Allah; verily He! He is the Hearer, the Beholder.
The creation of the heavens and the earth is indeed greater than the creation of mankind; Yet most of mankind know not.
Not equal are the blind and the seeing, nor those who believe and work righteous deeds and the wicked. Little are you admonished.
Verily the Hour is coming; there is no doubt thereof, yet most of mankind believe not.
And your Rabb has said: Call upon Me, and I shall answer you. Verily those who are stiff-necked against My worship, now they will enter Hell abject.
Allah it is Who has made the night that you may repose therein, and the day enlightening. Verily Allah is the Rabb of Grace for mankind: yet most of mankind return not thanks.
Such is Allah, your Rabb the Creator of everything; there is no god but He. Whither then are you straying away?
In this way those who were used to gainsay the Signs of Allah have strayed away.

Allah it is Who has made the earth for you a resting place and the sky a structure; and fashioned you and fashioned well, and provided for you goodly things. Such is Allah, your Rabb! So blessed be Allah, the Rabb of the worlds.
He is the Living; no god there is but He. So call upon Him, making faith pure for Him. All praise for Allah, the Rabb of the worlds.

Say you; verily I am forbidden that I should worship those whom you call upon besides Allah when evidences have come to me from my Rabb, and I am commanded that I should submit to the Rabb of the worlds.

He it is Who created you of dust, and then of a drop, and then of a clot, and then He brings you forth as an infant, and then He ordains that you attain your full strength, and then that you become old men - though some of you die earlier - and that you attain the appointed term; and that perhaps you may reflect.
He it is Who causes life and death; and whence He decrees an affair He only says to it: Be, and it becomes.
Do you not see those who wrangle concerning the revelations of Allah, whither are they turning away?
Those who belie the Book and the Message with which We sent Our Messengers, presently they will come to know..
When shackles will be on their necks and also chains; they will be dragged.
Into the boiling water, then into the Fire they will be stocked.
Then it will be said to them; where are those whom you have been associating?
Besides Allah? They will say: They have failed us: Aye! We have not been calling on anything before. Thus does Allah lead the infidels astray.
That is because you had been exulting in the earth without any right, and because you had been strutting.
Enter you the gates of Hell, as abiders therein. Hapless is the abode of the stiff-necked.
Wherefore you be steadfast, verily the promise of Allah is true. Then whether We let you see a portion of what we have promised them, or whether We cause you to die, to Us they all will be returned.

Assuredly We have sent Messengers before you: Of them are some whose story We have recounted to you. And it was not possible for any Messenger to bring a Sign save by Allah’s leave. So when comes the command of Allah, judgement will be given with truth, and then the followers of falsehood will lose.
Allah it is Who has made cattle for you, that you may ride on some of them, and of others you eat.
And for you there are other benefits in them, and that you may attain through them any desire that is in your breasts; and upon them and upon the ships you are borne.
And He shows you His Signs, which, then, of the Signs of Allah will you deny?

Have they not travelled on the earth that they may behold how has been the end of those before them? They were more numerous than these, and mightier in strength and the traces in the land. But nothing availed them of what they had been earning.
And when their Messengers came to them with evidences, they exulted in the knowledge they had with them, and there surrounded them what they had been mocking.
Then when they beheld Our Prowess they said: We believe in Allah alone, and we disbelieve in what we have been associating with Him.
But their belief profited them naught when they had seen Our Prowess. This is Allah's dispensation that has been in regard to His bondmen. And lost were the infidels then and there.
Hā. Mīm.
This is revelation from Allah, the Compassionate, the Merciful.
A Book whereof the verses are detailed; an Arabic Qurān; for a people who know.
A bearer of glad tidings and a warner. Yet most of them turn aside, so that they listen not.
And they say: Our hearts are under a veil from what you call us to, and in our ears is heaviness, and there is a curtain between us and you; so work you, we are also working.
Say you: I am only a human being like you; only it is revealed to me that your God is but One God, so take the straight path to Him, and seek forgiveness of Him, and woe be to the associators.
Who pay not Zakāt, and they! Disbelievers they are in the Hereafter!
Verily those who believe and work righteous deeds - to them shall be a wage unceasing.
Say you: Are you indeed those who disbelieve in Him Who has created the earth in two days, and set up peers unto Him? That is the Rabb of the worlds.
And He placed therein mountains firmly rooted, rising above it, and He blessed it, and ordained therein the sustenance thereof, all this in four days, complete; this for the inquirers.
He thereafter turned to the heaven, and it was as smoke, and said to it and to the earth: Do you twain come willingly or loth? They said: We come willingly.

Then He decreed them as seven heavens in two days, and revealed to each heaven the command thereof. And We bedecked the nether heaven with lamps and placed therein a guard. That is the ordinance of the Mighty, the Knower.
Then if they still turn away, say you: I warn you of a calamity of the 'Ād and Thamūd.
Recall when the Messengers came to them from before them and

As for the 'Ad, they grew stiff- necked on the earth without justification, and said: Who is mightier in strength than we? Did they not see that Allah Who created them - He was mightier in strength than they? And they used to deny Our Signs.

Wherefore We sent upon them a raging wind in inauspicious days, so that We might make them taste the torment of humiliation in the life of this world, and surely the torment of the Hereafter will be more humiliating, nor will they be succoured.
And as for the Thamūd, We guided them, but they preferred blindness to guidance, wherefore the bolt of the torment of abjection struck them because of what they had been earning.
And We delivered those who believed and used to keep their duty to Allah.
And on the Day when the enemies of Allah will be gathered towards the Fire, they will be set in bands.
Until when they come to it their ears and their sights and their skins will bear witness against them of what they had been working.

And they will say to their skins: Why do you bear witness against us? They will say: Allah has caused us to speak, as He causes everything to speak, and Who created you the first time, and to Whom you are now caused to return.

And you have not been taking cover against yourselves, lest your ears and your eyes and your skins should bear witness against you, and you imagined that Allah did not know much of what you were working.
That conception of yours which you formed of your Rabb has ruined you, and you have become of the losers.
Then if they are patient, the Fire is their very home, and if they seek to please Allah, then they will not be of those who are allowed to please Allah.

And We have assigned to them comrades who had bedecked to them what was before them and what was behind them. Justified upon them was the word pronounced on the communities of Jinn and mankind who passed away before them. Verily they were the losers.
And those who disbelieve say: Listen not to this Qurān, and babble therein, so that you may overcome.
So We will cause those who disbelieve to taste a severe torment, and We will surely requite them the worst of what they have been working.
That is the fate of the enemies of Allah – the Fire. Therein is their home of abidance - a sequel to their refuting Our Signs.
And those who disbelieve will say: Our Rabb! Show us those of Jinn and mankind who led us astray and we will place them under our feet that they may be of the nethermost.

Verily those who said: Our Rabb is Allah, and have thereafter stood by it – on them will descend the angels saying: Fear not. Nor grieve, and rejoice at the glad tidings of the Garden which you have been promised.
We have been your friends in the life of the world, and are such in the Hereafter, herein whatever you desire shall be yours and whatever you call for shall be yours.
An entertainment for you from your Rabb, the Forgiving, the Merciful.
And who is better in speech than he who summons unto Allah and works righteously, and says: Verily I am of the Muslims.
Good and evil cannot be equal. Repel you evil with what is goodly, then behold! He, between whom and you was enmity, will be as though he was a friend.
And none attains that except those who are patient, and none attains that except the owner of mighty fortune.
And if there stirs you an incitement from Satan, then seek refuge in Allah. Verily He! He is the Hearer. The Knower.

And of His Signs are the night and the day and the sun and the moon. So do not prostrate yourselves to the sun and the moon, but prostrate yourselves to Allah Who has created them, if it is Allah Alone Whom you are worshipping.

And if they grew stiff-necked, then those who are with your Rabb, hallow Him night and day, and they weary not. And of His Signs is that you see the earth lowly, and when We sent down water on it, it stirs to life and grows. Verily He Who quickens it, is the Quickener of the dead. Verily He is Potent over everything. Verily those who blaspheme Our revelations are not hidden from Us. Is he then who will be cast into the Fire better or he who comes secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do what you will, verily He is the Beholder of what you do. Verily those who disbelieve in the Admonition when it comes to them are themselves at fault; verily it is a Book mighty. Falsehood cannot come to it from before it or from behind it. It is a Revelation from One Wise and Praise-worthy. Nothing is said to you save what was said to the Messengers before you. Your Rabb is Owner of forgiveness and the Owner of afflictive chastisement. guidance and a healing; and those who do not believe, in their ears is heaviness and to them it is blindness. These are they who are cried unto from a place far-off.

And of His Signs is that you see the earth lowly, and when We sent down water on it, it stirs to life and grows. Verily He Who quickens it, is the Quickener of the dead. Verily He is Potent over everything

Verily those who blaspheme Our revelations are not hidden from Us. Is.he then who will be cast into the Fire better or he who comes secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do what you will, verily He is the Beholder of what you do.
Verily those who disbelieve in the Admonition when it comes to them are themselves at fault; verily it is a Book mighty.
Falsehood cannot come to it from before it or from behind it. It is a Revelation from One Wise and Praise-worthy.
Nothing is said to you save what was said to the Messengers before you. Your Rabb is Owner of forgiveness and the Owner of afflictive chastisement.

And had We made it a recital into a foreign tongue, they would certainly have said: Why are not the verses thereof explained? A foreign tongue and an Arab! Say you to those who believe in it, it is guidance and a healing; and those who do not believe, in their ears is heaviness and to them it is blindness. These are they who are cried unto from a place far-off

And assuredly We vouchsafed the Book to Mūsa and there arose difference concerning it. And had not a word gone forth from your Rabb the affair would have been decreed between them. And verily they are in regard thereto in doubt and dubitating.
Whoever works righteously it is for his own soul, and whoever works evil it is against it. And your Rabb is not an oppressor to His bondmen.

To Him Alone is referred the knowledge of the Hour. And not a fruit comes forth from its knops, nor does a female conceive or bring forth but with His Knowledge. And on the Day when He will call unto them: Where are My associates? They will say: We assure You, none of us is a witness thereof.
And those whom they had been calling upon before will fail them, and they will perceive that there is no refuge for them.
Man is never wearied of praying for his worldly good, and if an evil visits him, he is despondent, despairing.

And if, after an affliction has visited him, We cause him to taste of Our Mercy, he is sure to say: This is my own, and I do not think that the Hour will ever arise, and were I to be brought back to my Rabb, surely there will be for me an excellent reward from Him. But We shall surely declare to those who disbelieve what they have worked, and make them taste a rough torment.
And when We show favour to man, he turns aside and withdraws on his sides, and when evil touches him he is full of prolonged prayer.
Say you: Think! If it is really from Allah and you reject it, who is further astray than one who is in schism far-off?

Soon We shall show them Our Signs in the universe and in their own selves until it becomes manifest to them that it is the truth. Does it not suffice in regard to your Rabb, that He is Witness over everything?
Lo! They are in doubt concerning their meeting with their Rabb. Lo! He is the Encompass of everything.
Hā Mīm.
'Ain. Sīn. Qāf.
Thus reveals to you and to those before you Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.
His is whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and He is the Exalted, the Grand.
Well-nigh might be rent the heavens from above them. And the angels hallow the Praise of their Rabb and ask His Forgiveness for those on the earth. Lo! Verily Allah; He is the Forgiver, the Merciful.
And those who take patrons besides Him - Allah is Warden over them, and you are not guardian over them.

And thus We have revealed to you a Qurān in Arabic, that you may warn thereby the mother-town and those around it, and that you may warn them of a Day of Assembling whereof there is no doubt. And of mankind a party will be in the Garden, and a party in the Blaze.
And had Allah willed, He would have made them all a single community. But He causes whom He will to enter into His Mercy. And the ungodly! For them there shall be no patron or helper.
Have they taken patrons besides Him? But Allah! He is the Patron. He quickens the dead, and He is Potent over everything.
And whatsoever it be in which you differ, the decision thereof is with Allah; such is Allah, my Rabb. In Him I put my trust, and to Him I turn in penitence.

The Originator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you mates of yourselves, and for the cattle also mates, whereby He diffuses you. Not like Him is anything, and He is the Hearer, the Beholder.
His are the keys of the heavens and the earth. He expands the

He has ordained for you in the faith what He had enjoined upon Nūḥ and what We have revealed to you, and what We had enjoined upon Ibrāhīm and Mūsa and 'Isā, saying: Establish the faith, and be not divided in it. Grievous unto the polytheists is that to which you call them. Allah chooses for Himself whom He will, and guides to Himself him who turns in penitence.

And they divided not till knowledge had come to them, through spite among themselves. And had not a word gone forth from your Rabb for an appointed term, the affair would surely have been judged between them. And verily those who have been made the heirs of the Book after them are in doubt thereof dubitating.

Summon you therefore to that, and be steadfast as you have been commanded, and follow not their desires. And say you: I believe in whatsoever Allah has sent down of the Book, and I am commanded that I should do justice between you; Allah is our Rabb and your Rabb. Unto us our works and unto you your works; let there be no contention between us and you. Allah will assemble us all, and to Him is the return.

And those who contend in respect of the religion of Allah after it has been acknowledged; their contention is void in the sight of their Rabb, and upon them shall befall His wrath and theirs shall be a severe chastisement.
Allah it is Who has sent down the Book with the truth and the balance. And what shall make you know? It may be that the Hour is near.

It is only those who do not believe therein seek to hasten it, and those who believe therein are fearful thereof, and know that it is the truth. Lo! Verily those who debate concerning the Hour are in error far-off.
Allah is Gentle to His bondmen. He provides for whomsoever He will, and He is the Strong, the Mighty.

Whosoever seeks the tillage of the Hereafter, to him We shall give increase in his tillage; and whosoever seeks the tillage of this world, We shall give him somewhat thereof, and in the Hereafter his shall be no portion.

Have they associated with gods who have instituted for them a religion which Allah has not approved? And had there not been a decisive word, the affair would have been judged between them. And verily the ungodly! Theirs shall be afflictive torment.

You shall see the ungodly fearful on account of what they have earned, and it is sure to befall them. And those who believe and work righteous deeds will be in meadows of the Gardens. Theirs will be whatsoever they desire with their Rabb. That! That is the supreme grace.
That is the glad tidings Allah gives to His bondmen who believe and work righteous deeds. Say you: I ask of you no wage for that save affection in respect of kinship. And whosoever does a

So they say: He has fabricated a lie concerning Allah? Now if Allah willed, He could seal your heart; and Allah abolishes falsehood and establishes truth by His Words. Verily He is the Knower of what is in the breasts.
And He it is Who accepts repentance from His bondmen, and pardons evil deeds and knows what you do.
He answers those who believe and work righteous deeds and increases to them of His Grace. And the infidels! Theirs shall be a severe torment.

And had Allah expanded the provision for His bondmen they surely would have rebelled in the earth, but He sends down by measure as He wills. Verily He is in respect of His bondmen, the Aware, the Beholder.
And He it is Who sends down the rain after men have despaired, and spreads abroad His Mercy and He is the Patron, the Praiseworthy.
And of His Signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and of the moving creatures which He has dispersed in both. And He is
And whatever of affliction befalls you is owing to what your hands have earned; and He pardons much.
And you cannot frustrate Him in the earth; and you have, besides Allah, neither a protector nor a helper.
And of His Signs are ships in the sea like high mountains.
If He wills, He causes the wind to cease, so that they stand still on the back thereof; verily therein are Signs for every one patient and grateful.
Or He may destroy them for what the people have earned; and He pardons many of them.
And those who dispute in respect of Our revelations may know that there is for them no place of shelter.

So whatsoever things are vouchsafed to you are but a passing enjoyment for the life of this world; and what is with Allah, better and more lasting, is for those who believe and put their trust in Allah.
And those who avoid heinous sins and indecencies and forgive when they are wrathful.
And those who answer the call of their Rabb and establish Şalāt and whose affairs being matter of counsel among themselves and who spend of that wherewith We have provided them.
And those who vindicate themselves when they are oppressed.
The meed of an ill-deed is an ill like thereunto, but whosoever pardons and is reconciled, his wage is on Allah: Verily He does not approve the wrong-doers.
And whosoever vindicates himself after wrong done to him; these! Against them there is no way of blame.
The way of blame is only against those who wrong mankind, and rebel on the earth without justification; these! For them is an afflictive torment.
And whosoever forgives and forbears – that verily is of the firmness of affairs.
And whosoever Allah sends astray, for him there will be no protecting friend to take His place. And you will see the ungodly when they will face the torment, saying: Is there any way to return?

And you will see them set up before it downcast with ignominy, looking with stealthy glance. And those who believe will say: Surely the losers are those who have lost themselves and their house folk on the Day of Resurrection. Lo! The ungodly will be in a lasting torment.
And they will have no patrons succouring them besides Allah. Whosoever Allah sends astray, there will be for him no way.

Answer the call of your Rabb before there comes to you a Day on which there is no averting from Allah. You will have no place of refuge on that Day, nor will there be for you any denying of your guilt.
If they turn away, then we have not sent you as a warden over them; on you is nothing but preaching. And verily We! When We cause man to taste of Mercy
Allah’s is the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He creates whatsoever He will. He bestows females on whomsoever He will, and bestows males on whomsoever He will.
Or, He conjoins them males and females; and He makes barren whomsoever He will. Verily He is the Knower, the Potent.

And it is not possible for any human being that Allah should speak to him otherwise than by revelation or from behind a veil, or that He sends a Messenger. So that the Messenger may reveal, by His Command whatsoever He will. Verily He is Exalted, Wise.

In this manner We have revealed unto you a spirit of Our Command; you know not what the Book was, nor what the faith. Yet We have made it a light wherewith We guide whomsoever We will of Our bondmen. And verily you guide to a straight path.
The Path of Allah, Whose is whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth. Lo! To Allah tend all affairs.
Hā Mīm.
By this luminous Book.
Verily We! We have made it an Arabic Qurān that haply you may reflect.
And verily it is in the Original Book before Us, indeed exalted, full of wisdom.
Shall We take away from you the Admonition because you are a people extravagant?
And how many a Prophet We have sent among the ancients.
And not a Prophet came to them but him they used to mock.
Therefore We destroyed peoples mightier than these in prowess; and there has gone forth the example of the ancients.
And if you question them: Who has created the heavens and the earth? They will surely say: The Mighty, the Knower created them.
Who has made the earth a bed for you and has made therein paths for you so that you are directed.
And who sends down water from the heaven in measure. Then we quicken a dead land therewith and even so you will be brought forth.
And Who has created the pairs, all of them, and appointed for you from ships and cattle on which you ride.
That you may mount firmly on their backs, and then may remember the favour of your Rabb when you mount thereon, and may say: Hallowed be He Who has subjected this to us, and we could not have it.
And verily to our Rabb we are to return.
And they assign out of His bondmen co-partners. Verily man is a manifest ingrate.
Has He taken, from His creatures, daughters for Himself, and has honoured you with sons?
And when there is announced to any of them the birth of what he likens to the Compassionate, his countenance remains darkened the whole day, and he is indignant inwardly.
Has He taken to Himself what is reared in ornaments, and is not clear in contention?
And they make the angels who are the bondmen of the Compassionate. Have they witnessed their creation? Their testimony will be written down and they will be questioned.
And they say: Had the Compassionate willed we should not have worshipped them. No knowledge they have of it, they are only guessing.
Have We vouchsafed them any Book before this, so that they are clinging to it?
Nay! They say: We have found our fathers on a certain way, and by their footsteps we are guided.
And in this wise We sent not a warner before you in any city but the affluent thereof said: Verily we found our fathers on a certain way and verily their footsteps we are following.
The warner therefore said: What! Even if I bring you a better guidance than what you found your fathers upon. They said: We deny that wherewith you are sent.
Therefore We took revenge on them. Behold then how has been the end of the beliers!
And recall when Ibrāhīm said to his father and his people, verily I am quit of what you worship.
Save Him, who has created me and then He would guide me.
And Ibrāhīm made it a word lasting among his posterity that perhaps they may return.
Aye! I let these and their fathers enjoy life, until there came unto them the truth, and a plain Messenger.
And when the truth came to them, they say this is magic, and verily we are therein disbelievers.
And they say, why has not this Qurān been revealed to a man of moment in the two cities?

Shall they apportion their Rabb’s Mercy? It is We Who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of the world, and have raised some of them over others in degrees, so that one of them may take another as a serf, and the Mercy of your Rabb is better than what they amass.

And were it not that the mankind would have become one community, We should make for those who disbelieve in the Compassionate roofs of silver for their houses and silver stairways whereby they ascend.
And silver doors for their houses and silver couches whereon they reclined.
And ornaments of gold. And yet all that would have been but a provision of the life of this world, and the Hereafter with your Rabb is for the God-fearing.
And whoever blinds himself to the admonition of the Compassionate, We assign to him a devil, and he becomes his comrade.
And verily they hinder them from the way, while they imagine that they are rightly guided.
Until when he comes to Us, he will say: Ah! Would that there had been between me and you the distance of the two orients – an evil comrade.
And because you have done wrong, today it will profit you not, that you are sharers in the torment.
So can you make the deaf hear or can you guide the blind, or him who is in manifest error?
And even though We take you away, We shall surely take vengeance on them.
Or if We show you that with which We threaten them; verily We are going to prevail over them.
Hold you fast to what We have revealed to you; verily you are on the straight path.
And verily it is an admonition to you and your people, and presently you will be questioned.
And ask you Our Messengers whom We sent before you: Did We appoint gods besides the Compassionate to be worshipped?
And assuredly We sent Mūsa with Our Signs to the Pharaoh and his chiefs, and he said: Verily I am a Messenger of the Rabb of the worlds.
Then when he came to them with Our Signs, lo! They were laughing at those Signs.
And not a Sign We showed them but it was greater than its like, and We seized them with chastisement that perchance they might turn.
And they said: Magician! Supplicate your Rabb for us for what He has covenanted with you, verily we shall let ourselves be directed.
Then when We had removed from them the chastisement, lo! They were breaking their promise.
And the Pharaoh proclaimed among his people saying: My people! Is not mine the kingdom of Egypt and these rivers flowing undemeath me? Do you not see?
Aye! I am better than this one who is contemptible, and unable even to make his speech plain.
Why, then, have the bracelets of gold not been set upon him, and why have the angels not come with him accompanying?
Then he incited his people and they obeyed him: They were ever a transgressing people.
So when they angered Us, We took vengeance on them, and We drowned them all.
And We made them a precedent, and an example to those after.
And when the son of Maryam is held up as an example, lo! Your people cry out at that.
And they say: Are not our gods better, or is he? They mention him not to you save for disputation. They are a people contentious.
He is nothing but a bondman; him We favoured, and him We made an example to the Children of Isrāil.
And had We willed We would have appointed angels among you in the earth to succeed each other.
And verily he is a Sign of the Hour, so do not dubitate concerning it and follow Me; this is the straight path.
And let not Satan hinder you, verily he is to you a manifest enemy.
And when ‘Isā’ came with evidences, he said: Surely I have come to you with wisdom, to expound to you some of that wherein you differ, so fear Allah and obey me.
And verily Allah! He is my Rabb and your Rabb; so worship Him; this is the straight path.
Then the sects differed among themselves. Woe to those who do wrong, because of the torment of the Day.
They wait but the Hour. That it should come upon them of a sudden, while they perceive not.
The intimate friends will be on that Day hostile one to another
O’ My bondmen! There shall be no fear upon you this Day, nor shall you grieve.
You who believed in Our revelations and were Muslims.
Enter the Garden, you and your spouses, joyfully.
Passed around among them will be dishes of gold and goblets, and therein will be whatsoever souls desire and eyes delight in; and you will be therein abiders.
This is the Garden which you have been made to inherit for what you have been working.
For you there will be fruits in plenty which you will eat.
Verily the culprits will be abiders in Hell's torment.
It shall not be abated from them, and therein they will become despondent.
And We wronged them not, but they have been the wrong-doers themselves.
And they will cry: O keeper! Let your Rabb make an end of us. He will say: Verily you shall abide for ever.
Assuredly We brought the truth to you, but most of you are averse to the truth.
Have they determined an affair, then We also are determining.
Do they think that We hear not their secrets and their whispers? Yea! We do, and Our envoys present with them write down.
Say you: Had the Compassionate a son, I shall be the first of his worshippers.
Hallowed be the Rabb of the heavens and the earth, the Rabb of the Throne from what they ascribe.
So leave them alone wading and sporting till they meet the Day which they are promised.
And He it is Who is Worthy of worship in the heaven and in the earth, and He is the Wise, the Knower.
And blessed be He Whose is the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is in-between, and with Him is the knowledge of the Hour and to Him you will be made to return.
And whom they call upon besides Him, they do not own the power of intercession - save those who bear witness to the truth and who know.
And were you to ask them who created them, they will surely say: Allah. Then where are they deviating?
And We hear his saying: Rabb! Verily they are a people who do not believe.
So turn you aside from them, and say: Peace. Presently they shall come to know.
Hā. Mīm
By the luminous Book.
We have sent it down on a blessed night; verily We were to become warners.
Therein is decreed every affair of wisdom.
As a Command from before Us. Verily We were to become Senders.
A Mercy from the Rabb. Verily He! He is the Hearer, the Knower.
Rabb of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is inbetween, if only you would be convinced.
There is no god but He. He quickens and causes to die: your Rabb and Rabb of your forefathers.
Aye! They are in doubt sporting.
So wait you for a day when the sky will bring forth a manifest smoke.
Covering the people, this shall be a dreadful scourge.
Our Rabb! Lift up from us this scourge; verily we shall become believers.
How can there be an admonition unto them, when there came to them a clear Messenger.
Yet they turned away from him and said: One tutored, one distracted!
Verily We shall remove the chastisement for a while; but verily you shall revert.
On the Day when We assault them with the greatest assault, verily We shall take vengeance.
And assuredly before them We tried the Pharaoh's people, and there came to them an honoured Messenger, saying.
Restore to me the bondmen of Allah, I am unto you a trusted Messenger.
And saying: Exalt not yourselves against Allah, verily I have come to you with a manifest authority.
And verily I have sought refuge in my Rabb and your Rabb lest you stone me.
And if you will not believe in me, then let me alone.
Then he called upon his Rabb: These are a guilty people.
Allah said: So depart you with My bondmen by night; surely you will be pursued.
And leave you the sea parted; verily they are a host to be drowned.
They left – how many – of gardens and springs.
And cornfields and goodly positions.
And the delights, which they had been enjoying!
Even so. And We caused another people to inherit them.
And the heaven and the earth did not shed tears for them, nor were they reprieved.
Assuredly We saved the Children of Israil from a degrading scourge.
From the Pharaoh, verily he was haughty and of the extravagant.
And assuredly We chose them with knowledge purposely above the worlds.
And We vouchsafed to them Signs in which was a manifest favour from Us.
Verily these! They say.
Nothing is there but our first death, and we shall not be raised again.
Bring back then our fathers, if you speak the truth.
Are these better or the People of Tubb’a and those before them? We destroyed them, they were culprits.
And We did not create the heavens and the earth and what is in between in sport.
We did not create them save with a purpose, yet most of them know not.
Verily the Day of Decision is the term appointed for all of them.
A Day whereon a friend shall not avail a friend at all, nor shall they be succoured.
Save those on whom Allah will have Mercy. Verily He! He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
Verily the tree of Zaqqum.
Food of the sinners.
Like the dregs of oil; it shall seethe in the bellies.
As the seething of boiling water.
Seize him and drag him to the midst of the Flaming Fire.
Then pour upon his head the torment of boiling water.
Taste you! You are indeed mighty, honoured!
Verily this is what you were used to doubt.
Verily those who kept their duty to Allah will be in a station secure.
Amidst gardens and springs.
Attired in fine silk and brocade, facing each other.
Even so. And We shall mate them with damsels large-eyed.
They will call therein for every manner of fruit in security.
They will not taste death therein, except the first death, and He will guard them against the chastisement of Flaming Fire.
A bounty from your Rabb! That! That is the supreme achievement.
And We have made it easy in your language, perhaps they might be admonished.
Wait you then, they are also waiting.
Hā. Mīm
The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.
Verily in the heavens and the earth are Signs for the faithful.
And in the creation of yourselves and the beasts that He has scattered over the earth are Signs for a people who are convinced.

And in the alternation of night and day and what Allah sends down of provision from the heaven and thereby quickens the earth after its death and in the turning about of the winds, are Signs for a people who reflect.
These are the revelations of Allah which We rehearse to you with truth. In what discourse, then, after Allah and His revelations, will they believe?
Woe unto every liar, sinner!
Who hears the revelations of Allah rehearsed to him, and yet persisted with stiffness as though he heard them not. Announce you to him, then, an afflictive torment.
And when he comes to know anything of Our revelations, he takes it scoffingly. These! Theirs shall be an ignominious torment.
Before them is Hell. Nothing will avail them of what they have earned nor those whom they took for patrons besides Allah and theirs shall be a mighty torment.
This Book is a guidance; and those who disbelieve in the revelations of their Rabb, theirs shall be a torment of afflictive calamity.
Allah it is Who has subjected the sea to you that ships may run on it by His Command, and that you may seek of His Grace and that you may return thanks.
And He has subjected to you whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is on the earth, the whole from Himself. Verily herein are Signs for a people who ponder.
Say you to the faithful, let them forgive those who hope not for the days of Allah, that He may recompense a community for what they have been working.
Whosoever works righteously, works for himself, and whosoever does evil, does against himself, then to your Rabb you will be made to return.
And assuredly We vouchsafed to the Children of Israil the Book and the wisdom and the Prophethood, and We provided them with good things, and preferred them above the worlds.

And We vouched to them the evidences of the affairs. And they differed not except through spite among themselves after the knowledge had come to them. Verily the Rabb will decide between them on the Day of Judgment concerning what they have been differing in.
And thereafter We have placed you upon the law of the religion; so follow it you, and follow not the vain desires of those who do not know.
Verily they cannot avail you at all against Allah. And the wicked! Friends are they one to another, and Allah is the friend of those who keep their duty to Him.
This Book is an enlightenment and a guidance to mankind, and a mercy to people who are convinced.
Do those who commit ill-deeds imagine that We shall place them as those who believed and worked righteous works? Equal is their life and death! How ill they judge!
Allah has created the heavens and the earth with purpose, and that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned. And they will not be wronged.

Have you seen him who takes for his god his own vain desire, and Allah has sent him astray despite his knowledge, and has sealed up his hearing and his heart and has set up a covering on his sight? Who will guide him after Allah? Will you not then be admonished?
And they say: Nothing is there but the life of this world, we die and we live; and none kills us save time. And they have no true knowledge of it, they only conjecture.
And when Our manifest revelations are rehearsed to them, their argument is no other than that they say: Bring back our fathers if you are truthful.
Say: Allah keeps you alive, then He will cause you to die; then He will assemble you on the Day of Resurrection, of which there is no doubt; but most of mankind do not know.
Allah's is the dominion of the heavens and the earth; and on the Day when the Hour arrives, the followers of falsehood shall lose.
And you shall behold every community kneeling, every community summoned to its record. This Day you shall be recompensed for what you had been working.
This Book of Ours speaks against you with truth; verily We have been setting down whatsoever you had been working.
Then, as for those who believed and worked righteous deeds, their Rabb will cause them to enter into His Mercy, that is a manifest achievement.
And as for those who disbelieved: Were not My revelations rehearsed to you? But you were stiff-necked and you were a people guilty.

And when it was said: Verily Allah's Promise is true, and no doubt is there about the Hour, you said: We do not know what the Hour is; we do not imagine it but as a conjecture, and we have no faith therein.
And the evils of what they had worked shall become apparent to them, and there will surround them that at which they had been mocking.
And it will be said: This Day We shall ignore you as you ignored the meeting of this day; your abode will be the Fire, and none you will have as helpers.

That is because you took the revelations of Allah in mockery, and there deluded you the life of this world. To-day, therefore they will not be taken forth therefrom, nor will they be allowed to please Allah.
All Praise, then, to Allah, the Rabb of the heavens, and the Rabb of the earth, the Rabb of the worlds.
And His Alone is the Majesty in the heavens and the earth, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
Hā. Mīm.
The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.
We created not the heavens and the earth and what is in-between save with a purpose and for a term determined. And those who disbelieve backslide from what they are warned of.

Say you: Think! Whatsoever you call upon besides Allah – show me whatsoever they have created of the earth? Or, have they any share in the creation of the heavens? Bring me a Book before this or some trace of knowledge, if you are truthful.
And who is more misguided than he who calls besides Allah such as will not answer him till the Day of Resurrection, and who are even unaware of their call?
And when mankind are gathered they will become enemies unto them, and will become deniers of their worship.
And when Our manifest revelations are rehearsed to them, those who disbelieve say of the truth when it comes to them: This is magic manifest.

Do they say: He has fabricated it? Say you: If I have fabricated it, you cannot avail me against Allah in anything. He is the Knower of what you utter respecting it. He suffices as witness between me and you and He is Forgiving, Merciful.
Say you: I am not an innovator among the Messengers nor I know what would be done with me or with you: I only follow what is revealed to me, and I am but a manifest warner.

Say you: Think! If it is from Allah while you disbelieve in it, and a witness from the Children of Israïl bears witness to the like thereof and believes, while you are still stiff-necked, then who is further astray than you? Verily Allah does not guide a wicked people.
And they who disbelieve say of those who believe. Had it been good they would not have preceded us thereto. And when they have not let themselves guided by it, they say: This is an ancient falsehood.

And prior to it there has been the Book of Mūsa a guidance and a Mercy. And this is a Book confirming it in Arabic speech, that it may warn those who have done wrong and as glad tidings to the well-doers.
Verily those who say: Our Rabb is Allah, and then stand fast to it, no fear shall come upon them, nor shall they grieve.
Those are the inmates of the Garden, abiders therein: A recompense for what they have been working.

And We have enjoined upon man kindness to the parents, with hardship bears him his mother, and with hardship she brings him forth, and the bearing of him and the weaning of him is thirty months, until, when he attains his full strength and attains the age of forty years, he says: Rabb! Grant me that I may give thanks for the favour which You have done me and my parents and that I may work righteously such as You may approve. And be You good in my progeny, verily I have turned to You penitent; verily I am of those who submit.

Those are they from whom We shall accept the best of what they have worked, and their misdeeds We shall pass by. They will be among the inmates of the Garden - a true promise this, what they have been promised.

And he who says to his parents: Fie upon you both! Do you threaten me that I shall be taken forth, whereas generations have passed away before me. And the woe to you! Come to believe, verily the promise of Allah is true. Yet he says: This is nothing but the fables of the ancients.
Those are they upon whom has been justified the saying about the communities of Jinn and mankind who have passed away before them; verily they are ever the losers.
And for all are ranks according to what they have worked, that He may repay them in full for their work, and they shall not be wronged.

And on the Day when those who disbelieve shall be placed before the Fire: You made away with your good things in your life of the world, and you enjoyed yourselves therewith, so today you shall be requited with torment of ignominy because you have been growing stiff-necked on the earth without justification, and because you have been transgressing.
And remember you the brother of the Ād when We warned his people in the sandhills – and surely there have passed away warners before him and after him – saying: Worship none
They said: Have you come to us that you may turn us aside from our gods? Then bring upon you that with which you threaten us, if you are truthful.
He said: The knowledge is only with Allah, and I preach to you that wherewith I am sent, but I see you are a people given to ignorance.

And when they saw it as an over peering cloud tending towards their valleys they said: That is an over peering cloud bringing us rain. Nay! It is what you sought to be hastened: A wind wherein is an afflictive torment.
It shall annihilate everything by the command of its Rabb. Therefore, they became such that nothing could be seen of them save their dwellings. We thus requite a nation of the guilty.

And them We had assuredly established in that flourishing condition wherein We have not established you and We had assigned for them hearing and sight and hearts; yet their hearing and sight and hearts availed them not at all. They used to deny the revelations of Allah, and then encompassed them what they had been mocking at.
And assuredly We have destroyed the cities round about you, and We have variously propounded Our Signs that per chance they might return.
Then why succoured them not those whom they had taken for gods beside Allah, as means of approach? Aye! They failed them. And that was their lie which they had been fabricating.

And recall when We sent towards you a company of the Jinn listening to the Qurān. So when they came in the presence thereof they said: Give ears. Then when it was ended, they returned back to their people as warners.
They said: O our people! Verily we have hearkened to a Book sent down after Mūsa, confirming
O our people! Answer Allah's summoner, and believe in him; He shall forgive you your sins and shall shield you from an afflictive chastisement.
And whoever does not answer Allah's Summoner, he cannot frustrate His vengeance on the earth, and there will be no patrons for him, beside Him. Those are in manifest error.
Bethink they not that Allah Who created the heavens and the earth and was not fatigued with the creation thereof, is able to quicken the dead? Aye! Verily He is Potent over everything.
And on the Day when those who disbelieve will be placed before the Fire: Is this not real? They will say: Yes! By our Rabb! He will say: Taste therefore the torment for you have been disbelieving.

Bear you then with patience, as the Messengers, endued with resolution bear with patience and seek not to hasten on for them. On the Day when they will behold that with which they are threatened, it will seem to them as though they had tarried but for an hour of a day. A proclamation this; so none will be destroyed but the nation of transgressors.
Those who disbelieve and hinder others from the path of Allah – their works He shall send astray.

And those who believe and work righteous deeds and believe in what has been revealed to Muhammad – and it is the truth from their Rabb, their misdeeds He shall expiate from them and shall make good their state.
That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood and those who believe follow the truth from their Rabb. And thus does Allah propound to the mankind their similitude.

Now when you meet those who disbelieve, smite their necks until when you have slain them greatly, then make fast the bonds, then thereafter let them off freely or by ransom, until the war lays off its burden. That you shall do. And had Allah willed, He would have vindicated Himself against them, but He ordained fighting in order that He may test you one by the other. And those who are slain in the Cause of Allah, He shall not let their works go astray.
Soon He will guide them and make good their state.
And He will make them enter the garden and will make it known to them.
O you who believe! If you want to help Allah, He will help you and make your feet firm.
And those who disbelieve, theirs shall be the downfall, and their work He will send astray.
That is because they detest what Allah has sent down, and so He will make their works of no effect.
Have they not journeyed on the earth so that they might see how has been the end of those before them? Allah annihilated them; and for the infidels, theirs shall be the like fate therefore.
That is because Allah is the Patron of those who believe, and the infidels! No patron is theirs!

Verily Allah will cause those who believe and work righteous deeds to enter the Garden where under rivers flow. And those who disbelieve enjoy themselves and eat even as the cattle eat, and the Fire shall be the abode for them.
And many a city, mightier in strength than the city which drove
Is he then who stands on an evidence from his Rabb like him whose evil of work is bedecked to him, and those who follow their lusts?

A likeness of the Garden which has been promised to those who keep their duty to Allah is this, therein are rivers of water incorruptible, rivers of milk of unchangeable flavour, rivers of wine, a joy to the drinkers; and rivers of honey clarified; therein theirs shall be every manner of fruit, and forgiveness from their Rabb. Shall persons enjoying such bliss be like those who are abiders in the Fire, and are given to drink boiling water so that it mangles their entrails?

Of them are some who listen to you, until, when they go forth from before you, they say to those who are vouchsafed knowledge: what is that he said just now? Those are they whose hearts Allah has sealed up, and they follow their lusts.
And those who are guided, He adds their guidance, and gives them protection against evil.
Do they only await the Hour, that it should come upon them suddenly? Portents thereof are already come, so how will they be? with them when there comes to them their admonition?
So know you that there is no god save Allah, and ask forgiveness for your fault and for faithful men and women. And Allah knows well your moving about and your place of rest.

And those who believe say: Why has a Surah not been revealed? Then when there is revealed a Surah firmly-constructed and fighting is prescribed therein, you see those in whose heart is a disease looking at you with a look of one who is fainting unto death: So woe unto them!
Obedience and a civil word. Then, when the affair is resolved, if even then they gave credence to Allah, it would have been better for them.
Then if you turn away, you are likely to cause corruption on the earth and to sever your kinship.
Those are they whom Allah has cursed and then had deafened them and blinded their sights.
Do they not ponder the Quran, or are there locks upon their hearts?
Verily those who have apostated on their backs after the guidance had become manifest to them, Satan has embellished this apostasy to them, and has given them false hopes.
That is because they say to those who abhor what Allah has revealed; we shall obey you in part of the affair, and Allah knows their talking in secret.
How then shall it be, when the angels shall take them away at death, smiting their faces and their backs!
That is because they followed what incensed Allah and abhorred His good-will. So He made their works of no-effect.
Do then in whose hearts is a disease imagine that Allah will never bring to light their rancour?
And if We willed, We would surely show them to you, so that you should know them by their marks. And you shall surely know them by the mode of their speech. And Allah knows your works.
And of a surety We shall put you to the proof till We know the valiant among you and the steadfast, and We shall know your states.

Verily those who have disbelieved and have hindered others from the Path of Allah and have opposed the Messengers after the guidance has become manifest to them shall not hurt Allah at all, and soon He shall make their works fruitless.
O you who believe! Obey Allah and obey the Messenger, and do not render your works vain.
Verily those who disbelieve and hinder others from the Path of Allah and die as infidels; Allah shall by no means forgive them.
So do not faint, nor cry out for peace; and you shall triumph. And Allah is with you, and will not defraud you of your works.
The life of this world is but a sport and a pastime. And if you believe and shun evil, He will give you your wage and will not require of you your substance.
If He required it of you and importuned you, you would be niggardly, and He will bring to light your secret malevolence.

Look here! You are those who are called to expend in the Cause of Allah; then of you there are some who are niggardly. And whosoever is niggardly is only niggardly to his soul. Allah is Self-sufficient, and you are the needy. And if you turn away, He will substitute for you another people, and then they will not be your likes.
Verily We! A victory We have given you, a manifest victory.
That He may forgive you of your sins, past and future, and may accomplish the more His favour on you, and may keep you guided on the straight path.
And that Allah may help you with a mighty help.

He it is Who has sent down tranquillity into the hearts of the believers that they might increase belief to their belief. And Allah's are the hosts of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is ever Knowing, Wise.

He has prescribed war in order that He may admit the believing men and women into Gardens, where under rivers flow as abiders therein, and that He may expiate from them their misdeeds. And that is with Allah a mighty achievement.

And that He may chastise the hypocritical men and women and the polytheist men and women, and the thinkers of evil thought concerning Allah. To them shall befall the evil turn of fortune, and Allah shall be indignant with them, and shall curse them, and He has prepared for them Hell, an ill destination!
And Allah's are the legions of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is ever Mighty, Wise.
Verily We! We have sent you as a witness and a bearer of glad tidings and a warner.
That you (mankind) may believe in Allah and His Messenger, and may assist Him and honour Him, and may hallow Him morning and evening.

Verily those who swear allegiance to you indeed swear allegiance to Allah; the hand of Allah is over their hands. So whosoever breaks his oath breaks it only to his soul's hurt; and whosoever fulfils his covenant with Allah, him He shall soon give a great wage.

Those of the desert Arabs who lagged behind will presently say to you: Our properties and our families kept us occupied, so you ask pardon for us. They say with their tongues what is not in their hearts. Say you: Who can avail you in naught against Allah, if He intended you hurt or intended you benefit? Yea! Allah is ever Aware of what you do.

Yea! You imagined that the Messenger and the believers would never return to their families, and that became bedeeked in your hearts, and you bethought an evil thought, and you became a people doomed.
And whoever does not believe in Allah and His Messenger – then verily We have prepared a Blaze for the infidels.
