And Allah's is the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whomsoever He will, and chastises whomsoever He will, and Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.

Those who lagged behind will, when you march forth to take the spoils presently say: Leave us, we shall follow you. They were to change the word of Allah. Say you: You shall by no means follow us; thus has Allah said before. Then they will say: Aye! You envy us. Aye! Little it is you used to understand.

Tell those of the desert Arabs who lagged behind: Surely you shall be summoned to fight against a people endued with exceeding violence, then you will fight them or they will surrender. Then if you obey, Allah will give you a goodly wage; but if you turn away, as you turned away before, He will chastise you with a painful chastisement.

No blame there is upon the blind and no blame upon the lame and no blame upon the sick. And whosoever obeys Allah and his Messenger he will admit him into Garden whereunder rivers flow; and whosoever turns away, him He shall torment with an afflictive torment.

Assuredly He was Allah with the faithful when they swore allegiance to you under the tree, and He knew what was in their hearts, so He sent down on them tranquility, and rewarded them with a victory near at hand.
And abundant spoils that they are taking. And Allah is ever Mighty, Wise.

Allah has promised you abundant spoils that you shall take, and these He has hastened to you and has restrained the hands of the people from you, that it may be a Sign to the believers, and that He may guide you to a straight path.
And another victory He promised, over which as yet you have no power, Allah has surely encompassed it, and Allah is ever Potent over everything.
And had those who disbelieve fought against you, surely they would have turned their backs and then they would have found no patron nor helper.
That has been the dispensation of Allah with those who passed away before; and you shall not find any change in the dispensation of Allah.
And He it is Who restrained their hands from you and restrained your hands from them, in the vale of Makkah after He had made you victorious over them, and Allah is ever a Beholder of what you do.

They were those who disbelieved and debarred you from the Sacred Mosque, and prevented the detained offering, that it should arrive at its goal. And had it not been for the believing men and women you know not and that you might have trampled on them and thus might have been guilty on their account unwittingly. This He did that He might abide with His Mercy whomsoever He will. Had they been distinguished one from another, surely We had chastised those who disbelieved among them with a painful chastisement.

When those who disbelieve had put in their hearts a zeal, the goal of paganism then Allah sent down a tranquillity upon His Messenger and the faithful and kept them fixed on the way of piety, and they were worthy of it and meet for it; and Allah is ever the Knower of everything.

Assuredly did Allah show a true vision to His Messenger in very truth; Allah willing, you shall surely enter the Sacred Mosque, secure, with your head shaven and your hair cropped, and you shall have no fear. He knows what you do not know. So He has assigned. besides that a victory nearby.
He it is Who has sent his Messenger with guidance and true faith that He may make it prevail over all faiths, and Allah suffices as Witness.

Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. And those who are with him are stern against the infidels and merciful among themselves. You see them bowing down and doing Sajdah, seeking Grace from Allah and His Goodwill. This mark is on their faces, a trace of Sajud, such is their description in the Torah. And their description in the Like a seed that puts forth its shoot arid strengthens it, and grows and rises straight upon its stalk delighting the sowers. Such are the early Muslims described that He may enrage the infidels with them. To those among them who believe and work righteous deeds. Allah has promised forgiveness and a splendid wage
O you who believe! Do not be forward in the presence of Allah and His Messenger, and fear Allah. Verily Allah is Hearing, Knowing.

O you who believe! Do not raise your voice above the voice of the Prophet, nor shout loud to him in discourse, as you do to one another, lest your works may be rendered fruitless, while you perceive not.
Verily those who lower their voices in the presence of the Messenger of Allah! Those are they whose hearts Allah has disposed towards piety; theirs will be forgiveness and splendid wage.
Verily these who call aloud to you from outside the inner apartments, most of them are foolish.
And had they waited till you come out unto them, it had surely been better for them: and Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
O’ you who believe! If a mischief-maker came to you with a report, then make a strict inquiry. Lest one may hurt a people unwittingly and thereafter repent of what you have done.

And know that verily among you there is the Messenger of Allah. If he were to obey you, you would surely be in trouble, but Allah has endeared faith to you and has bedecked it in your hearts and has made infidelity and wickedness and disobedience abhorrent to you. These! They are the men of rectitude.
Through grace from Allah and His favour. And Allah is Knowing, Wise.

And if two parties of the faithful fall to mutual fighting, then strive reconciliation between them. But if one of them rebels against the other, then fight the party which rebels till it reverts to the Commandment of Allah. Then if it reverts, strive reconciliation between them justly and be equitable, Allah loves the equitable.
The faithful are but brethren, so affect reconciliation between your brethren and fear Allah that mercy may be shown to you.

O you who believe! Let not one group scoff at another group; perchance they may be better than they are, nor let some women scoff at other women; perchance the latter may be better than they are. And do not traduce one another, nor revile one another by odious appellations; ill is the name of sin after belief. And whosoever will not repent, then those are the wicked. O you who believe! Avoid much suspicion; indeed some suspicion is a sin. And spy not, nor backbite one another. Would any of you relish to eat the flesh of his dead brother? You detest that. And fear Allah; verily Allah is Relenting, Merciful. Mankind! Verily We! We have created you of a male and a female, and We have made you nations and tribes that you might know one another. Verily the noblest of you with Allah is the most pious of you. Verily Allah is Knowing, Wise. The desert Arabs say: We have believed. Say you: You have not believed, rather say: We have submitted to Islam, while faith has not yet entered into your hearts. And if you obey Allah and His Messenger, He shall not diminish of your works; verily Allah is Forgiving, Merciful. the Cause of Allah. Those! They are the truthful.

O’ you who believe! Avoid much suspicion; indeed some suspicion is a sin. And spy not, nor backbite one another. Would any of you relish to eat the flesh of his dead brother? You detest that. And fear Allah; verily Allah is Relenting, Merciful.

Mankind! Verily We! We have created you of a male and a female, and We have made you nations and tribes that you might know one another. Verily the noblest of you with Allah is the most pious of you. Verily Allah is Knowing, Wise.

The desert Arabs say: We have believed. Say you: You have not believed, rather say: We have submitted to Islam; while faith has not yet entered into your hearts. And if you obey Allah and His Messenger, He shall not diminish of your works; verily Allah is Forgiving. Merciful.

The faithful are only those who have faith in Allah and His Messenger, and have not doubted thereafter, and have striven hard with their riches and their lives in the Cause of Allah. Those! They are the truthful.
Say you: What! Will you instruct Allah about your religion? Whereas Allah knows whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, and Allah is Aware of everything.

They regard it as a favour to you that they have embraced Islam. Say you: Deem not your surrender a favour to me; nay! Allah has conferred a favour upon you as He has guided you to the faith, if you are sincere.
Allah knows the hidden in the heavens and the earth, and Allah is the Beholder of what you do.
Qaf. By the glorious Qurān, We have sent you as a warner.
Aye! They marvel that a warner has come to them from among themselves, and so the infidels say: This is a thing wonderful.
Shall we be brought back when we are dead and have become dust? That is a return.
Surely We know what the earth consumes of them, and with Us is a Book preserved.
Aye! They denied the truth when it came to them; so they are confused in the matter.
Have they not looked up to the sky above them; how We have constructed it, and adorned it and that there is no rift therein.
And the earth! We have spread it forth, and have cast upon it firm mountains, and have caused to
An insight and admonition for every penitent bondmen.
And We have sent down blessed water from the heaven whereby We have caused the gardens to grow, and the grain reaped.
And tall date-palms laden with ranged clusters.
As a provision for Our bondmen; and with it We made the dead land alive. Such will be the coming forth.
Denied before them the people of Nuh and the dwellers of Rass and the Thamud.
And the 'Ad, and the Pharaoh and the brethren of Lut.
And the dwellers of the wood, and the People of Tubb'a. Each one belied the Messengers, and so My- judgement was fulfilled.
Are We then wearied with the first creation? Aye! They are in doubt regarding a new creation.
Assuredly we have created man, and We know what his soul whispers within him, We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.
Behold! When the two receivers receive – one on the right hand and the other on the left - a sitter.
Not a word he utters but there is a watcher ready.
And the stupor of death will come in truth; this is what you have been avoiding.
And the Trumpet will be blown; this is the Day of Threat.
And there shall come every soul, with whom will be a driver and a witness.
Assuredly you have been heedless thereof; now We have lifted off from you your veil, so your sight today is piercing.
And his companion will say: This is what with me is ready.
Cast you twain into Hell every person, rebellious, contumacious.
Hinderer of good, trespasser, doubter.
Who set up with Allah another god, so cast him you twain in the severe torment.
His companion will say: Rabb! I did not cause him to transgress, he was himself in error far-off.
Allah will say: Do not wrangle in My presence, and I had already proffered to you the warning.
The word shall not be changed in My presence, nad am I an oppressor at all to My bondmen.
Mention the Day when We shall say to Hell: Are you filled? And it will say: Is there yet any addition?
And to the godly the Garden will be brought near, not far-off.
This is what you were promised for every oft-returning heedful one.
Who fears the Compassionate, in the Unseen and comes to Him with a penitent heart.
Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Abidance.
Theirs therein will be whatever they wish and with Us will be yet more.
And how many a generation We destroyed before them who were mightier in power than they, and they traversed the cities! And no place of refuge could they find.
Verily herein is an admonition to him who has a heart, or gives ear while he is heedful.
And assuredly We created the heavens and the earth and what is in-between in six days, and naught touched Us of weariness.
So bear you patiently with what they say, and hallow the Praise of your Rabb before the rising of the sun and before its setting.
And hallow Him in the night-time, and also after the prescribed prostration.
And listen you: The Day when the caller will call from a place quite near.
The Day, when they will surely hear the Shout – that is the Day of coming forth.
Verily We! It is We Who give life and cause death, and to Us is the journeying.
That shall be the Day when the earth shall be cleft from off them, as they hasten forth. That shall be a gathering unto Us easy.
We are the best Knower of what they say; and you are not a tyrant over them. So admonish you.
By the dispersing winds that disperse.
And the clouds bearing a load.
And the ships that glide with ease.
And the envoys who distribute the Affair.
What you are threatened with is surely true.
And the Requital is sure to happen.
By the sky full of paths.
Verily you are in divided opinion.
Turned aside therefrom, is he who is turned.
Perish the conjecturers.
Who are in heedlessness, neglectful.
They ask: When is the Day of Requital coming?
It will be the Day whereon they will be burned in the Fire.
Taste your burning. This is what you sought to be hastened.
Verily the God-fearing will be in the Gardens and water-springs.
Taking whatsoever their Rabb will vouchsafe to them. Verily they have been well-doers before that.
Little of the night they were used to slumber.
And in the dawns they used to pray for forgiveness.
And in their substance there was the right of the beggar and non beggar.
And on the earth there are Signs for those who would be convinced.
And also in your own selves. Behold you not?
And in the heavens your provision and what you are promised.
By the Rabb of the heaven and the earth it is certain, even as it is a fact that you are speaking.
Has there come to you the story of Ibrāhīm's honoured guests?
When they went in to him and said: Peace! He said: Peace! They were a people unknown.
Then he turned away into his household and brought a calf fatted.
And he set it before them and said: Why do you not eat?
Then he conceived a fear of them. They said: have no fear. And they gave him the glad tidings of a knowing son.
Then his wife drew near vociferating, and smote her face, and said, an old barren woman!
They said: even so says your Rabb. Verily He! He is the Wise, the Knower!
And he said: What is your errand, O envoys?
They said: We are sent to a guilty people.
That we may send down upon them stones of baked clay.
Marked from before your Rabb for the extravagant.
Thus We brought forth from therein the faithful.
But We found not there but one household of the Muslims.
And We left therein a Sign for those who fear an awful chastisement.
And in Mūsa also was a lesson, when We sent him to the Pharaoh with manifest authority.
He turned away with his court and said: A magician or a mad, man!
Then We seized him and flung him and his hosts into the sea and he was reproachable.
And in 'Ad also was a lesson when We let loose on them a blighting wind.
It left nothing it came upon but blew it into spreads.
And in Thamūd also was a lesson, when it was said to them: Enjoy yourselves for a while.
They disdained the Command of their Rabb; so the bolt laid hold of them while they looked on.
So they were neither able to stand, nor could they help themselves.
And the People of Nūḥ We destroyed before; verily they were a sinful people.
And the heaven! We have built it with might, and verily We are Powerful.
And the earth! We have stretched it forth; an excellent Spreader are, We!
And of everything We have created pairs, that you might remember.
Then flee to Allah verily I am a manifest warner to you from Him.
And do not set up another god with Allah; verily I am a manifest warner to you from Him.
Likewise, there came not a Messenger to those before them but they said: A magician or a madman!
Have they handed over this to one another? Nay! They are a people contumacious.
So you turn away from them, for you are not blameworthy.
And admonish you, for admonition benefits the faithful.
And I have not created the jinn and mankind but that they should worship Me.
I seek not any provision from them, nor I desire that they should feed Me.
Verily Allah! He is the Provider, Owner of Power, Firm.
So verily unto them who do wrong, there is a portion of their fellows; so let them not ask Me to hasten.
Woe, then, to those who disbelieve when their Threatened Day arrives.
By the mount.
By the Book inscribed.
In parchment unrolled.
By the House frequented.
By the roof elevated.
By the sea overflowing.
Verily the chastisement of your Rabb is sure to overtake.
Of it there is no averter.
On the Day when the heaven will shake with awful shaking.
And the mountains will move away with an awful movement.
Woe, then, it will be on that Day to the beliers.
Who sport themselves in wading.
On the Day when they will be pushed into Hell-Fire with a dreadful pushing.
This is the Fire you used to belie.
Is this magic? Or are you still unable to see?
Roast therein. Endure it or endure it not, all is equal to you. You are being requited for what you have been working.
Verily the godly will be in the Gardens and Delight.
Rejoicing in what their Rabb has vouchsafed to them, and their R.abb will shield them from the torment of the Flame.
Eat and drink with relish for what you have been working.
Reclining on couches ranged. And We shall couple them with damsels wide-eyed.

And those who believe and whose progeny follow them in faith – We shall cause their progeny to join them, and We shall not diminish nothing of their own work. Every man is a pledge for what he has worked.
And We shall increasingly give them fruit and meat as they desire.
Therein they will snatch a cup from one another, therein there will be neither vain babble nor sin.
And there will go round on them youths appointed to attend them as if they were pearls concealed.
And they will advance to each other asking questions.
They will say: We were aforetime in the mid of our household, ever in dread.
Therefore Allah obliged us, and has protected us from the torment of the Scorch.
We used to pray to Him aforetime. Verily He! It is He, the Benign, the Merciful.
Therefore admonish you! By the grace of your Rabb, you are neither a soothsayer nor a madnan.
Do they say: A poet, for whom we wait only some adverse turn of fortune?
Say you: Wait, verily I am, with you, among the waiters.
Does their reason enjoin them to this? Or are they a people outrageous?
Do they say: He has forged it? Aye! They will not believe.
Let them bring a discourse like thereunto, if they tell the future.
Have they not been created from nothing? Or are they the creators?
Did they create the heavens and the earth? Aye! They will not be convinced.
Are with them the treasures of your Rabb? Or are they the dispensers?
Have they a stairway whereby they overhear? Then let their listener bring a clear authority.
Has He daughters and you sons?
Or ask you a wage from them, so that they are laden with debt?
Is with them the Unseen and they write it down?
Do they seek to lay a plot? Then those who disbelieve - it is they who shall be plotted against.
Is theirs a god beside Allah? Hallowed be Allah from what they associate!
And even if they should see a fragment of the sky falling down, they would say: It is only clouds.
So let them alone, till they meet their Day whereon they shall swoon.
A Day when their plotting shall not avail them at all nor will they be succoured.
And for those who are ungrateful there is a chastisement before that but most of them know not.
And wait you the judgment of your Rabb patiently; verily you are ever before Our eyes. And hallow the Praise of your Rabb before you arise.
And hallow Him in the night and at the declining of the stars.
By the star when it goes down.
Your companion has not gone astray, nor has he erred.
And he speaks not of his own desire.
It is but a Revelation revealed.
One of mighty powers has taught it to him.
One of mighty make. Then he stood straight.
While he was on the uppermost horizon.
Thereafter he drew closer, then he let himself down.
Till he was two bows length off or yet nearer.
Thus He revealed to His bondman whatever He revealed.
The heart lied not in what he saw.
Will you then dispute with him concerning what he saw?
And assuredly he saw him at another descent.
Near unto the lote-tree at the boundary.
Near thereto is the Garden of Abode.
When that covered the lote-tree which covered it.
The eye did not wander, nor did it turn aside.
Assuredly he beheld of the greatest Signs of his Rabb.
Have you then considered the Lāt and the 'Uzza'?
And the Manāt, the other third?
What! For you the males and for Him the females.
That indeed is an unfair division!

They are but names which you have named, you and your fathers, for which Allah has sent down no authority. They follow but their fancy and what pleases their souls, whereas there has come to them assuredly the guidance from their Rabb.
Shall man have whatsoever he wishes?
Allah's is the last and the first.
And many an angel there is in the heavens, whose intercession will not avail at all save after Allah's leave for whomsoever He wills and is well-pleased.
Verily those who believe not in the Hereafter name the angels with female names.
Verily they have no true knowledge thereof; they follow but a conjecture and conjecture is no substitute for the truth.
So withdraw you from him who turns away from Our admonition and seeks only the life of the world.
That is their highest point of knowledge. Verily your Rabb! It is He who is the Best Knower of him who strays from His Way, and He is the Best Knower of him who lets himself be guided.
And Allah's is whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, that He may recompense the evildoers for what they worked and reward those who do good with goodness.

They are those who shun heinous sins and indecencies save the minor offences. Verily your Rabb is of vast forgiveness; He is the Best Knower of you when He produced you out of the earth, and when you were embryos in the bellies of your mothers. So do not ascribe purity to yourselves. He is the Best Knower of him who fears Him.
Did you observe him who turned away.
And gave a little, and then stopped?
Is with him the knowledge of the Unseen so that he sees?
Has he not been told of what is in the Scriptures of Mūsa?
And of Ibrāhīm who faithfully fulfilled?
That no burdened soul shall bear the burden of another.
And that there shall be for man nothing except what he endeavours.
And that his endeavour shall soon be seen.
Thereafter he shall be recompensed with the fullest recompense.
And that unto your Rabb is the goal.
And that it is He Who causes one to laugh and causes one to weep.
And that it is He Who causes death and causes life.
And that He creates the pair, the male and the female.
From a seed when it is emitted.
And that upon Him is another bringing forth.
And that it is He Who enriches and impoverishes.
And that it is He Who is the Rabb of Sirius.
And that He destroyed the former ' Ād.
And that He spared not the Thamūd.
And also the People of Nūḥ before. Verily they were even greater wrongdoers and more contumacious.
And He overthrew the cities.
Then covered them what covered them.
Which then of your Rabb’s benefits will you doubt?
This apostle is a warner among the warners of old.
There has approached the Approaching Hour.
None can avert it, except Allah.
Do you marvel then at this discourse?
And laugh light-heartedly and not weep!
And you are being impatient.
So prostrate yourselves before Allah and worship.
The Hour has drawn near, and the moon has been rent asunder.
And if they behold a Sign, they turn away, and say: Magic continuous.
And they belied, and they followed their lusts, and every affair comes to a final goal.
And assuredly there has come to them tidings wherein is a deterrent.
Wisdom consummate. But warnings avail not.
So withdraw you from them. The day when the summoner will summon mankind to a thing unpleasant.
They will come forth with the downcast looks from the tomb as if they were locusts scattered.
Hastening towards the summoner. The infidels will say: This is a hard Day.
There belied before them the People of Nūḥ. So they belied Our bondman Nūḥ, and said: A madman; and he was reproved.
Thereupon he prayed to his Rabb. Verily I am overcome, so vindicate me.
Then We opened the portals of heaven with water poured out.
And We made the earth break forth with springs, that the water met after an affair already decreed.
And We bore him on a thing of planks and nails.
Moving forward under Our eyes: A vindication of him who had been rejected.
And assuredly We left it for a Sign. Is there, then, any one who would be admonished?
So how dreadful have been My chastisement and My warnings.
And assuredly We have made the Qurān easy for admonition; is there, then, any one who would be admonished?
And there belied the 'Ād'; so how dreadful have been My chastisement and My warnings!
Verily We! We sent against them a raging wind on a day of continuous calamity.
Carrying men away, as if they were trunks of uprooted palm trees.
So how dreadful has been My chastisement and My warnings.
And assuredly We have made the Qurān easy for admonition, is there, then, any one who would be admonished?
And the Thamūd belied the warnings.
And they said: A mere human being from amongst us, and alone - shall we follow him? Then indeed we should be in error and madness.
Has the Admonition been laid upon him from amongst us? Aye: He is an insolent liar!
They shall learn tomorrow which is an insolent liar!
Verily We are sending a she-camel as a test for them, so watch them you and have patience.
And declare you to them that water has been divided between them, every drinking shall be by turns.
Then they called their comrade, and took the sword, and hamstrung her.
So how dreadful have been My chastisement and My warnings!
Verily We! We sent upon them one shout, and they became as the stubble of a fold-builder.
And assuredly We have made the Qurān easy for admonition; is there, then, any one who would be admonished.
Then belied the warnings of the People of Lūṭ.
Verily We! We sent upon them a storm save the family of Lūṭ. We delivered them at dawn.
As a favour from Us. Thus do we recompense him who gives thanks.
And assuredly he had warned them of Our grasp, but they doubted the warnings.
And they solicited him for his guests; then We deprived them of their sight, taste and My chastisement and My warnings.
And thus met them early in the morning a settled chastisement.
Taste then My chastisement and My warnings.
And assuredly We have made the Qurān easy for admonition; is there, then, anyone who would be admonished?
And assuredly there came the warning unto the household of the Pharaoh.
They belied Our Signs, every one thereof. Then We seized them with the grip of the Mighty, the Powerful.
Are you infidels better than those? Or, is there an immunity for you in the Writs?
Or is it that they say: We are a people prevailing?
Soon will this multitude be vanquished, and they will turn their backs.
Aye: The Hour is their appointed term and the Hour will be far more grievous and far more bitter.
Verily the culprits are in great error and madness.
On the Day when they shall be dragged on their faces into the Fire, it will be said to them: Taste the touch of the Scorching.
Verily We have created everything by a measure.
And Our Commandment is but one as the twinkling of an eye.
And assuredly We have destroyed your likes; is there, then, any one who would be admonished?
And everything they have done is in the Writs.
And everything, small or big, has been written down.
Verily the pious will be amid Gardens and rivers.
In a good seat, near a Sovereign Omnipotent.
The Compassionate.
He taught the Qurān.
He created man.
He taught him utterance.
The sun and the moon are made punctual.
And herbs and trees do Sajdah.
And the sky! He has elevated it and set the balance.
That you should not trespass in respect of the Balance.
And observe the weight with equity, and do not make the balance deficient.
And the earth: He has laid it for the creatures.
Therein are fruit and palm-trees sheathed.
And grain chaffed and other food.
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you twain deny?
He created man from potter's clay.
And has created the Jinn from a flame of fire.
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you twain deny?
He is Rabb of the two Easts and the two Wests.
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you twain deny?
He has let loose the two oceans.
In-between them is a barrier they cannot pass.
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you twain deny?
There come forth from the two the pearl and the coral.
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you twain deny?
His are the ships slanted like mountains in the sea.
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you twain deny?
Everyone who is thereon is mortal.
And there will remain the face of your Rabb, Owner of Majesty and Beneficence.
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you twain deny?
Of Him begs whosoever is in the heavens and the earth, Every day He is in a new state.
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you twain deny?
Soon We shall direct Ourselves to you, O two classes!
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you twain deny?
O' Assembly of Jinn and mankind! If you are able to pass out of the regions of the heavens and the earth, then do pass out, but you cannot pass out except with an authority.
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you deny?
There shall be sent against both of you flame of fire and smoke, and you will not be able to defend yourselves.
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you deny?
And when the heaven will be rent asunder and will become rosy like red hide.
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you deny?
Neither man nor Jinn will be questioned of his sin that Day.
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you twain deny?
The culprits will be known from their marks, and will be seized by their fore-locks and their feet.
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you twain deny?
This is the Hell which the culprits denied.
They shall go round between it and boiling hot water.
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you twain deny?
And for him who dreads the standing before his Rabb will be two Gardens.
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you twain deny?
With spreading branches.
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you twain deny?
In them will be two fountains running.
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you deny?
In them will be every kind of fruit in pairs.
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you deny?
Reclining on the carpets lined with rich brocade, and the fruits of the two Gardens will be near at hand.
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you twain deny?
Therein shall be damsels of refraining looks, touched by neither man nor Jinn.
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you twain deny?
Like rubies and coral.
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you twain deny?
Is the recompense for good other than good?
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you twain deny?
And below the two, there will be two other Gardens.
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you twain deny?
Dark-green.
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you twain deny?
In them will be two fountains gushing forth.
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you twain deny?
In them will be the fruit, date palms and pomegranates.
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you twain deny?
Therein will be damsels comely and beautiful.
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you twain deny?
Fair ones, cloistered in tents.
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you twain deny?
Untouched by man and Jinn.
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you twain deny?
Reclining upon green cushions and rich carpets.
Which, then, of the benefits of your Rabb will you twain deny?
Blessed be the name of your Rabb, Owner of Majesty and Beneficence.
When the Event happens.
And there can be no denial of its happening.
Abasing one, exalting others.
This will be when the earth is shaken and shaken.
And the mountains are crumbled and crumbled.
So that they become scattered dust.
And you are in three groups.
Those on the right hand, how happy shall those on the right hand be!
Those on the left hand; how miserable shall those on the left hand be!
And the preceders are the preceders.
Those shall be brought near.
In Gardens of Delight.
A multitude from the ancients.
And a few from the later generations.
On couches lined with gold.
Reclining on them facing each other.
Youths ever-young will go round them.
With goblets and ewers and cups of limpid drink.
Theirs will be no headiness, nor will they be inebriated.
And with fruit of their choice.
And with fowl-flesh of their desire.
And there will be fair ones large-eyed.
The like unto pearls well-guarded.
A recompense for what they had been doing.
No vain or sinful talk will they hear therein.
Only the saying, peace! peace!
And the fellows on the right hand; How happy shall the fellows on the right hand be!
Midst thorn-less lote-trees.
And plantains laden with fruit.
And the shade over-spread.
And water over-flowing.
And fruit abundant.
Neither ending nor forbidden.
And couches raised.
Verily We! We have created those maidens by a special creation.
And have made them perpetual virgins.
Loving, of equal age.
For the fellows on the right hand.
A multitude from the ancients.
And a multitude from the later generations.
And the fellows on the left hand! How miserable shall the fellows on the left hand be!
Amidst scorching wind and scalding water.
And the shade of dark smoke.
Neither cool nor pleasant.
Verily they had been affluent before.
And they had been persisting in heinous offences.
And they used to say, when we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we indeed be raised?
We and our fathers of old?
Say you, verily the ancients and those of the later generations.
Are all going to be assembled on the assigned time of a Day Known.
Then verily you, you erring, denying people.
Shall surely eat of the tree of Zaqqūm.
And shall fill your bellies with it.
And shall drink of boiling water.
Drinking as the drinking of thirsty camels raging with thirst.
This shall be their entertainment on the Day of Requital.
Verily We! It is We Who created you, why do you not confess?
Do you behold what you emit?
Then is it you who create him, or are We the Creator?
We! It is We who have decreed death unto you all and We are not to be outstripped.
In ‘hat We may substitute others like you and may produce you into what you know not.
And assuredly you have finally known the first production. Why do you not heed?
Do you behold what you sow?
Do you cause it to grow, or are We the Grower?
If We willed, We would surely make it chaff, so that you would be left wondering.
We are undone indeed.
Aye! We are deprived altogether.
Do you behold the water which you drink.
Is it you who sends it down from the rain-cloud, or are We the sender down?
If We willed, We would surely make it brackish. Why do you not give thanks?
Do you behold the fire you strike out?
Is it you who produce the tree thereof, or are We the Producer?
We! It is We Who made it a reminder, and a provision for the campers.
So hallow you the name of your Rabb, the Mighty.
I swear by the setting of the stars.
And that is a mighty oath, if you but knew.
That it is an honoured Recitation.
In a Book well-guarded.
Which none can touch except the purified.
It is a revelation from the Rabb of the worlds.
Is this the discourse that you hold so lightly?
And make it your provision that you should deny it?
Wherefore then, when the soil comes up to the wind-pipe.
And you are looking on.
We are nearer to him than you are, but you behold not.
Wherefore then, if you are not to be requited.
Can you cause it not to return, if you are truthful?
Then if he be of the brought-near.
For him shall be repose and fragrance and a Garden of Delight.
And if he be of the fellows on the right hand.
Then: peace unto you, for you are of those on the right hand.
And if he be of the rejectors, the erring.
Then, an entertainment of the boiling water.
And roasting in a Blaze.
Verily this! This is the very truth.
So hallow you the name of your Rabb, the Mighty.
Hallows Allah whatever is in the heavens and the earth, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He gives life and causes death; and He is Potent over everything.
He is the First and the Last, and the Evident and the Inward and He is the Knower of everything.

He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six days; then He established Himself on the Throne. He knows whatever plunges into the earth, and whatever comes forth therefrom, and whatever descends from the heaven and whatever ascends thereto; and He is with you wherever you be. And Allah is Beholder of whatever you do.
His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and to Allah will all affairs be brought back.
He plunges the night into the day, and plunges the day into the night, and He is the Knower of whatever is in the breasts.
Believe in Allah and His Messenger and spend of that whereof He has made you successors to. Those of you who believe and spend – theirs shall be great wage.
And why is it that you believe not in Allah whereas the Messenger is calling you to believe in your Rabb, and He has already taken your bond, if you are going to be believers?
He it is Who sends down to His bondmen clear Signs that He may bring you forth from darkness into the light, and verily Allah is to you Tender, Merciful.

And how is it that you spend not in the cause of Allah when Allah's shall be the inheritance of the heavens and the earth? Those of you who spent and fought before the victory shall not be held equal. They are greater in rank than those who spent and fought afterwards; unto each Allah has promised good; and He is Aware of whatever you do.
Who is he that will lend Allah a goodly loan, so that He may multiply it for him? And his will be an honourable wage.

Mention the Day whereon you shall see the believing men and women, their light running before them and on their right hands, glad tidings to you To-day. Gardens with running water beneath them, they will abide therein. That, it is a mighty achievement.

It shall be the Day whereon the hypocrites, men and women, will say to the faithful: wait for us that we may borrow some light from you. It will be said: Go back and seek a light elsewhere. A high wall will then be set up between them, wherein will be a door, of which the inside has mercy and the outside is toward the torment.

They will call to them: Have we not been with you? They will say: Yes, but you tempted your souls and you waited and you doubted and your vain desires beguiled you until there came the affair of Allah, and in respect of Allah the beguiler beguiled you.
Today, therefore, will no ransom be accepted of you, nor of those who openly disbelieved. abode is the Fire; that is your companion, a hapless destination.

Is not the time yet come for those who believe, that their hearts should humble themselves to Allah's admonition and to the truth which has been revealed, and that they do not become as those who were given the Book before, and the time was extended to them, and so their hearts were hardened? And many of them were ungodly.
Know that Allah quickens the earth after its death. Surely We have propounded to you the Signs that perchance you may reflect.
Verify the alms-giving men and women - and they are lending a goodly loan to Allah - it shall be multiplied for them and theirs shall be an honourable wage.

And those who believe in Allah and His Messengers, they are the saints and martyrs in the sight of their Rabb: Theirs shall be full wage and their light. And those who disbelieved and belied Our Signs - they shall be the fellows of the Blaze.

Know that the life of this world is but a sport and a play, and an adornment and a self-glorification among you and a rivalry in riches and children. It is as the vegetation after rains, the growth of which pleases the husbandmen, then it withers and you see it becoming yellow, then it becomes chaff. And in the Hereafter there is both a grievous torment and forgiveness from Allah and His Pleasure; and the life of this world is but a vain bauble.

Strive with one another in hastening towards forgiveness from your Rabb and towards a Garden of which the width is as the width of the heavens and the earth, prepared for those who believe in Allah and His Messengers. This is the Grace of Allah! He vouchsafes it to whomsoever He will; and Allah is the Owner of Mighty Grace.
Nothing of affliction befalls the earth or your persons but it is inscribed in the Book, even before We have created them. Verily that is easy with Allah.
This is announced lest you feel sorry for what you miss, or exult over what He has vouchsafed to you. And Allah loves not any vainglorious boaster.
They who are niggardly and enjoin others to be niggardly. And whoever turns away, then verily Allah! He is the Self-Sufficient, the Praiseworthy.

Assuredly We sent Our Messengers with evidences and We sent down with them the Book and the Balance that the people might observe equity, and We sent down iron in which is great violence and also advantages to mankind, and that Allah may know him who succours Allah, unseen, and His Messengers. Verily Allah is Strong, Mighty.

Assuredly We sent Nūḥ and Ibrāhīm, and placed in the posterity of the twain the Prophethood and the Book. Then of them are some guided ones, and many of them are ungodly. And thereafter We caused Our Messengers to follow in their footsteps, and We caused 'Isā, son of Maryam, to follow them, and We vouchsafed to him the Bible, and We placed in the hearts of those who truly followed him, tenderness and compassion. And asceticism, We did not prescribe it for them; they innovated it, only seeking Allah's goodwill, but they tended it not with the tendence due to it. So We vouchsafed to such of them as believed their wage, and many of them are ungodly.

And thereafter We caused Our Messengers to follow in their footsteps, and We caused 'Isa, son of Maryam, to follow them, and We vouchsafed to him the Bible, and We placed in the hearts of those who truly followed him, tenderness and compassion. And asceticism, We did not prescribe it for them; they innovated it, only seeking Allah ’s goodwill, but they tended it not with the tendency due to it. So We vouchsafed to such of them as believed their wage; and many of them are ungodly.

O’ believers! Fear Allah and believe in His Messenger, He will vouchsafe to you twofold portions of His Mercy and will assign to you a light with which you will walk, and He will forgive you. And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

This He will award that the People of the Book may know that they control nothing of the Grace of Allah, and that the grace is in Allah ’s hand. He vouchsafes it to whom He will, and Allah is the Owner of Mighty Grace.
Surely has Allah heard the saying of her who pleaded with you concerning her husband and made her plaint to Allah, and Allah has heard your mutual conversation. Verily Allah is Hearing.

As to those among you who put away their wives by pronouncing Zihār – their mothers they are not. Their mothers are only those who gave them birth; and they utter a word disreputable and false. Verily Allah is Pardoning, Forgiving.

Those who put away their wives by pronouncing Zihār and thereafter would retract what they have said, then upon them is the freeing of a slave before they touch each other. You are exhorted to that; and Allah is Aware of whatsoever you do.

And whoever does not find a slave to free, on him is the fasting for two months consecutively before they touch each other, and on him who is unable to do so is the feeding of sixty indigent ones. That is in order that you may believe in Allah and His Messenger. These are the ordinances of Allah, and for the infidels is an afflictive chastisement.

Verily those who oppose Allah and his Messenger shall be abased even as those before them were abased; and surely We have sent down manifest Signs. And for the infidels is an ignominious chastisement.
On the Day when Allah will raise them all together and declare to them what they have worked. Allah has taken count thereof, while they forget it. And Allah is a Witness over everything.

Have you not seen that Allah knows whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth? There is no whispering among three but He is their fourth, nor among five but He is their sixth, nor fewer nor more, but He is with them wheresoever they may be. And thereafter He will declare to them, on the Day of Judgment what they have worked. Verily Allah is the Knower of everything.

Have you not seen those who were forbidden whispering and they returned afterwards to what they had been forbidden? And they whisper among themselves of sin, and transgression and disobedience to the Messenger. And when they come to you, they do not greet you with that with which Allah greets you, and say within themselves: Why does Allah not punish us for what we utter? Sufficient unto them is Hell, wherein they will roast, a hapless destination!
O believers! When you whisper together, do not whisper of sin and transgression and disobedience to the Messenger, but whisper for virtue and piety. And fear Allah unto whom you will be gathered.
Whispering is only from Satan that he may grieve the believers, and he cannot harm them at all save with the leave of Allah. So in Allah let the faithful trust.

O believers! When it is said to you: Make room in your assemblies, then make room; Allah will make room for you. And when it is said: rise up, then rise up. Allah will exalt, in degree, those of you who believe and those who are endowed with knowledge Allah is Aware of whatsoever you work.

O believers! When you come to the Messenger for private consultation, offer alms before your whispering. That is better for you and purer. Then if you do not find the wherewithal, Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

Do you shrink at your spending something in charity before your whispering? Then, when you could not do it, and Allah relented towards you, establish Şalāt and pay Zakāt, and obey Allah and His Messenger. And Allah is Aware of what you do.
Do you not see those who take for friends a people with whom Allah is annoyed? They are neither of you nor of them, and they swear to a lie while they know.
Allah has prepared for them a grievous torment; verily vile is what they have been working.
They have taken their oaths as a shield, and they have hindered others from the way of Allah, and theirs shall be a debasing torment.
Their riches or their progeny will not avail them against Allah at all. They are the fellows of the Fire; there they shall abide.
This will happen on a Day when Allah will raise all together, then they will swear to Allah, as they swear to you today, imagining that they rest upon anything. I o! verily they are the liars.
Satan has overpowered them and has caused them to forget Allah's Zikr. These are the hand of Satan. Lo! Verily it is the band of Satan that shall be the losers.
Verily those who resist Allah and His Messenger, they are among the lowest.
Allah has prescribed: Surely I will overcome: I and My Messengers. Verily Allah is Strong, Mighty.

You shall not find a people who believe in Allah and the last Day befriending those who oppose Allah and His Messenger, even though they be their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their kindred. These! He has inscribed faith on their hearts and has strengthened them with a spirit from Him; and He shall make them enter Gardens whereunder rivers flow as abiders therein. Well pleased is Allah with them, and well pleased are they with Him; these are Allah's band. Lo! Verily it is Allah's band that are the blissful.
Whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth hallows Allah, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.

He it is Who drove forth the People of the Book who disbelieved, from their homes at the first meeting. You did not imagine that they would go forth, and they imagined that their strongholds would defend them against Allah. Then Allah came upon them from whence they reckoned not, cast terror in their hearts so that they made their houses desolate by their own hands as well as hands of the faithful. Take warning, therefore, O you with eyes!
And had not Allah ordained banishment for them, surely He would have chastised them in this world, and in the Hereafter theirs is a chastisement of the Fire.
This, because they opposed Allah and His Messenger, and whoever
Whatever fine palms you cut down or left standing on their roots, it was by Allah's leave and in order that He might abase the transgressors.
And as to what He restored to His Messenger, you rushed neither horse nor camel upon it, but Allah gives mastery to His Messenger over whomsoever He will. And Allah is potent over everything.

Whatsoever Allah may restore to His Messenger from the people of the cities is due unto Allah and the Messenger and his kinsmen, and the orphans and the indigent and the wayfarer, so that it may not be confined to the rich among you. Take whatsoever the Messenger gives you, and refrain from whatsoever he forbids you. And fear Allah; verily Allah is Stern in chastising.
And it is due to the poor Muḥājirīn who have been driven forth from their homes and their substance, seeking grace and goodwill from Allah and succouring His Messenger. These! They are the sincere.

And it is also due to those who are settled in the dwelling and the faith before them, loving those who have migrated to them and finding in their breasts no desire for what has been given them, preferring them above themselves even though there was want among them. And whosoever is preserved from the greed of his soul, then these! They are the blissful.

And it is also due to those who came after them, saying! Rabb! Forgive us and our brothers who have preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts any rancour toward those who have already believed, Rabb! You are Tender, Merciful.

See you not those who dissemble saying to their brothers who disbelieve among the People of the Book: if you are banished we too will go forth with you and we will not listen to anyone in respect of will go forth with you and we will not listen to anyone in respect of you, and if you are attacked, we will succour you. Allah bears witness that they are certainly liars.

To be sure, if they are banished, they will not go forth with them, and if they are attacked, they will not succour them, and even if they did succour them they would turn their backs, and then they should not be succoured.
Surely in their breasts you are more awful than Allah. That is because they are a people who have no understanding.

They shall not fight against you, not even together, except in fenced townships or from behind walls. Their violence among themselves is great; you deem them enjoined, while their hearts are diverse. That is because they are a people who do not reflect.
They are like those a little before them; they tasted the ill effect of their affairs, and theirs will be an afflictive torment.
They are like Satan when he says to man: disbelieve; and then when he disbelieves, says: I am quit of you. I verily fear Allah, Rabb of the worlds.
The end of both, however, will be that they will be in the Fire, abiding therein; that is the meed of the ungodly.
O’you who believe! Fear Allah, and let every soul look to what it sends forward for the morrow. And fear Allah; Allah is Aware of what you do.
And be not as those who forgot Allah, so He caused them to forget their own souls. These! They are the transgressors.
Not alike are the fellows of the Fire and the fellows of the Garden. Fellows of the Garden are the achievers.

Had We sent down this Qurān on a mountain, you would surely have seen it humbling itself and cleaving in asunder in awe of Allah. Such similitudes We propound to mankind that perhaps they may reflect.
He is Allah; there is no god but He, the Knower of the unseen and the seen. He is the Compassionate, the Merciful.

He is Allah, there is no god but He, the Sovereign, the Holy, the Author of Safety, the Giver of Peace, the Protector, the Mighty, the Mender, the Majestic. Hallowed be Allah from what they associate.
He is Allah, the Creator, the Maker, the Fashioner, His are the excellent names. Him hallows whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth, and He is Mighty, the Wise.

O you who believe! Do not make friends with those who are My enemies and yours showing affection towards them, while of a surety they deny what has come to you of the truth, and have driven forth the Messenger and yourselves because you believe in Allah, your Rabb, if you have come forth to strive in My cause, and to seek My goodwill. You show them affection in secret, while I know very well what you conceal and what you disclose. And whosoever of you does this, he has surely strayed from the straight path.
Should they come upon you, they will be your enemies and will stretch out their hands against you and also their tongues with evil, and would like that you should disbelieve.
Neither your kindred nor your children will profit you on the Day of Judgment. He will decide between you; and Allah is the Beholder of what you do.

Surely an excellent pattern has been for you in Ibrāhīm and those with him, when they said to their people: Verily we are quit of you and what you worship beside Allah, and we renounce you, and there has appeared between us and you hostility and hatred for ever until you believe in Allah alone, except the saying of Ibrāhīm to his father. Surely I shall seek forgiveness for you, and surely I have no power for you with Allah at all. Our Rabb! In You we put our trust and to You we turn, and to You is our journeying.
Our Rabb! Make us not a trial for those who disbelieve, and forgive us, our Rabb. Verily You are Mighty, the Wise.
Assuredly there has been an excellent pattern for you in them - for him who hopes for Allah and the Last Day. And whosoever turns away, then verily Allah! He is the Self-sufficient, the Laudable.
Allah may perhaps place affection between you and those whom you hold as enemies. And Allah is Potent, and Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
Allah does not forbid you to deal benevolently and equitably with those who did not fight against you on account of religion nor drove you out from homes; verily Allah loves the equitable.

It is only concerning those who fought against you on account of religion and drove you out from your homes and helped in driving you out, that Allah forbids you to befriend them. And whosoever will befriend them, then these are the wrongdoers.

O you who believe! When believing women come to you as emigrants, examine them. Allah is the Best Knower of their faith. Then if you ascertain that they are believers, then do not send them back to the infidels; they are not lawful to them, nor are they lawful to them, and give them what they have spent. Nor is it a crime if you wed them when you have paid their wages. And do not hold to the ties of the infidel women, and ask back what you have spent, and let them ask back what they have spent. That is the judgment of Allah, He judges between you. And Allah is Knowing, Wise.

And if any of your wives has been left with the infidels and you have retaliated, then give to those whose wives have gone away the like of what they have expended, and fear Allah in Whom you believe.

O Prophet! When believing women come to you for taking Oath of Allegiance, that they shall not associate anything with Allah, nor shall they steal, nor shall they commit fornication, nor shall they slay their children, nor shall they produce any falsehood that they have fabricated between their hands and feet, nor shall they disobey you in anything reputable, then accept their oath, and pray to Allah for their forgiveness. Verily Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
O you who believe! Do not make friends with people who have despaired of the Hereafter, as despaired are the infidels.
Hallows Allah whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth. And He is the Mighty, the Wise.
O faithful! Why do you say what you do not act?
Most odious it is to Allah that you should say what you do not act.
Verily Allah loves those who fight in His cause drawn up n ranks, as though they were a structure well-compacted.

And recall when Mūsa said to his people: my people! Why do you hurt me when you know surely that I am Allah's Messenger to you? Then when they swerved, Allah made their hearts swerve; and Allah does not guide a transgressing people.

And recall when 'Isā, son of Maryam, said: O Children of Isrāil! Verily I am Allah's Messenger to you, confirming the Torah before me and conveying the glad news of a Messenger coming after me: His name will be Ahmad. Then when he came to them with evidence, they said: This is manifest magic.
And who is a greater wrong doer than he who, when he is summoned to Islam, fabricates a lie against Allah? And Allah does not guide an ungodly people.
They intend to extinguish the light of Allah with their mouths, and Allah is going to accomplish His light, though the infidels may be averse.
He is Who has sent His Messenger with guidance and true faith that He may make it triumph over every other faith, though the associates may be averse.
O you who believe! Shall I direct you to a trade, which will deliver you from an afflictive torment?
It is: Believe in Allah and His Messenger and strive in the Cause of Allah with your riches and lives. That is best for you if you only know!
He will remit your sins, and make you enter the Gardens with running water, and happy abodes in the Everlasting Gardens. That is a great achievement.
And also another bliss, which you love: Succour from Allah and a swift victory. And bear you the glad tidings to the faithful.

O you who believe! Be Allah's helpers, even as 'Isā, son of Maryam, said to the disciples: Who shall be my helpers for Allah? The disciples said: We are Allah's helpers. Then a party of the Children of Isrā'īl believed, and another party disbelieved. Then We strengthened those who believed against their foe, so they became triumphant.
Hallows whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth Allah, the Sovereign, the Holy, the Mighty, the Wise.

He is Who has raised amidst the unlettered ones a Messenger from among themselves, rehearsing to them His Revelations and purifying them and teaching them the Book and the Wisdom, though they have been before in gross error.
And also others of them who have not yet joined them. And He is the Mighty, the Wise.
That is the Grace of Allah; He vouchsafes it to whomsoever He will; and Allah is the Owner of Mighty Grace.

The case of those who were laden with Torah but who bore it not is as the case of an ass bearing tomes. Hapless is the case of those who belie the Sign of Allah, and Allah does not guide a wrongdoing people.
Say you: O those who are Judaised: If you think you are the friends of Allah above mankind, then wish for death, if you are truthful.
And they will never wish for it, because of what their hands have sent forward. And Allah is the Knower of the wrong doers.

Say you: The death which you flee from will certainly meet you, and thereafter you will be brought back to the Knower of the Unseen and the seen, and He will declare to you what you have been working.
O you who believe! When the call is made to the Şalāt on Friday hasten to Allah's Zikr and leave off bargaining. That is better for you, if you know.
Then when the Şalāt is ended, disperse on the land and seek of the Grace of Allah, and remember Allah much, perhaps you may thrive.
And when they behold merchandise or sport, they flocked thereto, and left you standing. Say: What is with Allah is far better than sport and merchandise, and Allah is the Best of Providers.
When the hypocrites come to you, they say: We bear witness that you are Allah's Messenger. Allah knows that you are His Messenger, but Allah also bears witness that the hypocrites are liars indeed.
They have made their oaths a shield; and they turn away men from the path of Allah. Vile is indeed what they have been working.
This, because they first believed and then disbelieved, their hearts are therefore sealed, so that they do not understand.

And when you look at them, their persons please you, and if they speak, you listen to their discourse; they look as though they are blocks of wood prop up. They imagine every shout to be at them. They are the foe; so beware of them. Perish them Allah! Whither are they deviating?
And when it is said to them: come! So that the Messenger of Allah may ask forgiveness for you, they twist their heads, and you see them retire. While they are stiff-necked.
It is alike to them whether you ask forgiveness for them or not; Allah shall not forgive them. Allah does not guide a transgressing people.

They are the ones who say: Spend not on those who are with Allah's Messenger, so that they may desert him, whereas Allah's are the treasures of the heavens and the earth. Yet the hypocrites do not understand.
They say: Surely if we return to Madinah, the mightier shall drive out the meaner thence; whereas the might belongs to Allah, and His Messenger and the faithful. Yet the hypocrites do not know.
O you who believe: Let not your riches or your children divert you from Allah's Zikr. And whoso does that, verily they are the losers.

And spend of that with which We have provided you before death comes to one of you and he says: Rabb: Would You not respite me for a short time, so that I would spend in charity and become of the righteous.
And Allah does not respite a soul when its term has arrived, and Allah is Aware of what you do.
Hallows Allah whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is on the earth. His is the kingdom, His is the Praise, and He is Potent over everything.
He is Who has created you, so of you some are infidels and some are believers, and Allah is Beholder of what you do.
He has created the heavens and the earth with truth, and has fashioned you, and has fashioned you in a comely shape, and to Him is the return.
He Knows whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth; and He Knows whatsoever you conceal and whatsoever you disclose; and Allah is the Knower of whatsoever is in the breasts.
Has not the news reached you of those who disbelieved aforetime, and so tasted of the ill

That was because their Messengers came to them with evidences but they said: Will there guide us a mere human being? So they disbelieved and turned away. And Allah did not need them. Allah is Self-sufficient, Praise-worthy.
Those who disbelieved asserted that they would not be raised. Say you: By my Rabb, you shall surely be raised, and to you shall be declared what you worked. And that is easy for Allah.
So believe in Allah and His Messenger and the light which We have sent down. And Allah is Aware of what you work.

Remember the Day when He will assemble you, the Day of Assembly, that will be the Day of Mutual Loss and Gain. Then whosoever believes in Allah and acts righteously, He will expiate from him his misdeeds and will make him enter the Gardens whereunder rivers flow, as abiders therein. That is a great achievement.
And they who disbelieve and belie Our Signs! Those will be the fellows of the Fire as abider therein – a hapless destination!
No calamity befalls man save by Allah's leave and whoso believes in Allah He guides his heart. And Allah is the Knower of everything.
Obey Allah and obey the Messenger, then if you turn away, on Our Messenger there is only the clear preaching.
Allah! There is no god but He! Let in Allah, therefore, the believers put their trust.
O you who believe! Verily you have an enemy among your wives and your children; so beware of them. And if you pardon and pass over and forgive, then surely Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
Your riches and your children are but a trial, and Allah! With Him is a mighty wage.
Wherefore fear Allah as far as you are able, and listen and obey and spend, for the benefit of your souls. And whoso is guarded against the avarice of his soul, those! They are blissful.
If you lend to Allah a goodly loan, He will multiply it to you and will forgive you, and Allah is Appreciative, Forbearing.
Knower of the Unseen and the seen, the Mighty and the Wise.

O Prophet! When you divorce women, divorce them before their waiting-period, and count their waiting-period; and fear Allah, your Rabb. And do not drive them out of their houses, nor should they themselves go forth, unless they commit a flagrant indecency. These are the bounds of Allah, and he who trespasses the bounds of Allah has surely wronged himself. You know not that Hereafter Allah may bring something new to pass.

Then when they have attained their term, either retain them honourably; or part with them honourably; and take as witnesses two honest men from among you, and set up your testimony for Allah. Thus is exhorted he who believes in Allah and the Last Day. And whoso fears Allah He makes an outlet for him.
And He provides for him from whence he never reckons. And whoso puts his trust in Allah, He will suffice him. Verily Allah is sure to attain His Purpose, and has assigned to everything a measure.

And as to such of your women as have despaired of menstruation, if you are in doubt thereof, their waiting-period is three months, as also of those who have not yet menstruated. And as to those with burdens, their term is when they have laid down their burden. And whoso fears Allah, He has made his affair easy unto himself.
That is the Commandment of Allah, which He has sent down unto you. And whoso fears Allah, He will magnify his wage for him.

Lodge them wheresoever you are lodging according to your means, and do not hurt them so as to straiten them. And if they are with burden, spend on them until they lay down their burden. Then if they suckle their children for you give them their wage, and take counsel together honourably. And if you make hardship for each other, then another woman shall suckle for him.

Let the affluent spend according to his means, and whoso is stinted in his subsistence, let him spend of what Allah has given him. Allah does not task any soul except according to what He has vouchsafed it. Allah will soon appoint ease for hardship.
And how many a city trespassed the Commandment of its Rabb and His Messengers. So We reckoned with them sternly and inflicted on them a chastisement unheard of.
So they tasted the ill consequence of their affairs, and loss was the end result of their affair.
Allah has prepared for them a grievous punishment; so fear Allah, O' men of understanding! Those who have believed. Surely He has sent down unto you an Admonition.

A Messenger reciting the revelations of Allah as evidences, that he may bring forth those who believe and work righteous works from darkness unto light. And whoso believes in Allah and works righteously, him He shall cause to enter the Gardens whereunder rivers flow as abiders therein for ever. Surely Allah has made for them an excellent provision.

Allah it is Who has created seven heavens and of the earth the like thereof. His Commandment comes down between them; so that you may know that Allah is Potent over everything, and that Allah does encompass everything in His Knowledge.
O Prophet! Why do you forbid for you what Allah has allowed to you, seeking the goodwill of your wives? And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
Surely Allah has ordained for you absolution from your oaths; and Allah is your Patron, and He is the Knower, the Wise.

And recall when the Prophet confided a story to one of his spouses, and then she disclosed it. Allah apprised him of it; he made known a part of it, and a part he withheld. Then when he had apprised her of it, she said: Who has told you of it? He said: The Knower, the Aware has told me.

Then if you twain turn to Allah repentant, it is well; surely your hearts are so inclined. But if you support each other against him, then verily Allah! his friend is He and Jibril, and so are the righteous believers, and furthermore angels are his aiders.
If he divorces you, perchance his Rabb will give him in exchange better wives than you: Muslims, believers, devout, penitent, worshippers, given to fasting, both virgins and virgins.

O you who believe! Guard yourselves and your households against a Fire the fuel whereof is mankind and stones. Over it are angels, stern, strong; they do not disobey Allah in what He Commands them, and they do what they are commanded.
O you who disbelieve! Excuse not yourselves today; you are only being requited for what you have been working.

O you who believe! Turn to Allah with a sincere repentance, May be your Rabb will expiate from you your misdeeds and cause you to enter Gardens whereunder rivers flow, on the Day whereon Allah will not humiliate the Prophet and those who believe with him. Their light will be running before them and on their right hands, and they will say: Our Rabb! Perfect for us our light, and forgive us: Verily You are Potent over everything.
O Prophet! Strive hard against the infidels and the hypocrites, and be stern to them. And their abode is Hell; a hapless destination.

Allah propounded for those who disbelieve the similitude of the wife of Nūḥ and the wife of Lūṭ. They were under two of Our righteous bondmen, and then they defrauded them. Wherefore the twain availed them nothing against Allah, and it was said: Enter you twain the Fire with those who enter.

And Allah propounded for those who believe the similitude of the wife of the Pharaoh when she said: my Rabb! Build me in Your presence a house in the Garden and deliver me from the Pharaoh and his handiwork, and deliver me from the transgressing people.

And the similitude of Maryam daughter of 'Imran, who preserved her chastity, wherefore We breathed in it of Our Spirit. And she testified to the words of her Rabb and His Books and she was of the devout.
Blessed be He, in Whose hand is the Sovereignty, and He is Potent over everything.
Who has created death and life, that He might test you as to which of you is excellent in work. And He is the Mighty, the Forgiver.
Who has created the seven heavens in storeys. You shall not find any crack in the creation of the Compassionate.
Then repeat your look twice over, and your look will return to you dim and drowsy.
And assuredly We have bedecked the nearest sky with lamps and We have made them missiles for pelting devils, and We have prepared for them the torment of the Blaze.
And for those who disbelieve in their Rabb will be the torment of Hell – a hapless destination!
When they will be cast in it, they will hear a braying as it boils up.
It almost bursts up with rage. So often as a company is cast in it, its keepers will ask them: Did not a warner come to you?
They will say: Surely a warner did come to us but we refuted him and said: Allah has not sent down anything, you are nothing but in a great error.
And they will say: Had we listened or reflected, we would not have been among the fellows of the Blaze.
So they will confess their sin. Far away be they, the fellows of the Blaze!
Those Who are in awe of their Rabb unseen, theirs shall be forgiveness and a great wage.
And whether you keep your discourse secret or disclose it, verily He is the Knower of what is in the breasts.
Will not He Who has created know? He is the Subtle, the Aware.
He it is Who has made the earth subservient to you, so go forth in the tracts thereof, and eat of His provision. And to Him is the Resurrection.
Are you secure that He Who is in the heaven will not sink the earth with you, and then it should quake?
Or are you securing that He Who is in the heaven will not send against you a whirlwind? Soon you shall know how has been My warning.
And assuredly those before them have belied, then how has been My Wrath?
Do they not see the birds above them outstretching their wings and also closing them? None sustains them except the Compassionate. Verily He is Beholder of everything.
Who is he, besides the Compassionate that can be an army unto you and succour you? The infidels are but in delusion.
Should He withhold His provision, who is he that can provide for you? Aye! They persist in perversity and aversion.
Is he, then, who goes about grovelling upon his face better directed or he who walks evenly on a straight path?
Say you: He it is Who has brought you forth and has endowed you with hearing and sights and hearts. Little thanks it is you give!
Say you: He it is Who has spread you over the earth, and to Him you shall be gathered.
And they say: When will this promise come to pass, if you are truthful.
Say you: The knowledge thereof is only with Allah, and I am but a manifest warner.
But when they will see it approximating, sad will be the countenances of those who disbelieve, and it will be said: This is what you have been calling for.
Say you: Think! If Allah destroys me and those with me, or have Mercy on us, who will protect the infidels from an afflictive torment?
Say you: He is the Compassionate; in Him we have believed, and in Him we have put our trust. And soon you will know who it is that is in manifest error.
Say you: think! Were your water to be sunk away, who then could bring you water welling-up?
Nun, By the pen and by what they inscribe.
Through the Grace of your Rabb. You are not mad.
And verily for you will be an unending wage.
And verily you are of a high and noble disposition.
Soon you will see and they will see.
Which of you is afflicted with madness.
Verily your Rabb is the best Knower of him who has strayed from the path and the best Knower of him who is the guided one.
So do not obey you the beliers.
They would like that you should be a pliant, so that they also will be a pliant.
And do not obey you any ignominious swearer.
Defamer, spreader abroad of slander.
Hinderer of the good, trespasser, sinner.
Gross, and moreover ignoble.
And thus, because he is owner of riches and children.
When Our revelations are rehearsed to him he says: Fables of the ancients.
Soon We shall brand him on the snout.
Verily We! We have tried them even as We tried the men of a garden when they swore that they would surely pluck it in the morning.
And they made in the assertion no reservation.
Wherefore there visited it an encircling visitation while they slept.
Then in the morning it became as if it had been plucked.
Then in the morning they cried out to each other.
Saying Go out early to your tilth if you would pluck.
Then they went off speaking to each other in a low voice.
Let there enter upon you no needy man today.
And they went out early determined in purpose.
Then when they saw it, they said: Indeed we are gone astray.
Alas! It is we who have been robbed!
And the most moderate of them said: Did I not tell you: Why do you not hallow Him?
They said now in repentance: Hallowed be Our Rabb! Verily we have been wrong doers.
Then they turned to each other reproaching.
They said: Woe to us! Surely we have been arrogant.
Perhaps our Rabb may exchange for us a better garden than this, verily we are beseechers to our Rabb.
Such is the chastisement, and the chastisement of the Hereafter is far greater, if they but knew.
Verily for the pious there are Gardens of Delight with their Rabb.
Shall We make the Muslims like the culprits?
How it is with you! How ill you judge!
Is there with you a Book wherein you study?
That therein is for you what you may choose?
Or, have you oaths from Us, reaching to the Day of Resurrection, that yours will be what you judge?
Ask them, which of them will stand thereof as a guarantee?
Have they associate gods? Let them produce their associate gods if they are truthful.
Remember the Day when the shank shall be bared and they shall be called upon to prostrate themselves, but they shall not be able.
Downcast will be their looks; abjectness will overspread them. Surely they had been called upon to prostrate themselves, but they shall not be able.
Let Me alone with him who belies this discourse; We lead them on by steps whence they perceive not.
And I bear with them. Verily My contrivance is sure.
Do you ask them a wage, so that they are laden with debt?
Is with them the Unseen, so that they write down Allah's Decrees?
Be you patient with your Rabb’s judgment, and do not be you like him of the fish, when he cried out, while he was in anguish.
Had there not reached him the Grace from his Rabb, he would surely have been cast into the wilderness in a plight.
Then his Rabb chose him and made him of the righteous.
And when those who disbelieve hear the admonition; they shall cause you to stumble with the stern looks, and they say: Indeed he is mad.
While it is nothing but an admonition to the worlds.
The Inevitable Calamity!
What is the Inevitable Calamity!
And what will make you know what the Inevitable Calamity is?
The tribes of Thamūd and ' Ād belied the Striking Day.
As for Thamūd, they were destroyed by an outburst.
And as for ' Ād, they were destroyed by a wind, furious, roaring.
To which He subjected them for seven nights and eight days in succession so that you might have seen men during it lying prostrate, as though they were stumps of palm ruined.
Do you see any remnant of them?
And the Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities committed sin.
And they disbelieved their Rabb’s Messenger, so He seized them with an increasing grip.
Verily We bore you, when the water rose, upon a traversing ark.
That We might make it an admonition unto you and that it might be retained by the retaining ears.
And when the Trumpet will sound a single blast.
And the earth and the mountains will be borne, and they will be crushed with a single crushing.
Then on that Day will happen the event.
And the heaven will be rent in asunder, frail it will be on that Day.
And the angels will be on its borders, and eight of them will on that Day bear the Throne of your Rabb.
The Day whereon you will be mustered, nothing hidden by you will be hidden.
Then as to him, whose book will be vouchsafed to him in his right hand, he will say: Here! Read my record.
Verily I was sure that I would have to face my reckoning.
Then he shall be in a life well pleasing.
In a lofty Garden.
Of which the clusters will be near at hand.
Eat and drink with benefit for what you sent on beforehand in days past.
Then as to him whose record will be vouchsafed to him in his left hand, he will say. Oh! Would that I had not been given my record at all.
Nor known what was my reckoning.
Oh! Would that it would have been the ending.
My riches have availed me not.
My authority has perished for me.
Seize him, and chain him.
Then roast him in the Scorch.
Then fasten him with a chain seventy cubits long.
Verily he used not to believe in Allah, the Great.
Nor he urged on others the feeding of the poor.
No friend is therefore for him here this Day,
Nor any food except the filthy corruption.
None will eat it except the sinners.
I swear by what you see.
And by what you do not see.
That it is the speech brought by an honourable envoy.
And it is not the speech of a poet. Little it is that you believe.
Nor it is the speech of a soothsayer. Little are you admonished!
It is a Revelation from the of the worlds.
And if he had forgotten concerning Us some discourses.
We surely would have seized him by the right hand.
And then severed his life vein.
And not one of you would have withheld Us from punishing him.
And surely it is an Admonition to those who fear Allah.
And verily We know that some among you believe.
