And verily it shall be an occasion of anguish to the infidels.
And verily it is the truth of absolute certainty.
So hallow you the Name of your Rabb, the Great.
A questioner has questioned about chastisement about to befall.
Upon the infidels which is not to be averted.
From Allah, Owner of the ascending steps.
Thereby the angels ascend to Him and also the Spirit; on a Day whose space is fifty thousand years.
Be you patient with a becoming patience.
Verily they see it afar off.
And We see it near.
It shall befall on a Day whereon the sky will become like dregs of oil.
And the mountains will become like dyed wool.
And not a friend shall ask a friend.
Though they shall be made to see one another. The guilty would like to ransom himself from the torment of that Day by his children.
And his wife and his brother.
And his kin that sheltered him.
And all those on the earth, so that this might deliver him.
By no means! It is a Flame.
Flying off the scalp-skin.
It shall call him who turns away and backslides.
And amasses and hoards.
Verily man is formed impatient.
Bewailing when evil touches him.
And begrudging, when good visits him.
Not so are the prayerful.
Who are constant at their Salāt.
And in whose riches is a recognised right.
For the beggar and the destitute.
And who testify to the Day of Requital.
And who are fearful of their Rabb’s torment.
Verily from the torment of their Rabb none can feel secure.
As also those who guard their private parts.
Save in regard to their women and those whom their right hands own. So they are not reproachable.
And whoever seeks beyond that, then it is those who are the trespassers.
As also those who keep their trusts and their covenant.
And who stand firm in their testimonies.
And who are observant of their Şalāt.
Honoured, they shall dwell in Gardens.
What ails those who disbelieve, hastening towards you?
On the right and on the left, in companies?
Does every one of them covet that he shall enter the Garden of Delight?
By no means! We have created them from what they know.
I swear by the Rabb of the East and West that We are Able.
To replace them by others better than they and We are not to be frustrated.
So you let them alone plunging in vanity and sporting, until they meet their Day which they are promised.
The Day whereon they will come forth from the graves hurrying as if they were hastening to an altar
Downcast shall be their looks, abjectness shall overwhelm them. Such is the Day they were promised.
Verily We! We sent forth Nūḥ to his people saying: Warn your people before there comes to them an afflictive chastisement.
He said: My people! I am to you a manifest warner.
Worship Allah, and fear Him, and obey me.
He will forgive you your sins, and will defer you to an appointed term. Verily the term of Allah, when it comes, shall not be deferred, if you but know.
He said: Rabb! Verily I have called my people night and day.
And my calling has only increased their aversion.
Verily whenever I call them, that You may forgive them, they place their fingers in their ears, and wrap themselves with their garments, and persist in their denial, and are stiff-necked.
Then I have called them aloud.
Then I spoke to them in public and in private I addressed them.
And I said: Beg forgiveness of your Rabb; He is ever Most Forgiving.
He will send down upon you rains copiously.
And He will increase you in riches and children and will assign to you gardens and will assign to you rivers.
What ails you that you look not for majesty in Allah?
While He has created you by stages.
Do you not see how Allah has created the seven heavens in storeys?
And He has placed the moon therein for a light and has made the sun for a lamp?
And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth as a growth.
And hence He will cause you to return to it and He will bring you forth completely.
And Allah has made for you the earth an expanse.
That of it you may traverse the open ways.
Nūḥ said: Rabb! Verily they have denied me and have followed him whose riches and children has only increased him in loss.
And they have plotted a tremendous plot.
And they have said: You shall not leave your gods, nor shall you leave Wadd nor Suwa nor Yaghuth nor Ya'uq nor Nasr.
And surely they have led many astray. Increase them in naught save error.
And because of their misdeeds they were drowned, and then made to enter the Fire. Then they did not find for themselves any helpers.
And Nūḥ said: Rabb: Leave not of the infidels any inhabitant upon the earth.
For should You leave them, they will lead astray Your bondmen and will surely beget sinning infidels.
Rabb! Forgive me and my parents and him who enters my house as a believer, and all the faithful men and women, and increase not the ungodly save in perdition.
Say you, it has been revealed to me that a company of the Jinn listened and said: Verily we have listened to a Recitation wondrous.
Guiding to rectitude; so we have believed in it, and we shall not by any means associate any one with our Rabb.
And He, exalted be the majesty of our Rabb, has taken neither a wife nor a son.
And the foolish among us used to forge a lie against Allah exceedingly.
And verily we believed that neither man nor Jinn could ever forge a lie against Allah.
And persons among mankind have been seeking refuge with persons of the Jinn, so that they increased them in evil.
And indeed they imagined, as you too imagined, that Allah will not raise any one.
And we sought to reach the heaven, then we found it filled with a strong guard and darting meteors.
And we used to sit on seats therein to listen; but whosever listens now finds for him a darting meteor in wait.
And we do not know whether evil is boded for those on the earth, or their Rabb intends for them a right direction.
And of us there are some righteous and of us are some otherwise; we have been following very diverse paths.
And we know that we cannot frustrate Allah in the earth, nor can we elude Him by flight.
And when we heard the Message of guidance we believed in it, and whoever believes in his Rabb, he shall fear neither diminution nor wrong.
And of us some are Muslims, and some are deviators. Then whoever has embraced Islam such have endeavoured after a path of rectitude.
And as to the deviators, they shall be firewood for Hell.
And had they kept to the right path, surely We would have watered them with plentiful rains.
That We might try them thereby. And whoever turns aside from the remembrance of his Rabb, him He shall thrust into a vehement torment.
And the places of worship are for Allah, so do not call along with Allah anyone.
And when the bondman of Allah stood calling upon Him, they almost pressed upon him.
Say you: I simply call upon Allah, and do not associate anyone with Him.
Say you: I do not own for you power of hurt nor of benefit.
Say you: None can protect me from Allah, nor can I find besides Him any refuge.
Mine is but preaching from Allah and His Messages; and whosoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger, his portion is the Hell-fire, abiding there for ever.
They will go on denying until they see what they are promised. Then they will know who is weaker in protectors and fewer in number.
Say you: I do not know whether what you are promised is near, or whether my Rabb has appointed it for a distant term.
He is the Knower of the Unseen and He does not disclose His Unseen to anyone.
Save to a Messenger chosen. And then He causes to go before him and behind him a guard.
That He may know that they have delivered the messages of their Rabb. And He comprehends whatever is with them, and He keeps count of everything numbered.
O you enwrapped!
Keep vigil all night save a little.
Half of it, or a little less of it.
Or a little more. And intone the Qurān with a measured intonation.
Verily We! Soon We shall be casting on you a weighty word.
Verily the rising by night is most curbing and most conducive to right speech.
Verily for you is the day a prolonged occupation.
And remember you the Name of your Rabb and devote yourself to Him exclusively.
Rabb of the East and the West! No god is there but He! So take Him for your trustee.
And bear you patiently with what they say, and depart you from them with a becoming departure.
And let Me alone with the believers, owners of comfort and respite.
Verily with Us are heavy fetters and Scorch.
And a food that chokes and a painful torment.
On a Day when the earth and mountains shall quake and the mountains shall become a sand-heap.
Verily We have sent to you a Messenger, a witness over you, as We sent to the Pharaoh.
Then Pharaoh denied the Messenger, therefore We seized him with a painful grip.
How then, if you deny, shall you escape, on a Day that will make children grey-headed.
And the sky will be split therein. His Promise is certainly to be accomplished.
Verily this is an admonition; let him, therefore, who will, choose a way unto his Rabb.

Verily your Rabb Knows that you stay up near two-thirds of the night, or a half of it, or a third of it, and also a party of those who are with you. And Allah measures the night and the day. He Knows that you cannot compute it, so He has relented towards you. Recite now of the Qurān so much as is easy. He Knows that there will be among you some sick, and others shall be travelling in the land seeking Grace of Allah, and some others shall be fighting in the Cause of Allah. Recite of it, therefore, so much as is easy, and establish Şalāt, and pay Zakāt, and lend unto Allah a goodly loan. Whatsoever good you will send on for your souls, you will find it with Allah, better and greater in reward. And beg forgiveness of Allah; verily Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
O you enveloped!
Arise, and warn.
And magnify your Rabb.
And purify your raiment.
And shun pollution.
And show not favour, seeking more from them.
And be you patient for the goodwill of your Rabb.
Then when the Trumpet sounds.
That Day will be a day hard.
For the infidels, not easy.
Let Me alone with him whom I created lonely.
And for whom I assigned extended wealth.
And sons present by his side.
And for whom I smoothed everything.
And who yet covets that I shall increase.
Certainly not, he has been a foe to Our Signs.
Soon I shall afflict him with a fearful woe.
Surely he considered and devised.
Perish he: How maliciously he schemed!
And again perish he! How maliciously he schemed!
Then looked he.
Then frowned he, and scowled.
Then turned he back, and grew stiff-necked.
Then he said: Nothing is this but magic from of old.
Nothing is this but the word of man.
Soon I shall roast him in the Scorching Fire.
And what know you what the Scorching Fire is?
It shall not spare any one guilty, nor leave.
Scorching the skin.
Over it are appointed nineteen angels.

And We have appointed none but the angels to be wardens of the Fire. And We have made this number only a trial for them who disbelieve, so that those who are vouchsafed the Book may be convinced, and that the faithful may increase in faith, and that those who are vouchsafed the Book and the faithful may not dubitate, and that those in whose heart is a disease and the infidels may utter: what does Allah mean by this description? A forelock, lying, sinning.
Well, then, let him call his assembly.
We also shall call the infernal guards.
No indeed! You not obey him. Continue to adore, and continue to draw near.
Verily We have sent it down on the Night of Power.
And what will make you know what the Night of Power is?
The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.
The angels and the Spirit descend therein by the Command of their Rabb with His decrees for every affair.
It is all peace till the rising of the dawn.
Those who have disbelieved from among the People of the Book and the associaters, could not break off until there came unto them evidence.
A Messenger from Allah rehearsing Writs cleansed.
Wherein there are eternal discourses.
And those who are vouchsafed the Book differed not save after there had come unto them the evidence.
And they were commanded not but that they should worship Allah keeping religion pure for Him, as upright men, and that they should establish the Şalāt and pay Zakāt. That is the right religion.
Verily those who disbelieved from among the People of the Book and the associaters shall be cast unto Hell-fire as abiders therein. These are the worst of creatures.
Verily those who believe and work righteous works – these! They are the best of creatures.

Their recompense with their Rabb shall be Gardens Everlasting with running waters, as abiders therein for ever. Well-pleased will be Allah with them and well-pleased will be they with Allah. That is, for him who fears his Rabb.
When the earth is shaken by her full shaking.
And the earth shakes off her burdens.
And man says: What ails her.
On that Day will she relate what had happened to it.
Since your Rabb will inspire it.
On that Day will mankind proceed in bands, that they may be shown their works.
Then whosoever has worked good of an atom's weight shall see it.
And whosoever has worked ill of an atom's weight shall see it.
By the chargers panting.
And the striking sparks of fire by dashing their hoofs.
And raiding at dawn.
And therein raising dust.
And cleaving therein their way unto the host.
Verily man is ungrateful to his Rabb.
And to that he is a witness.
And he is vehement in the love of wealth.
Does he not know – when what is in the graves shall be ransacked?
And what is in the breasts shall be brought to light?
Verily their Rabb that Day shall be well-apprised of them.
The clatterer!
What is the clatterer?
And what will make you understand what the clatter,er is?
A Day when mankind shall become as moths scattered.
And mountains shall become as wool carded.
Then as for him whose balances are heavy.
He shall be in a life well-pleasing.
And as for him whose balances are light.
His abode shall be the Abyss.
And what shall make you understand what she is?
A Fire exceedingly hot.
The emulous desire of abundance engrosses you.
Until you visit the graves.
Lo! You shall soon know.
Again lo! You shall soon know.
Lo! Would that you knew now with sure knowledge!
Surely you shall behold the Scorch.
Then you shall behold with sure vision.
Then on that Day, you shall be questioned about the delights.
By the time.
Verily man is in loss.
But not those who believe and work righteous deeds, and enjoin upon each other the truth and enjoin upon each other steadfastness.
Woe be to every slanderer, traducer.
Who amasses and counts wealth.
He thinks that his wealth shall abide for him.
Lo! He shall surely be cast into the Crushing Fire.
And what shall make you understand what the Crushing Fire is?
Fire of Allah kindled.
Which mounts up to the hearts.
Verily it shall close upon them.
In pillars stretched forth.
Have you not seen how your Rabb dealt with the fellows of the elephant?
Did He not set their stratagem at nothing?
And He sent against them birds in flocks.
They hurled upon them clay stones.
Then He rendered them as stubble devoured.
For the protection of the Quraish.
For certain protection in the journey in the winter and the summer.
Let them worship the Rabb of this House.
Who has fed them against hunger, and has rendered them secure from fear of being waylaid.
Have you seen him who denies the Requital?
It is he who pushes away the orphan.
And does not urge the feeding of the poor.
So woe be to such performers of Şalāt.
As are heedless of their Şalāt.
They who would be seen.
And who withhold even the common necessaries from others.
Verily We have bestowed on you Kauthar.
So pray you to your Rabb, and sacrifice.
Truly it is your traducer who shall be childless.
Say you: Infidels!
I worship not what you worship.
Nor are you the worshippers of what I worship.
And I shall not be a worshipper of what you have worshipped.
Nor will you be the worshipper of what I worship.
Your requital shall be yours, and my requital shall be mine.
When there come the succour of Allah and victory.
And you find the mankind entering the religion of Allah in crowds.
Then hallow the Praise of your Rabb, and seek His forgiveness, verily He is ever Relenting.
Perish the two hands of Abū Lahab, and perish he!
His riches availed him not, nor what he earned.
Soon he shall roast in a Fire.
And his wife also, a fuel carrier.
Around her neck shall be a cord of twisted palm-fibres.
Say you: He is Allah, the One.
Allah, the Independent.
He begets not, nor was He begotten.
And never there has been anyone co-equal with Him.
Say you: I seek refuge with the Rabb of the day-break.
From the evil of what He has created.
And from the mischief of the darkening when it comes.
And from the mischief of the women blowers upon the knots.
And from the mischief of the envier when he envies.
Say you: I seek refuge with the Rabb of the mankind.
The King of mankind.
The God of mankind.
From the mischief of the sneaking whisperer.
Who whispers into the breasts of mankind.
Whether of jinn or of mankind.
